articles.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
articles.content: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无语言预训的文本到图像生成模式
articles.content_zh: 现代的文本到图像(T2I)系统使用互联网规模的语言预训来进行文本条件化的图像生成. 我们问语言预训对于强大的T2I生成是否必要. 我们引入了Halcyon, 一个早期聚变的多式自相回转模型家族, 完全从零开始在GPIC上训练, 一个100M图像文本对的数据集。 Halcyon-0.52B优于LlamaGen-XL/8(48.0 vs 63.3 gFD),18.2美元\时间减去预训计算. 此外,Halcyon-1.6B的成绩超过了JiT-T2I-XXL/8++(35.3 vs 41.0 gFD),预训计算减少275美元\时间. 被控制的实验显示,只使用文本的预训并不能改善T2I生成. Halcyon还学习了图像字幕,用I2T监管取代了字幕退出,在相同的预训预算下保持了具有竞争力的T2I生成质量. 我们显示,强大的T2I系统可以在没有互联网规模的语言预训的情况下从零开始训练. 守则和模型见https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon。

articles.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OpenVL Harness: 真实世界视觉代理工具与多模式内存
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理上取得了迅速的进展,然而许多任务需要的证据单靠内部推理是难以获得的:我们对22个基准的控制研究显示,仅仅增加基础模型的推论预算只能产生微小的收益. 这种任务需要有根据的认知、外部知识和通过各种工具获得的数字测量,其产出必须能够对模型作出解释,并保留各种推理步骤。 我们介绍了OpenVLHarness,这是一个围绕能力层和持久的多模式记忆组织的多模式推理工具。 能力层将任务级工具界面与证据渲染相结合,提供一致的获取多端后端,并将其输出转化为可被模型读取的观测. 持续的多模式内存保留了相应的图像,结构化数据和网络引用,作为每个查询的可地址文物. 一个编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序,使计算能够结合多个工具的结果. 这些机制共同支持获得、检查和整理多式联运证据的迭接过程。 对22个有8个开放和专有骨干的基准进行评估后,OpenVLHarness的平均分数比匹配的无工具基线提高9.7-12.6分,包括+11.2分与Qune3-VL-8B分,+9.7分与Kimi K3分,+9.9分与GPT-6 Astra分. 随着GPT-6 Luna在中度推理上的努力,OpenVLHarness以最大努力7.7-8.5分的成绩超过了基准模型"Codex"和"Visual Sketchpad",而其模型-token成本最高为37%.

articles.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
articles.content: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 这真的有用吗? 综合功能性CAD机制
articles.content_zh: 虽然LLM代理可以产生视觉上可信的 CAD 组件,但这些设计往往不能实现预期的物理功能. 我们研究功能性的 CAD 设计,一种由代理人解释未明确要求的设置,即构造和迭代修改机制,以满足物理模拟中的功能要求. 验证这些要求是非三角性的:不同的候选机制可能通过完全不同的组件,控制和操作序列来实现相同的功能. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出FunCAD-Harness,这个框架将抽象的要求转化为针对候选人的物理测试,并使用模拟反馈来指导设计修改. 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们引入了FunCABennch,这一基准涵盖46个具有相互依存和多步骤业务的机制家庭。 跨越边界的LLM剂实验表明,FunCAD-Harness暴露出视觉检查看不见的微妙机械故障,大大改善了功能成功率,超过了标准模拟强化基线. 归根结底,我们的工作标志着向有能力将人类意图转化为工作机制的CAD代理人迈出了一步。

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.content: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以可视可控政策自我分配加强学习
articles.content_zh: 具有可核查奖励的多式加固学习(RLVR)提供了可靠的任务层面监督,但为将视觉推理错误定位提供了有限的指导. 政策上的自我消化(OPSD)与这种监督相辅相成的是,一位拥有以证据为中心的视觉观点的特权教师进行了密集的象征性校正。 然而,由此产生的校正可能会将视觉证据与语言学前科、反应风格或特权观点本身引起的非视觉转变相混淆。 我们把这一现象正式确定为特权矫正污染:当其更新方向不能始终归因于特权视觉证据时,象征性的矫正就受到污染。 因此,直接提炼被污染的更正可能会强化错误的象征性更新。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议加强学习,在政策上采用可视化的自我消化法,这是一种符合证据的范式,通过基于可视化证据的特殊象征性矫正,加强任务层面的RLVR监督。 我们用Visual-Attribution Gating(VAG)来即时分析这个范式,它利用从核查者获得的优势作为优化的锚地,并验证每个特权校正,而不是证据存在和证据降级的教师观点之间的对比。 通过只承认这种视觉对比所支持的校正方向,VAG保留了有视底的取向,同时抑制了不一致的残余. 跨越6个视觉推理基准的实验表明,VAG的绩效始终高于GPRO和OPSD方法,建立了新的最先进的平均性能.

articles.title: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
articles.content: Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VideoMaMa++:通过 Preserve- and-Refine Token 进行暂时一致的视频编导
articles.content_zh: 利用互联网规模预训的视频传播前科, 然而,这些扩散主干线的沉重计算限制了仅仅6到24帧的短块推断,所以即使是普通的视频也跨越了多块. 由于每个块都是独立于粗口罩取向而成的,因此现有方法无法保持分块边界的一致性,产生闪烁的边缘和不连续的透明度。 我们以基于两个想法的口罩制导传播配对框架来解决这一问题。 RGB和口罩的调制被作为单独的符号流来表示,通过完整的斯皮提奥-时空自觉来相互作用,让模型适应性地将精细的RGB纹理与粗口罩布局相融合,而不是致力于固定的通道相融合. 除此之外,我们提出一对新颖的可学习嵌入物、保存的活物和精细的活物,作为每个框架的调节界面,并促成一个滑动的窗口推论方案,通过这个方案将已经生成的活物传播到分块边界,以达到局部时间一致性,并辅之以每个块的全球共享基准锚,以防止在不经过任何额外训练的情况下在长序列中积累出错。 我们的框架在详细准确性和时间一致性方面都超过了以往的传播方法,

articles.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
articles.content: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Ropedia W0: 扩展 Loco 管理 具有人类经验的世界模型
articles.content_zh: 世界模式使体现的代理人能够预见到行动的后果,但是由于行动空间各异和多式联运监督有限,联合模拟不同表现形式的运动和操纵仍然具有挑战性。 我们介绍Ropedia W0, 这是第一个以自我为中心 游戏操控世界的基础模型, 覆盖了人类和机器人, 并有着不同的化身。 我们管理Xp-Data,包括10k小时以自负为中心的人类数据和3k小时机器人数据,并附有统一的多模式说明和系统质量控制. 统一的动能表现编码通过相机起姿和通过投影骨架进行操纵来进行运动,机器人骨架结合了特异性前动能和广泛的手动键点注释和校正. 我们还引入了Xp-Teleop,一个基于高品质的去克氏人造电动操作数据的长视离子操纵基准. 评估显示,在五个交叉表现基准( " DreamDojo " 、 " $0美元 " 、 " $-HOME " 、 " Xp-Teleop " 和 " AgiBot " )和以人为自负为中心、从零镜头推论到数镜头和完整数据培训的视频上,都取得了最新业绩。 扩大人类培训前数据可提高人和机器人评价的性能。 蒸馏后,我们的模型支持实时,分长的推出,允许活式VR交互. 在政策评价、基于模型的规划和世界行动模式方面的应用进一步表明该模式对体现的决策的效用。

articles.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
articles.content: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: InfiniDream: 开端相片现实主义 三维世界通过程序生成
articles.content_zh: 程序生成在合成数据生成和游戏开发中起关键作用,提供比静态网格表达更大的可控性,可编辑性和多样性. 然而,基于VLM的代码生成往往会产生相对简单的3D资产,而复杂的光现实主义程序系统则需要大量人工开发. 现有的由VLM指导的程序方法在很大程度上仍然受到预先定义的工厂和API的限制,限制了它们创造出新型资产的能力. 我们介绍了InfiniDream,这是一个由VLM驱动的框架,用于无限程序3D世界一代. 首先,我们提议象征性地限制资产生成,它利用现有的程序算法创造出新颖的、光现实主义的资产,同时保留编辑性和种子多样性。 其次,我们开发了从端到端的文字到世界的管道,将语义场景规划与定型Frustum-Guided Grid Plantation相结合,以构建具有精确对象放置,程序人口,和动画的大规模3D世界. 对100个物体和20个场景生成任务的广泛评价表明,四个感知度量的改进。 多样性分析、消化研究和人类偏好评价进一步验证了我们框架的有效性。 项目网页:https://y四川h.github.io/infinidream-page/

articles.title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
articles.content: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 漫威漫画:有脚本和故事板规划的忠实漫威动画代理框架
articles.content_zh: 将现有的漫画改编成始终忠于源头的连贯动画,是一项宝贵而具有挑战性的任务。 现有方法要么主要通过文字来访问漫画,失去其人物和艺术风格,要么直接将漫画页输入视频生成模型,这曲解了漫画的结构并产生了不正确的故事情节. 在本文中,我们提出"曼加2Animate",即一个多代理框架,将每个世代阶段都以源头曼加为基础. 我们把任务分解为两个中间代表,一个动画剧本和一个视觉故事板. 每一份陈述均由创作代理制作,并由一对编审代理对源面板进行审查。 我们在综合最后动画之前,将特定代表的选择和双重反馈加以调整,以逐步完善两者。 广泛的实验和用户研究表明,"曼加2"(Manga2Animate)制作的动画更忠实于出自"出自"漫画"(source manga),并比最先进的方法更一致地拍摄出相片. 项目网页:https://annchen.github.io/Manga2Animate/

articles.title: GenOlympiad: Benchmarking Frontier Image Models at Their Capability Boundaries
articles.content: Text-to-image models have made tremendous progress and can produce high-quality images. However, a question which would be asked in any other discipline is where the frontier models fall short. We introduce GenOlympiad, a benchmark which provides the most challenging text prompts from nine capability axes for stress-testing frontier text-to-image models. The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GenOlympiad: 以边界图像模型为基准衡量其能力边界
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像模型取得了巨大进步,能够产生出高质量的图像. 然而,在任何其他学科中都会问到的一个问题是前沿模式的不足之处。 我们引入了GenOlympiad,这个基准为压力测试前沿文本到图像模型提供了9个能力轴的最有挑战性的文本提示. 评估能力包括产生出大量物质,进行深层推理,确保硬体一致性,遵循复杂的规则等. 提示的设计使得即时对齐是可视性可核查的(例如计数),而不是依赖主观性(例如样式). 在此基础上,我们开发了一个自动评价框架,将快件分解为简单而难用的问题,对于大多数难用的问题,我们绘制帮助线,以证明准确的分级。 我们评价20+强文本对图像模型,包括纳诺香蕉Pro,GPT-Image-2.5,Seedream-5.0等. 我们报告说,即使是表现最佳的T2I模型(Nano Banana Pro)也只取得23.9分的严格分数,而GPT-6 Astra等编码模型的快速比分较高(但不是视觉取悦). 我们还从模型演变、与埃洛的分数一致以及基于基础的评估协议的有效性中得出了见解。 代码见https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad,项目网页见https://genolympiad.github.io/

articles.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
articles.content: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RSI的物理能力从何而来? 《LLM即时政策观察扩展法》
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们系统地调查了物理递减自我改进的机制,缩放行为,和概括. 我们引入了 PhysRSI-eval ,通过五轴度量法量化物理 RSI: 初试性能,效率,成功率,预算及改进从失败. 在固定互动预算下,对18项操纵任务评价了不同的VLM. 对实验结果的分析激发了物理巴雷尔假说:不同的能力可能制约不同部分的改进. 五轴度量衡还区分了公共基准平均值接近的系统,并显示高分无需提前或高效率地获得收益. 我们从两个角度研究观测尺度:从公共能力中预测VLM剂的相对性能,从早期物理反馈中预测后来的进展. 这些分析加在一起,会问一个代理人能有多快和多远改进。 此外,我们进行工作空间干预,然后分析所遗留的改进。 消除历史会减少后期的成功,被冻结的工作空间在不为人知的布局上仍然有用,三个交叉任务案例更早成功. 结果表明,针对具体地点的适应和可重复使用的经验可以共存。

articles.title: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
articles.content: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpecKCast:分光卡尔曼预测分泌加速
articles.content_zh: 扩散变压器(DiTs)实现了高真实度的图像和视频生成,但由于在许多去诺步骤中反复进行变压器评价,它们承受了巨大的推论成本. 地物缓存通过在取名步骤中重新使用地物来降低这一成本. 最近的预测方法通过推断特征来扩展这个想法来跳过步骤而不是再用. 然而,现有的预测方法可以推断出它们一致预测的特征,尽管这些特征的空间-频率组成部分在不同的去名阶段变化最大. 它们也忽略了不统一地否认进步,因此,相等的步相间隔可以对应非常不同的变化量. 随着更多步骤被跳过,这些不匹配会扩大预测错误,限制了可实现的加速. 我们提出SpecKCast,一种无训练方法,用来预测频率域的模型输出. SpecKCast对输出采用2D离散余弦变换(DCT),并用轻量级卡尔曼滤波器沿着由噪声表产生的波段特定时间坐标来跟踪每个系数. 滤波器跟踪每个系数的值和变化率,而变压器只有在滤波器的预测不确定性超过阈值时才会被评价. 关于FLUX.1-dev,Quen-Image,Wan2.1-14B,和HunyuanVideo的实验显示,斯佩克克卡斯特在加速和忠诚之间实现更好的取舍,比起现有的缓存和预测方法,达到最高6x加速,额外内存小于0.05 GiB.

articles.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
articles.content: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RefCraft:通过网络开发建立视觉-参考-参考-代理生成基准
articles.content_zh: 除了基本的工具使用和编码技能外,有效地将视觉参考纳入代理生成对于将AI代理应用于现实世界的生产力任务同样至关重要. 我们通过网页开发来研究这一关键能力,这是一个实用和易于评价的设定,在这一设定中,现有基准在很大程度上仍然是理想化的:它们通常侧重于重建视觉目标,或仅从文字指示中生成网页,忽略了从视觉实例发展起来的更常见工作流程。 具体地说,我们采用了RefCraft,这是一个由300个现实的多模式网页开发任务构成的基准,这些任务将自然语言说明和1至5个参考网页的截图结合起来。 代理人必须有选择地解释和利用这些参考文献,同时制作、视觉检查和反复改进其产出。 我们利用可独立核查的关键点和补充方案及自愿活动法官,评估由此产生的不限成员名额文物。 在9个前沿(M)LLMs中,最强的系统在100个中总得分只有52.12分,揭示出视觉参考条件的代理生成对于实用网页开发环境中的当前模型来说仍然是个巨大的挑战.

articles.title: Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer
articles.content: A geometric style learned from one family of shapes is typically applied to new shapes from the same family. We consider a more challenging setting: learning the geometric design language of a stylized Latin alphabet and applying it to new forms, from Greek glyphs to entirely different structures such as human poses. We introduce Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer, where the forms to which a learned geometric style can be applied are not restricted to the shape family in which that style was observed. This setting is deceptively challenging: the difficulty is not merely learning a style, but learning the style without learning the shape family in which it was observed. We represent target forms by structural sketches and disentangle structural adherence from style realization using a Geometry LoRA and a style-specific LoRA. Critically, open-form transfer requires the Geometry LoRA to be universal. To achieve this, we devise a geometry-enrichment strategy that constructs a large and purposefully diverse collection of synthetic structural sketches spanning a broad range of unfamiliar geometries. Our experiments and ablations demonstrate the importance of both disentanglement and this universal geometry prior, enabling geometric styles learned from glyphs, pictograms, and other shape families to be transferred to substantially different, unseen forms.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 打开格式几何样式传输
articles.content_zh: 从一系外形所学出的一种几何风格一般被应用到同一系出的新外形上. 我们认为一个更具有挑战性的环境:学习了拼接拉丁字母的几何设计语言,并将其应用于新形式,从希腊格言到人类姿势等完全不同的结构. 我们引入了 Open-Form 几何样式传输,其中可以应用有学过几何样式的窗体并不限于该样式所观察到的形状家族. 这种背景具有欺骗性的挑战性:困难不仅仅是学习一种风格,而是学习这种风格而不学习所观察到的外形家族. 我们通过结构素描来代表目标形式,并用几何LORA和特有风格的LORA从样式实现中分解出结构的坚持. 关键的是,开放形式转移需要几何LORA是通用的. 为了实现这一点,我们设计出一种几何浓缩战略,构建出大量和有目的地多样化的合成结构素描集,涵盖广泛的不熟悉的几何美图。 我们的实验和活化证明了分解和这种普世几何学在先的重要性,使得从格子、象形图和其他外形家族学到的几何学风格能够转移到截然不同的、无形的形式。

articles.title: Real-Time Radar Semantic and Panoptic Scene Understanding
articles.content: Robust scene understanding under varying environmental conditions is essential for safe autonomous driving. While cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather and poor lighting, Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) spinning radar provides dependable 360° perception at extended ranges with minimal compute cost. However, real-time FMCW radar scene understanding is challenging due to complex signal returns, limited temporal resolution, and scarce annotated datasets. We introduce StreamRPS, a novel framework for streaming FMCW radar panoptic segmentation, comprising an automated label-generation pipeline via LiDAR scene completion and a real-time streaming network for semantic and panoptic segmentation. Our encoder-decoder streaming architecture comprises a radar-specific hierarchical Transformer encoder and task-specific decoders for semantic or panoptic prediction. Our encoder introduces a stem to capture range-dependent signatures, anisotropic patch embeddings to preserve angular resolution, and axial polar attention to separately model the periodic azimuth and bounded range axes. We further introduce azimuth roll rotation augmentation to simulate ego-vehicle rotation during training. Comprehensive experiments on the SAX and BOREAS datasets validate both our auto-labeling methodology and streaming segmentation network against established baselines. We outperform the strongest baseline by at least 1.4pp while processing sectors at over 400 FPS in a 4-sector streaming setting. We additionally provide manual annotations for 100 SAX radar scans, enabling independent evaluation of the entire framework.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实时雷达语义学和泛光学场景理解
articles.content_zh: 在不同环境条件下对现场的牢固理解对于安全自主驾驶至关重要。 虽然相机和LiDAR在恶劣天气和灯光差的情况下会退化,但频率调制的连续-行走(FMCW)旋转雷达以最小的计算成本提供可信赖的360°感知力。 然而,由于信号返回复杂,时间分辨率有限,以及附加说明的数据集稀缺,实时FMCW雷达场景理解具有挑战性. 我们介绍了StreamRPS,这是流取FMCW雷达泛光分片的一个新框架,它包括一个通过LiDAR场景完成的自动标签生成管道和一个语义和泛光分片的实时流取网络。 我们的编码器-解码器流线架构包括一个雷达专用分级变形器编码器和任务专用解码器,用于语义或泛光学预测. 我们的编码器引入了一种干来捕捉依赖射程的签名,异同位素的补丁嵌入来保存角分辨率,轴极注意将周期方位角和边距的射程轴分别建模. 我们进一步采用方位角滚动旋转增强法,以模拟训练期间自已车辆自转。 SAX和BOREAS数据集的全面试验验证了我们的自动标签方法以及按既定基线进行分流的网络。 在4个区段的流线环境中,我们处理部门超过400个FPS时,我们至少比最强的基线高出1.4pp。 我们还为100个SAX雷达扫描提供人工说明,以便能够对整个框架进行独立评价。

articles.title: PICA-WAM: Visual Perturbation Invariance via Cross-Appearance Self-Alignment in World Action Models
articles.content: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future video and generate actions, yet remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations, i.e., changes in visual appearance that should not affect robot behavior. We identify a gap in conventional WAM training: video prediction encourages representations to preserve appearance information, while action generation does not explicitly enforce invariance to task-irrelevant appearance. Data augmentation exposes WAMs to such perturbations but does not require perturbed and nominal observations to produce consistent action representations, and alignment with external pretrained features does not guarantee the desired invariance. To address this gap, we propose PICA-WAM, a self-supervised training framework that casts perturbation invariance as an auxiliary cross-appearance self-alignment task for WAMs. An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher processes the nominal observation to provide a deeper-layer target, while the online WAM processes a perturbed observation and aligns its shallower-layer action representation to this target through a lightweight projection head. Across four strong WAMs evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and a real robot, PICA-WAM consistently improves robustness under visual perturbations, preserves nominal performance in simulation, and raises the real robot success rate. PICA-WAM further reduces the sensitivity of video features to task-irrelevant appearance and its propagation into actions, as shown by paired layer-wise diagnostics. Code: https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-release
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PICA-WAM:通过世界行动模式中的交叉援助自我调整而出现的视觉干扰
articles.content_zh: World Action Models(WAMS)联合预测了未来的视频并生成动作,然而仍然对任务无关的视觉扰动保持敏感,即视觉外观的变化不应影响机器人的行为. 我们找出了传统WAM培训中的一个缺口:视频预测鼓励表达来保存外观信息,而动作生成并没有明确强制对与任务无关外观的偏差. 数据扩增使WAM面临这种扰动,但不需要扰动和名义上的观测来产生一致的行动表示,与外部预先训练的特性相配合并不能保证所期望的无变化. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议PICA-WAM, 这是一种自我监督的培训框架,将扰动性变化作为WAM的辅助交叉出现自我调节任务. 一个指数移动-平均(EMA)的老师处理名义上的观察,以提供更深层的目标,而在线的WAM则处理扰动的观察,并通过一个轻量级的投影头来使其更浅层的动作表现与这个目标相配合. 在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus、E Bench和一个真正的机器人上评价了四个强大的WAM,PICA-WAM在视觉扰动下不断提高稳健性,保持模拟中的名义性能,并提高了真正的机器人成功率。 PICA-WAM进一步降低了视频功能对任务不相干外观的敏感性并传播到动作中,如配对分层诊断所示. 代码:https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-放行.

articles.title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
articles.content: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 州级世界模式: 执行规则,生成像素
articles.content_zh: 现有的世界模型可以从一个单一的图像中生成具有行动条件的视频. 许多人关注相机移动,让用户探索所生成的场景. 然而,如果一项行动的结果取决于当前框架中看不见的状态,单靠导航并不能确保它遵循持续的规则。 将世界进化与视频渲染分开, 它根据特定规则维持一个不断演变的世界状态,使每个由此而来的事件都使用被冻结的视频模型,并利用所生成的剪辑来更新世界状态以进行下个转弯. 在每转弯时,被拉带会解决用户所选择的动作,并将所得出的事件编译为指令,而可编辑的3D场景的预览片段则提供空间和相机指导. 为了评价遵守规则的情况,我们建立了世界邦-奔驰,这是50个反事实双对的基准,它们共享一个初始框架和行动,但在隐藏状态和所需结果方面却有所不同。 在"只规则"的提示下,11个被评价的视频后端中最优秀的在32%的对子中为两种情况产生所需的结局. 对于"MiniMax-H3",具体说明需要的收尾将这个收尾率从32%提高到了64%,而用同一种被冷冻的型号,全吊带达到92%. 这些结果支持将规则执行与视频渲染分开,用于与隐藏状态的世界互动.

articles.title: What Language Adds, and at What Cost: Four Controlled Probes of Pathology Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision--language models (VLMs) promise to make computational pathology queryable and able to draft reports, but how much language adds beyond the vision backbone is unclear, because almost every system is evaluated by its developers on test sets of their own choosing. We grade published evidence by how it was produced and test four claims with controlled probes that reuse released checkpoints and public data, varying one input at a time. Report text adds prognostic signal: adding a frozen embedding of the stage-redacted report to a slide embedding raises the pooled C-index by 0.019 for progression-free interval and by 0.016 for overall survival across 1{,}633 TCGA patients, and restoring the stage statement adds nothing. Prompts add no measurable accuracy at inference: with features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification is statistically indistinguishable from a supervised linear probe for lung and renal cancer subtyping. Slide-level question answering is barely grounded: SlideChat answers 74.82\% of SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) items correctly with the slide and 74.41\% without it, whereas its language backbone alone reaches 43.52\%. Paraphrasing leaves accuracy unchanged but flips 8--23\% of answers. Self-reported gains from agentic navigation and few-shot language priors cannot yet be attributed to language. Language thus adds real but narrow value, and we propose minimum controls that would expose these failure modes in future evaluations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言加法,成本:4个病理学可控检测-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)承诺使计算病理可查询并能够起草报告,但是除了视觉主干之外,有多少语言添加的内容还不清楚,因为几乎每个系统都由开发者在自己选择的测试集上评价. 我们对公布的证据进行分级,按其制作方式分列,并用可控制的探测器检验4项索赔,这些探测器重新利用了检查站和公共数据,每次输入一次。 报告文本增加了预想信号:在幻灯片嵌入中添加被冻结的相接报告嵌入,使集合的C-指数上升0.019,无相接间隔上升0.016,1{,}633个TCGA患者总体存活上升0.016,恢复相接状态语句没有任何增加. 提示在推论上没有增加可测量的准确性:如果特征和集合固定,零发分级在统计上与受监督的肺癌和肾癌分型线性探针是无法区分的。 幻灯片关卡问题答案几乎没有被禁入: 幻灯片 恰克回答74.82 QQA(TCGA)项目的滑行本克-VQA(TCGA)项目与滑行本正确,74.41QQ没有滑行本克,而单是其语言主干就达到 43.52Q. 校对:Soup 自报从代理导航得到的收益和少有shot语言前传还不能归结于语言. 因此,语言增加了实际但狭隘的价值,我们提出最低限度的控制措施,在今后的评估中揭露这些失败模式。

articles.title: Mise-en-Video: Fine-Grained 3D Control for Multi-Shot Video Generation
articles.content: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity single-shot synthesis, yet practical storytelling creation requires multi-shot videos with both strong inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability. Existing multi-shot video generation approaches achieve strong consistency but still fall short in controllability. In this paper, we propose Mise-en-Video (MeV), a highly controllable multi-shot video generation framework that allows video creators to conduct staging the multi-shot in the 3D space and then generate the corresponding multi-shot video. To achieve this, our framework combines a hierarchical attention mechanism for multi-level narrative consistency with 3D-aware layout guidance for precise, per-shot spatial control. To support training and evaluation, we develop standardized annotation pipelines and construct a 160K-video dataset with hierarchical multi-shot texts and oriented 3D bounding boxes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeV consistently outperforms strong baselines in video quality, inter-shot consistency, and subject-level controllability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 雾入影道: 多热视频生成的精致3D控制
articles.content_zh: 最近从文本到视频生成的进步使得能进行高真实度的单发合成,然而实用的故事创作需要多发视频,既具有强烈的相接一致性,也具有精细的可控性. 现有的多镜头视频生成方法具有很强的一致性,但控制能力仍然不足。 在本文中,我们提出Mise-en-Video(MeV),这是一个高度可控多镜头视频生成框架,它允许视频创作者在3D空间进行多镜头的中传,然后生成相应的多镜头视频. 为了实现这一点,我们的框架将多层次叙事一致性的分级关注机制与3D-意识布局指导相结合,用于精确,每发空间控制. 为了支持培训和评价,我们开发了标准化的注解管道,并建造了一个160K-视频数据集,其中包含分级多镜头文本和取向的3D边框. 广泛的实验表明,MeV在视频质量、相机相通性和主题层面可控性方面一贯超过强基线。

articles.title: V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos
articles.content: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: V-JEPA(美国) 手: 简单、准确和快 三维手相机和相机轨迹回收
articles.content_zh: 爱高中心视频支持多种应用,包括机器人学习,增强现实,以及人类活动理解等. 从这种视频中恢复度量的3D手轨需要估计手动和相机自负,以便在一致的参考框中表达手. 许多已存在的管线分不同阶段恢复了手动和相机运动,结合了手相探测,手相重建,相机跟踪,并改进了轨迹. 我们介绍V-JEPA Hand, 一个简单的向导视频模型, 它使用自控的V-JEPA 2.1编码器从全帧视频中提取出斯皮提奥-时态特征,并使用基于查询的预测器将这些特征解码为每个帧的手姿,手相和相机运动. 我们利用预想相机运动,在共同的世界框架里表达出手的轨迹. 该模型接受已知的焦距,或在不可用时预测. 它在单个前传中重建出每个片段. 我们训练两个组件 最终在一个单一的阶段结束 在混合 不同的伪标签视频和高精度 3D说明。 单一模型在ARCTIC、HOT3D和EgoStandard的可比较基线中实现了覆盖率最低的每联合位置平均误差(MPJPE)。 它还产生比比较的基于SLAM的管道更低的世界范围轨迹误差. 规定支持视频预训、时间背景和混合监督的好处。 V-JEPA(美国) Hand在单个RTX A6000上实现93.4 FPS的先行通量. 项目页面:https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.

articles.title: Beyond Omni: A Unified MLLM for Embodied Sensory Understanding
articles.content: Recent embodied systems increasingly build on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for their pretrained understanding and reasoning capabilities, but their perception of the physical world remains largely limited to basic modalities such as vision and audio. However, broadening MLLMs to more diverse sensory modalities from the physical environment is challenging: their representations are often weakly connected to the MLLM and vary substantially in structure and statistics, while their interpretation still requires shared high-level understanding and reasoning. We therefore propose Unisense, a unified embodied MLLM framework that supports diverse physical sensory modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. Unisense follows a two-stage training process: (i) aligning sensory representations with language to establish a language-accessible interface; and (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the shared LLM to provide specialized processing for different sensory modalities. To support broad sensory learning, we curate Unisense-1M, a large-scale embodied sensory training corpus comprising 1M samples across 8 sensory modalities. We further evaluate Unisense on 12 benchmarks spanning depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell understanding. Across these heterogeneous sensing tasks, Unisense achieves strong performance and outperforms both generalist and specialized models on most benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of pretrained MLLMs as unified models for embodied sensory understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越Omni:促进体能理解的统一MLLM
articles.content_zh: 最近体现的系统越来越多地以多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)为基础,使其具备事先经过培训的理解和推理能力,但它们对物理世界的看法在很大程度上仍局限于视觉和音频等基本模式。 然而,将MLLMs扩大到来自物理环境的更多样化的感官模式具有挑战性:其表达方式往往与MLLM联系薄弱,在结构和统计上差异很大,而其解释仍需要共同的高层理解和推理. 因此,我们提出Unisense,这是一个统一的、包含的MLLM框架,在共同的多模式结构中支持各种物理感官模式。 Unisense遵循两阶段培训流程:(一)使感官表达方式与语言相配合,以建立语言可访问的界面;(二)在共享LLM范围内调换模式特定专家,为不同的感官模式提供专业处理. 为了支持广泛的感知学习,我们管理Unisense-1M,这是一个由8个感知模式的1M个样本组成的大规模内含的感知训练体. 我们进一步评估Unisense在深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热能、雷达、运动和嗅觉理解等12个基准上的情况。 在这些多种多样的感知任务中,Unisense在大多数基准上都取得了强大的性能并超越了通论模型和专门模型,显示出预先训练的MLLMs作为体现感觉理解的统一模型的潜力.

articles.title: CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing
articles.content: Reinforcement learning for instruction-guided image editing requires reward models that provide reliable, accurate, and efficient feedback. Direct scalar prediction compresses multidimensional editing preferences, whereas generative evaluators can expose their judgment through explicit reasoning. However, broad scoring criteria do not specify all instance-dependent editing and preservation constraints, and generating long reasoning trajectories is costly for online optimization. We introduce CheckDistill, a pointwise reward modeling framework that internalizes instruction-adaptive checklists. We decompose each editing condition into atomic, independently verifiable requirements and construct four-dimensional scoring labels together with structured verification evidence. After supervised score initialization, a privileged teacher conditions on checklists, item-level judgments, and dimension-level rationales to supervise the student's own scoring trajectories. A reliability-weighted on-policy self-distillation objective adjusts supervision at score tokens according to agreement between the teacher's expected scores and reference labels, while retaining candidate probability weights in a truncated token support. The deployed student directly predicts four score distributions without checklist inputs or explicit reasoning and aggregates their expectations into a scalar reward. CheckDistill achieves aggregate accuracies of 72.30%, 56.67% and 82.90% on MMRB2, MER-Bench and EditReward-Bench, respectively, exceeding the compared open-source baselines on all three metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CheckDistill: 图像编辑中用于高效分配奖励模型的可调用检查列表Distillation
articles.content_zh: 加强教学指导图像编辑的学习需要提供可靠、准确和高效反馈的奖励模式。 直接的scalar预测压缩了多维编辑偏好,而基因评价者可以通过明确的推理来暴露他们的判断. 然而,广泛的评分标准并未具体指明所有依实例进行的编辑和保存限制,而产生长推理轨迹对于网上优化来说成本高昂. 我们引入了CheckDistill,一个有分寸的奖赏模型框架,将指令调整清单内部化. 我们把每个编辑条件分解成原子,独立可核查的要求,并结合结构化的核查证据构建出四维分数标签. 监督分数初始化后,教师在核对表,项目级判断和维度级原理上享有特权条件,以监督学生自己的分数轨迹. 可靠性加权的政策自消化目标根据教师预期分数与参考分数之间的协议,调整分数符上的监督,同时将候选人概率分数保留在短符号支持中. 被部署的学生直接预测4个分数分布,没有核对表输入或明确推理,并将其期望汇总为分数奖励. 在MMRB2、MER-Bench和Edit-Reward-Bench上,CheckDistill分别实现72.30%、56.67%和82.90%的总加速率,超过了所有三个指标的开源基线。

articles.title: CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation
articles.content: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CAVA:辅助标签-智能数据估价
articles.content_zh: 辅助- 标签学习( CLL) 从一个实例不属于的类别命名的标签中培训一个分类器 。 这种标签从人群工或视觉语言模型(VLMs)中收集起来是便宜的,使得这些标签对大规模的注释具有吸引力. 然而,这两个来源都可能错误地将真类指定为互补标签. 这种注释错误在CLL中特别有害,因为模型被明确训练来压制正确的答案. 优化迁移(OT)数据估值通过将培训数据与干净的验证集进行比较来识别有害样本,但直接转移到CLL会形成语义错配:标签为$c$指的不是在训练中课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课上课 我们显示,这让OT标签组 吵闹的混合物 其行为取决于噪音率。 转出分数仅以足够高的噪音提供信息,按1美元/M$的交叉率变为无信息,并倒向下方,实际的CLL注释一般在其中操作. 我们建议采用 " CAVA " 方法,采用补充标签成本和标签比值,将每个补充标签对运输潜力的贡献隔离开来。 边距保持了对噪声速率的一致方向,以封闭式精度的无参数阈值检测出对角噪声,并允许被检测出样品被回收作为普通-标签监督. 在合成基准和人为基准方面,CAVA将直接转移的OT估值表现比随机更糟糕的对角噪声几乎完美地分开。 由于只有一小部分的清洁验证数据,它也改进了我们评价的每个CLL目标,表明一旦对互补监督的语义进行明确的模型化,基于OT的估值变得可靠.

articles.title: PlanarCityLoc: Breaking Silhouette Ambiguity in LoD Aerial Localization via 3D Planes
articles.content: Aerial visual localization is crucial for autonomous drone navigation in urban environments where GNSS signals are often degraded. Lightweight textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a geometric map alternative to textured assets. Existing silhouette-based methods rely on image-space alignment, which can leave different camera poses indistinguishable and favor incorrect poses when segmentation errors distort the building outlines. We present PlanarCityLoc, which moves beyond silhouette overlap by leveraging the planar geometry of building facades and roofs. Following geometry-aware initialization, we match image-side planar patches to LoD model planes and use the resulting 3D-to-2D correspondences to refine pose with Perspective-n-Point (PnP). The framework uses off-the-shelf geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 achieve state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods. By grounding image-space alignment in 3D planes, PlanarCityLoc enables more accurate aerial localization with lightweight, textureless city maps.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PlanarCityLoc:通过三维平面在LOD空域化中断开相机
articles.content_zh: 在全球导航卫星系统信号往往退化的城市环境中,空中视像本地化对于自主无人机导航至关重要。 轻量级无纹理级(LOD)城市模型提供了一种几何地图替代有纹理资产. 现有的以 silhouette 为主的方法依赖于图像-空间对齐,它可以让不同的相机在分区错误扭曲建筑轮廓时呈现出无法分辨和偏好不正确的相机. 我们介绍PlanarCityLoc,它通过利用建筑外观和屋顶的平面几何来超越了平面重叠。 在几何感知初始化后,我们将图像侧平面补丁与LoD模型平面相匹配,并使用所生成的3D到2D对应来精炼出Perspect-n-Point(PnP)的姿势. 框架采用现成的几何和分块模型,不进行数据集特定训练或微调. 关于UAVD4L-LoDv2和Swiss-EPFLv2的实验,在被评价的现成LoD方法中实现了最先进的本地化召回. PlanarCityLoc通过在3D平面上对地进行图像-空间对接,使得航空定位更加精确,并配有轻量级,无纹理的城市地图.

articles.title: A Flexible ROI Analysis Tool for Spatially Consistent Vegetation Index Extraction from Turfgrass Imagery
articles.content: Time-series multispectral imaging is widely used to assess turfgrass condition; however, extracting plot-level vegetation index (VI) values remains labor-intensive when camera positions vary between acquisitions and automated plot tracking is unreliable. We developed an open-source software tool comprising (i) a graphical user interface (GUI) for the interactive placement of orientation-adjustable regions of interest (ROIs) with $N$-way subdivision to match plot geometry and (ii) a batch-processing script that computes plot-level mean VI values from single-band floating-point rasters and exports measurements and ROI coordinates in JSON format for reuse. Saved coordinates can be reapplied to measure NDVI, NDRE, and SAVI from identical pixel regions within a single time point without re-delineating ROIs. In a demonstration using rail-mounted multispectral turfgrass imagery (18 images), plot-level mean values were extracted in a single session, with coordinates reused directly for NDRE and SAVI rasters. The system reads non-georeferenced pixel-coordinate rasters natively, does not require GIS expertise, and supports reproducible VI quantification where static sensor deployment is impractical.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从图尔夫格拉斯图像中提取空间一致性植被指数的灵活ROI分析工具
articles.content_zh: 时间序列多光谱成像被广泛用于评估草地状况;然而,当购买之间相机位置不同而自动地块跟踪不可靠时,提取地块水平植被指数(VI)值仍为劳动密集型. 我们开发了一个开源软件工具,包括(一) 一个图形用户界面(GUI),用于将取向调整感兴趣的区域(ROI)与美元行走分区交互放置,以匹配地块几何;(二) 一个批处理脚本,从单波段浮点光栅计算地块平面值VI,以JSON格式输出测量值和ROI坐标,供再利用。 所保存的坐标可以在单个时间点内从相同的像素区域重新应用来测量NDVI,NDRE和SAVI,而无需重新划定ROI. 在利用铁路上多光谱草地图象(18个图象)的演示中,在单场中提取出地平面平均值,坐标直接再用于NDRE和SAVI光栅. 系统在本土上读取了非地理参照的像素坐标光栅,不需要GIS专业知识,在静态传感器部署不切实际的情况下,支持可再生VI量化.

articles.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
articles.content: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PV Bench:用物体级物理测量方法量化视频生成中的物理可视性
articles.content_zh: 近期的视频生成模型产生了视觉上令人信服的产出,但其物理可信度仍然测量不足。 物理上的合理性询问所生成的物体是否遵守了几何学,动能学,动力学,和保护法. 现有的基准依赖于粗糙的视觉语言模型判断或目标,而不是视频生成本身。 我们采用PV Bench这一物理视频基准,从数量上衡量46个维度生成的视频的可信度,这些视频分为7个领域:(一) 教学和语义忠诚,(二) 行为和因果一致性,(三) 认知和时间质量,(四) 几何和空间一致性,(五) 物质属性和场地状态,(六) 动能和瞬息性持久性,(七) 机械功能与保护法。 PV Bench由600个精心设计的提示器组成,其中30%涉及机器人武器、人造物、四面体和多面体系统等物理内含剂。 对于具有挑战性的物理可牵引维度,它与专门视觉模型相配,这些模型得出可核查的、以物理为基础的测量结果,如物体6D级外观、度量尺度、地表常态、动能和数值保护法残基等。 因此,它避免仅仅依靠主观的分数,同时支持文本到视频和图像到视频的生成. 最后,我们确认自动衡量标准与通过人类评价作出人类判断之间的一致。 同时,我们评价主流开放源代码和封闭源代码模型,并提出若干见解。 通过发布基准、提示和校准协议,我们的目标是促进基于实体的视频生成。

articles.title: Foundation Model Driven Optical Flow
articles.content: We investigate how frozen pretrained visual and depth representations support dense optical flow when coupled with a supervised matching network. Building on TTSFlow, this paper studies Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) feature decoding and one coarse-to-fine refinement stage. Our method fuses features from frozen DINOv2 and Depth Anything V2 models and estimates optical flow through a trainable transformer-based matching pipeline. After optical-flow training on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings3D, it achieves 2.37 endpoint error (EPE) on the Sintel training split, Final pass, compared with 2.52 for the FlowSeek (T) configuration reported here. Our RoCo-Spring 2026 entry, RoCo-29.VSAI, obtains a robustness-balanced score of 1.1038, Spring EPE of 1.411, and RobustSpring proxy EPE of 4.739, with a lower balanced score than seven of the twelve listed reference baselines. These results characterize the complete pipeline, which reuses frozen foundation backbones and performs one refinement stage. Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/Visual-and-Spatial-AI-Lab/FFlow}
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基础模型驱动光学流
articles.content_zh: 我们调查了在结合一个有监督的匹配网络时,被冻结的先入为主的视觉和深度表现如何支持密集的光学流动。 本文以TTSFlow为基础,研究了Dense President Transformer(DPT)特征解码和一粗到精细的完善阶段. 我们的方法从被冻结的DINOv2和深度Anything V2模型中导出特性,并估计出光学流经可发式变压器相配管. 在飞行会长和飞行Things3D的光学流线训练后,在Sintel训练分出"最终通"上实现了2.37个端点出错(EPE),而本文所报告的"FlowSeek (T)"配置则达到了2.52个端点出错. 罗可春2026入场 罗可-29入场. VSAI,获得稳健平衡分数为1.1038分,春ESPE为1.411分,而RobustSpring代理ESE为4.739分,平衡分数低于所列出的12个参考基线中的7个. 这些成果是整个管道的特点,它重新使用被冻结的地基骨干,并进行一个改进阶段。 代码见:\url{https://github.com/Visual-and-Spatial-AI-Lab/FFlow}

articles.title: BrushOff: Stroke-Based Re-rendering as a Watermark Removal Attack on Painting
articles.content: Invisible watermarks are used to mark who owns a painting. We show that a simple attack removes the most robust one we test. The attack redraws the watermarked painting with brush strokes, using a pretrained stroke-based renderer. We call this attack BrushOff. It needs no training, no knowledge of the watermark, and no generative model. We test four watermarks on 500 paintings from five styles. VINE, a recent watermark built to survive image editing, survives all 14 conventional distortions we test, with at least 97.8% detection. Repainting lowers its detection to 1.8%, while the output keeps a no-reference quality score close to that of the clean paintings. Diffusion regeneration can also remove VINE, but at the same removal level it moves the image twice as far from the painting in DreamSim distance, and it changes what the painting shows. Because the renderer draws a countable number of strokes, we can control the attack strength step by step. Finally, we test what kind of signal survives. A simple probe that stores bits in the relative brightness of neighboring regions survives repainting, while a probe that uses absolute brightness does not. The same probe fails under diffusion regeneration, while VINE fails under repainting. Robustness to these two attacks is therefore a separate property, and benchmarks should test both.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BrushOff:以打出为取水标记的重击
articles.content_zh: 隐形水印用来标记谁拥有一幅画. 我们显示,简单的攻击 清除了我们测试的最强。 攻击用刷子来重绘水印画,使用被事先训练出以中风为主的渲染器. 我们称这次袭击为"BrushOff". 它不需要训练,不需要水印知识,不需要基因模型. 我们从五种风格的500幅画上测试出四个水印. VINE是最近为在图像编辑中幸存而建造的一款水印,它活过我们测试的所有14个常规扭曲,至少检测到97.8%. 重新油漆使其检测率降至1.8%,而输出时保持了与清版画相近的无参考质量分数. 分化再生也可以去除VINE,但在同一去除水平上,它能将图像从DreamSim相距的画作中移动到相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相 因为渲染器绘制出可计数的中风,我们可以一步一步地控制攻击强度. 最后,我们测试哪种信号能存活下来. 在相邻区域的相对亮度中存储比特的简单探测器能活下来再油漆,而使用绝对亮度的探测器则不会. 同样的探测器在扩散再生过程中失败,而VINE在再生过程中失败. 因此,这两起袭击的有力性是一个单独财产,基准应检验两者。

articles.title: From Short Clips to Real-Time Streams: Identity-Aware Supervision and Context-Efficient Generation for Video Face Swapping
articles.content: Video face swapping transfers the reference identity to a target video while preserving its other attributes and motion. Despite recent progress in reference-guided flow-based methods, jointly achieving faithful identity transfer, high fidelity, and real-time generation over long video streams remains challenging. To address this challenge, we rethink the task-specific structure of reference-guided video face swapping. First, face swapping changes only identity while preserving most visual content, yet flow-matching supervision is weakly sensitive to these changes. We therefore develop Joint Rec-ID Loss, which balances explicit identity supervision and latent reconstruction according to the noise level. Second, the target video already provides non-edited attributes and temporal dynamics, enabling generation with fewer spatial tokens and shorter temporal contexts through Face-RoI Generation and Short-Context Rollout Training. By integrating these designs, we propose StreamingSwap, a reference-guided flow-matching framework for real-time streaming video face swapping. We also introduce HumanFaceVid, comprising 1,000 hours of cinematic training data and evaluation sets of 200 short and 200 long videos. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive identity transfer and visual quality at 20 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with stable generation over videos up to 10 minutes long. Project webpage: https://aim-uofa.github.io/StreamingSwap/

articles.title_zh: 从短剪接到实时流:身份-智能监管和上下文-有效生成视频相接
articles.content_zh: 视频面相交换将参考身份转移给目标视频,同时保留其其他属性和运动. 尽管最近在基于参考指南的流程方法方面取得了进展,但联合实现忠实的身份转让、高度忠诚和在长视频流中实时生成仍然具有挑战性。 为了应对这一挑战,我们重新思考以参考为指南的视频脸相换的具体任务结构。 首先,面相互换只改变身份,同时保留了大多数可视内容,而流量相匹配的监管对这些变化的敏感度却很低. 因此,我们开发了联合Rec-ID损失(Rec-ID Loss),它根据噪音程度在明确的身份监督和潜在重建之间保持平衡。 其次,目标视频已经提供了非编辑属性和时间动态,通过Face-RoI Generation和短文本推出培训,能够生成较少的空间标志和较短的时间背景。 通过整合这些设计,我们提议StreamingSwap,作为实时流相视频相换的参考导流相配框架. 我们还推出HumanFaceVid,包括1 000小时的电影培训数据以及200个短视频和200个长视频的评价集。 实验证明,我们的方法在单NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上实现了20 FPS的竞争性身份传递和视觉质量,视频上的稳定生成可长达10分钟. 项目网页:https://aim-uofa.github.io/ StreamingSwap/

articles.title: CaptionFuse: Training-Free Composed Product Retrieval Via VLM Intent Captioning and Weighted Embedding Fusion
articles.content: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) retrieves products matching a reference image modified by natural language---a core capability for eCommerce search. Existing training-free methods fuse CLIP embeddings via arithmetic, but we identify a fundamental limitation: user text modifications are attribute-sparse---a user who types ``make it red with shorter sleeves'' specifies what to change but not what to keep (the floral pattern, the V-neck, the fit-and-flare silhouette). We introduce language-space fusion: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) jointly interprets the reference image and modification to generate a visually grounded product-title caption---e.g., ``Red floral fit-and-flare dress with short sleeves and V-neck''---that fills in the missing attributes from the image. Our method, CaptionFuse, requires no task-specific training and is model-agnostic. A controlled experiment confirms that attribute content--- not linguistic style---drives the gains: imperative and descriptive captions with identical attributes achieve equal R@10, while both outperform raw modifications by +6.5 points.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CaptionFuse: 训练-免费由产品构成的取回Va VLM 的入心说明和加权嵌入融合
articles.content_zh: 由编成的图像检索(CIR)检索出与由自然语言修改的参考图像相匹配的产品-- eCommerce搜索的核心能力. 现有无训练方法通过算术将 CLIP 嵌入式连接起来,但我们发现了一个根本的局限性:用户文本修改是属性-sparse---一个用户,用更短的袖子来打出"使它红"来指定要改变什么,而不是保留什么(植物图案,V-颈部,适和花纹 silhouette). 我们引入了语言空间聚变:一个视觉语言模型(VLM)联合诠释了参考图像和修改,以生成一个可视化的产品标题标题 -- -- 例如:"红花相配和花相配的外衣有短袖和V-neck'-"来填补图像中缺失的属性. 我们的方法,CaptionFuse,不需要特定任务的培训,并且是模型不可知的. 一个被控制的实验证实了属性内容 - - - 不是语言风格 - - - 驱动收益:具有相同属性的必备和描述性标题实现等同的R@10,而两者的性能都超过了以+6.5分的原始修改.

articles.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
articles.content: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpaceScout:VLM代理可以积极探索并映射出3D相片吗?.
articles.content_zh: 空间情报要求特工人员积极获取视觉证据,将观测纳入三维世界的一致代表. 然而,空间问题回答提供了有限的证据,说明模型是否能够通过自主探索构建准确的计量地图。 我们引入了SpaceScout,这是在活动对象级3D映射上评价视觉语言模型代理的基准. 空间 Scout包含80个不同的室内场景,包含有3,140个目标物体. 鉴于一个物体清单、RGB观测、相机校正和相机姿势,特工控制一个相机,以探索每个场景并在一个共享坐标框架内估计物体中心。 这项任务需要协调观点选择、交叉视图关联、几何估计和在限定的互动预算下对地图的修订。 评价通过对缺失预测进行惩罚的物体级重叠分数,共同衡量本地化准确度和目标覆盖度. 具有前沿VLM的实验揭示出实质性的局限性:最强的被评价模型克洛德·奥普斯·5.5,平均重叠得分为41.71%,47.23%的目标超过交叉结合(IoU)阈值为0.5,只有3.25%超过0.9. 这些结果表明,在恢复粗糙的物体布局和绘制完整、精确的平面图之间存在着很大差距。 SpaceScout为通过活性感知建立可靠的三维空间表示的开发剂提供了定量测试台. 代码见https://github.com/JesseZZZZZZ/SpatialScout。

articles.title: Dual-Scale Condition-Shift Editing for Robust Real-World Image Demoiréing
articles.content: Robust demoiréing of screen-recaptured images remains challenging: moiré varies in frequency, color, and spatial support across display-camera pairs and capture conditions. Dedicated restoration networks trained on finite paired data struggle with this diversity, especially when low-frequency color banding and high-frequency stripes co-occur. We present DemoiréEdit, a content-preserving editing framework that adapts the natural-image prior of a pretrained flow-matching editor to demoiréing. First, an endpoint-supervised training objective supplements velocity matching with pixel, perceptual, and frequency-domain restoration losses. Second, a dual-scale condition-shift strategy performs global correction at low resolution, then refines the image at full resolution by shifting the denoising condition from the first-stage output to the original input for detail recovery. We also introduce DailyMoiré130, a benchmark of challenging moiré in everyday screen photography, comprising 130 smartphone captures across diverse displays with low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference. On the challenging DailyMoiré130 benchmark, our method achieves the lowest residual moiré area and receives 71.3% overall-quality preference in a blind Best-of-7 study with 31 participants. We also evaluate on paired FHDMi/UHDM, reducing residual moiré confidence by 47.1%/9.3% and increasing MUSIQ by 4.3%/2.0% over the best baseline for each metric.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 强大的真实世界图像解析的双比例条件-隐藏编辑
articles.content_zh: 对屏幕恢复的图像进行强力降压仍然具有挑战性:Moiré在频率、颜色和空间支持方面在显示相机对和捕获条件方面各不相同。 受过有限对等数据培训的专用恢复网络与这种多样性相冲突,特别是在低频彩色带和高频条纹共同出现的情况下。 我们介绍DemoiréEdit,这是一个内容保存编辑框架,在经过预先训练的流量匹配编辑器被降级之前对自然图像进行调整。 首先,一个端点监督的培训目标补充了与像素,知觉相匹配的速度,以及频率域恢复损失. 其次,双相阶条件相变策略以低分辨率进行全局校正,再以全分辨率来改进图像,将去名条件从第一阶段输出转移到原始输入来进行细节回收. 我们还引入了DailyMoiré 130,这是在日常屏幕摄影中挑战moiré的基准,包括130个智能手机在各种显示器中捕获,并带有低频率的花色带,精细的高频条纹和混合频率干扰. 在挑战性的DailyMoiré130基准上,我们的方法实现了最低的剩余moiré地区,并在一项有31人参加的盲目的Best-7研究中获得71.3%的整体质量偏好。 我们还对配对的FHDMI/UHDM进行评估,将残留的moiré信任度减少47.1%/9.3%,将MUSIQ比每个度量的最佳基线增加4.3%/2.0%。

articles.title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
articles.content: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoXperience:从人类经验中学习世界全方位的Egocent代表
articles.content_zh: 从以自我为中心的视频中重建人类活动需要的不仅仅是恢复单个的3D组件:观察者的运动,周围几何,手-物体的相互作用必须在一个连贯的世界中相接. 实现这种一致性需要联合重建和协调一致的监督,但现有的方法和数据集对两者的支持都很有限。 我们提出“EgoXperience”,一种通过数据收集、自动注释、统一建模和基准制定满足这些需要的全方位范例。 EgoXperience的中心是自动注释引擎EgoX-Engine,夫妇用基于SLAM的世界对齐进行几何验证的物体跟踪,对相机,场景,手和物体产生一致的监督. 这产生了EgoX-Data-6M,这是一套50小时的由任务驱动的在室内外环境内外操纵和运动的数据集,带有二级任务说明. 我们仔细挑选一个小时来评估联合重建活动。 为了将这种监督转化为重建,我们引进了EgoX,经过了EgoX-Data-6M的培训,并增加了公共数据集的补充说明. 我们的模型实现了相机、场景、手和物体在共享世界坐标框中的联合计量重建, 广泛的实验表明,现场估算和世界空间手取物体的性能都达到了最新水平。 根据最强的评价基线,EgoX将相机,手和深度误差减少68.9%,65.6%和42.9%,并将对象的分数提高28.0%.

articles.title: Scaling Vision Foundation Models for Toxicologic Pathology
articles.content: Here, we present TOX-FM, a family of non-clinical PFMs trained on large-scale diverse histopathology datasets of over one million whole slide images consisting of over 60 organs across six animal species from over 14,000 toxicology studies across six decades. We introduce a comprehensive benchmark of 18 non-clinical downstream tasks, incorporate an established benchmark of 9 clinical downstream tasks, and evaluate TOX-FM against state-of-the-art clinical PFMs across both non-clinical and clinical domains. Notably, we explore open questions surrounding domain-specific training and cross-domain generalization, offering insights into the opportunities and challenges of applying PFMs in the non-clinical domain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 扩大毒理学展望基础模型c 病理学
articles.content_zh: 这里,我们介绍TOX-FM,一个非临床PFM的家族,经过培训,拥有超过一百万个完整的幻灯片图像的大规模多样化组织病理学数据集,由六类动物的60多个器官组成,来自六十年来14 000多起毒理学研究。 我们引入了18个非临床下游任务的综合基准,纳入9个临床下游任务的既定基准,对TOX-FM进行跨非临床和临床领域的最新临床PFM评价. 值得注意的是,我们探讨围绕特定领域培训和跨领域通用的开放问题,使人们深入了解在非临床领域应用PFM的机会和挑战。

articles.title: Drive2Gauss: FeedForward 4D Gaussian Reconstruction from Multimodal Generative Driving Videos
articles.content: Generating reusable driving environments requires both controllable future observations and an explicit representation that supports rendering from different viewpoints, yet existing methods still recover explicit scenes from generated RGB videos through optimization for each sequence. To overcome these limitations, we present Drive2Gauss, a feedforward framework that converts jointly generated RGB, metric depth, and dynamic flow into dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes. A Multimodal Video Generator predicts the three modalities from reference multiview images and future control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Gaussian Query Decoder that uses depth to initialize sparse 3D queries and flow to associate the queries across time, and integrates appearance information through spatiotemporal feature aggregation and iterative query refinement. The reconstruction stage operates in a single feedforward pass without optimization for each scene. Extensive results on nuScenes demonstrate that our approach attains an FID of 6.38 and an FVD of 12.43 for future RGB generation, a PSNR of 29.91 dB when reconstructing its generated observations, and supports both direct rendering under lateral camera shifts and downstream video fixing. Code and more visualizations are available at https://zttt04. github.io/Drive2Gauss_page/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Drive2Gauss: FeedForward (英语). 4D 高斯重建从多模式通用驱动视频
articles.content_zh: 生成可再使用的驱动环境,既需要可控的未来观测,也需要支持从不同角度进行渲染的明确表现,然而,现有的方法仍然通过优化每个序列,从生成的RGB视频中恢复出清晰的场景. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了Drive2Gauss,一种将联合生成的RGB,度量深度和动态流转换为动态4D高斯场景的向导框架. 一个多模式视频生成器从参考多视图图像和未来控制信号中预测出三种模式. 此外,我们引入了高斯查询器(Gaussian Query Decoder),它使用深度来初始化稀有的3D查询并流来将查询进行跨时间的关联,并且通过spatiotemporal特性聚合和迭代查询改进来整合外观信息. 重建阶段的运行方式是单向后传,没有为每个场景进行优化. nuScens的广泛结果表明,我们的方法为未来RGB一代提供了6.38的FID和12.43的FVD,在重建其生成的观测数据时提供了29.91分贝的PSNR,并且支持在平相相机转换下直接渲染和下游视频修复。 在https://zttt04上可以找到代码和更多的可视化。 github.io/Drive2Gauss_page/. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2011-12-21.

articles.title: DenseHap: Dense Hand Haptic Estimation from Monocular Images
articles.content: As dexterous robotic manipulation advances, scalable annotations of human hand-object interactions are becoming increasingly important. Furthermore, previous hand contact estimation methods suffered from issues such as dorsal-side misclassifications and insufficient precision, while lacking a unified framework for integrating multiple hand to environment interaction modalities, including distance fields, contact thresholds, and pressure. To address that, we present DenseHap, a unified end-to-end approach to estimate hand distance field recognition, comprehensive hand contact detection, hand pressure analysis, and hand reconstruction from a single monocular image. By incorporating three distinctly defined heads, along with a pretrained 3D reconstructed skeleton and an enhanced dataset, DenseHap outperforms previous state of the art models on four evaluation datasets, improving the F1 score by 8.5 percentage points (a 16% relative improvement) on untrained datasets and by 3 percentage points (5% relative improvement) on in-distribution datasets. Furthermore, DenseHap has effectively improved short-range hand estimate and pressure evaluation. Code and models will be publicly available upon the paper's acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DenseHap:由单相图推算的 DenseHaptic 估计
articles.content_zh: 随着可调和的机器人操纵的进步,可伸缩的人类手物相互作用说明变得越来越重要. 此外,以往的手接触估计方法存在诸如手侧分类错误和不够精确等问题,同时缺乏一个统一框架,将多手与环境互动模式相结合,包括距离领域、接触阈值和压力。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了DenseHap,一种统一的端到端方法,用来估计手相距场识别,全面的手相接触检测,手相压分析,以及手相重建从单一的单相相像. DenseHap在四个评价数据集上加入了三个明确定义的头,加上一个经过预先训练的3D重建骨架和一个增强的数据集,超越了以前的艺术模式,在未经过训练的数据集上提高了F1的8.5个百分点(相对改进了16%),在分配数据集上提高了3个百分点(相对改进了5%)。 此外,DenseHap还有效地改进了短距离手估计和压力评价。 守则和模型将在报章接受后公布。

articles.title: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
articles.content: World Action Models (WAMs) typically represent the world through latent embeddings from pretrained video models, which entangle heterogeneous aspects of the world, from how it looks (e.g., texture and color) to how it is physically configured (e.g., occupancy and pose). This raises an underexplored question: $\textbf{what should constitute the state of a WAM?}$ We argue that the world state should separate how the world appears from how the world evolves under action: the former captures semantic context, while the latter is governed by physical state. To this end, we propose $\textbf{PrismWAM}$, which decouples physics from semantics while jointly modeling state and action. PrismWAM factorizes an embodied task into a $\mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action}$ pipeline: given only the initial RGB observation, semantic planning learns to predict the final goal image, while physical rollout predicts the fine-grained evolution toward this goal in depth space; executable actions are then generated from the depth rollout. Without any embodied action pretraining or additional data augmentation, PrismWAM achieves strong manipulation performance in both simulation and the real world. Notably, PrismWAM even surpasses a broad range of models with large-scale embodied action pretraining (e.g., OpenWAM-$α$). More broadly, we reframe World Action Models from modeling how the world looks to how it responds to action, paving the way for action-centric world models grounded in occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and beyond.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PrismWAM:世界行动模式中国家代表的脱钩
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)通常通过预先训练的视频模型的潜在嵌入来代表世界,这些模型将世界的不同方面、世界的外观(例如纹理和颜色)以及世界的物理配置(例如占有和姿势)相缠绕在一起。 这引起了一个未充分探讨的问题:$\textbf{什么是WAM状态?}$ 我们主张,世界国家应该将世界的出现方式与行动下的世界演变方式分开:前者抓住语义背景,而后者则受物理状态所支配. 为此,我们提出$\textbf{PrismWAM}$, 将物理学与语义学脱钩,同时联合建模状态和行动. PrismWAM 将一个已包含的任务元素化为 $\ mathrm{Semantic\ 规划\ 右侧arrow\ mathrm{ 物理\ 推出\ 右侧arrow\ mathrm{ 可执行文件} Action}$ program:仅考虑到最初的RGB观测,语义规划学来预测最终目标图像,而物理推开则预测深度空间向这一目标方向的细微进化;然后从深度推出可执行动作. 在没有包含任何动作预训或附加数据增强的情况下,PrismWAM在模拟和现实世界中都实现了强大的操纵性能. 值得注意的是,棱晶水晶运动甚至超越了各种模型,并有大规模包含的动作预训(例如OpenWAM-$α美元)。 更广泛地说,我们把世界行动模式从模拟世界的展望转向如何对行动作出反应,为基于占用、流动、触觉感知、自主感知等以行动为中心的世界模式铺平道路。

articles.title: MRI Reconstruction Risk Estimation from Inference Dynamics
articles.content: Iterative MRI reconstructors produce intermediate estimates before returning a final image. We study these inference trajectories as a model-internal representation of realized reconstruction risk, measured by log-NMSE. Model-native states are projected to magnitude images, summarized by a fixed 16-dimensional descriptor, and mapped to risk using a source-trained ridge readout. Across three reconstruction backbones, trajectory features are strongly predictive of reconstruction risk on held-out source data. Under zero-shot target shift, their behavior is backbone-dependent, exhibiting both preserved positive association and readout reversal. Conditional analyses show that trajectory information can remain associated with error beyond an initialization-only predictor. A prefix analysis further shows that useful trajectory information can emerge before reconstruction completes. Repeated-mask and low-shot calibration studies indicate that trajectories primarily encode persistent case difficulty, while their orientation and calibration can change under domain shift.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 核磁共振 根据推论动态对重建风险所作的估计
articles.content_zh: 活性核磁共振重建器在还原出最终图像之前会产生中间估计. 我们研究这些推论轨迹,作为以对数NMSE衡量的已实现重建风险的内部模型。 模型-原生状态预测成比例图像,由固定的16维描述图加以归纳,并采用经源培训的山脊读取法绘制成风险图。 纵观三个重建主干线,轨迹特征对被搁置来源数据的重建风险有强烈的预测. 在零镜头目标转变下,他们的行为依赖骨干,既表现出保留了正联想,也显示出了读出倒转. 有条件的分析表明,轨迹信息可能仍然与超出初始化-仅能预测的误差有关. 前缀分析进一步表明,在重建完成之前,可以出现有用的轨迹信息. 重复的mask和低射校正研究显示,轨迹主要编码持续的案例难度,而它们的取向和校正可以在域移下改变.

articles.title: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
articles.content: Human egocentric experience offers a rich foundation for learning how the world is organized and how it changes through interaction. Realizing this potential at scale requires turning growing volumes of recordings into learning resources that connect scene structure, object semantics, and interaction histories across viewpoints and time, while reducing dependence on costly manual annotation. We introduce HOLI-WORLD, an integrated ecosystem connecting experience capture, world representation, automated data construction, model learning, and independent evaluation. To sup- port learning at scale, HOLIWORLD-Foundry combines complementary static and dynamic perception to automatically construct world records that connect persistent scene structure and evolving object states with interaction histories and supporting observations. HOLIWORLD-Data organizes these records from approximately 100 self-collected scenes into grounded learning resources, including approximately 80K QA pairs used to train HOLIWORLD-VL-4B. Independent human annotations of heldout recordings form HOLIWORLD-Bench, supporting evaluation of both annotation quality and learned spatial and temporal understanding. Experiments on ScanNet, ScanNet++, Aria Digital Twin, and HOLIWORLD-Bench demonstrate strong performance in static perception and dynamic tracking, while training on HOLIWORLD-Data substantially improves HOLIWORLD-VL-4B's spatial and temporal reasoning on HOLI- WORLD-Bench and EgoDynamic4D. HOLIWORLD provides a practical foundation for expanding learning resources from the continuous flow of human experience and advancing machine understanding of the dynamic world.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Holi-World:从人类 -- -- Ego经验中建立整体世界情报
articles.content_zh: 以人类自我为中心的经验为学习世界的组织方式和如何通过互动而改变提供了丰富的基础。 要大规模地认识到这一潜力,就必须将越来越多的录音转化为学习资源,将场景结构、物体语义和跨越观点和时间的互动历史联系起来,同时减少对昂贵的人工注释的依赖。 我们提出HOLI-WORLD,这是一个连接经验捕捉、世界代表性、自动数据构建、模型学习和独立评价的综合生态系统。 为了在规模上进行sup-port学习,HOLIWORLD-Foundry结合了互补的静态和动态感知,可以自动地构建世界记录,将持久的场景结构和正在演变的物体状态与相互作用的历史和辅助观测联系起来. HOLIWORLD-Data将这些记录从大约100个自收自收的场景整理成被禁的学习资源,包括用于训练HOLIWORLD-VL-4B的约80KQA对. HOLIWORLD-Bench对被扣录音的独立人类说明,支持对注释质量和所学空间与时间理解的评价。 在ScanNet,ScanNet++,Aria Digital Twin,和HOLIWORLD-Bench上的实验在静态感知和动态跟踪方面表现出了强大的性能,而HOLIWORLD-Data的训练则大大地改善了HOLI-World-Bench和EgoDynamic4D上的HOLIWORLD-VL-4B的空间和时间推理. HOLIWORLD为从人类经验的持续流动中扩大学习资源并推进机器对活生生世界的理解提供了实用的基础.

articles.title: Small Average Error, Wide Individual Error: General-Purpose LLMs Estimating Energy Intake from Meal Photos in a Feeding Trial
articles.content: Photo-based estimation of food energy could ease dietary assessment, and general-purpose multimodal large language models (LLMs) make such estimates easy to obtain. Most evaluations use one photo taken before eating and compare with energy served, while dietary assessment needs energy eaten.
