We evaluated six models from two vendors (Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5; GPT-6 luna, 6.1 sol and 6 astra) on 802 meals from ACETADA, a controlled feeding trial with weighed intake, with the before photo only, before and after photos in separate calls (subtraction), or both photos in one request. Three results ran against intuition. Subtraction under-estimated intake for five of six models, because the models still report hundreds of kilocalories for a nearly empty tray. Scaling the before-only estimate by the average share eaten (0.87) matched much of the gain from the after photo; beyond that constant, the second photo lowered meal-level error by only 2.2 to 3.4 points, mainly in meals with food left. With one photo, two models had a near-zero intake bias only because they under-estimated the served energy and ignored uneaten food. In ablations, adding the after photo improved accuracy under both prompt formats for five models, while prompt effects varied across models. Over 148 feeding days, three models kept the 90% confidence interval of their mean error within a pre-set 10% margin, but no model reached the pre-set 30% limits of agreement. Protein was under-estimated by every model, most in protein-dense meals; repeated calls changed error by at most 1.4 points; a high reasoning effort helped only the smallest model (4.2 points) and changed the others by less than 1 point. A low average bias is not evidence of accurate individual intake estimation; such estimates should support, not replace, assessment by a dietitian.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 小平均误差, 宽单个误差: 供餐试验中从食用相片中估计能量摄入的通用 LLMS
articles.content_zh: 基于照片的食品能估计可以方便饮食评估,而通用多式大型语言模型(LLMs)使得这种估计容易获得. 大多数评价使用食用前拍摄的一张照片,并与所提供的能量进行比较,而饮食评估需要食用能量。 我们从两个销售商(Claude Haiku、Sonnet和Opus 5.5;GPT-6 luna、6.1 sol和6 astra)评估了来自ACETADA的802份膳食的6个型号,这是一次量重摄取量的有控制的喂食试验,只有前相片、相片之前和相片之后的相片单独通话(分录),或者两种相片在一次请求中都有。 三个结果与直觉相反。 6个型号中的5个型号的减低估计摄入量,因为型号仍然报告有上百个千卡为一近空托盘. 用平均摄取份额(0.87)来放大先前的估计数,与后相片的大部分收益相符;除此常数外,第二相片仅将膳食水平误差降低了2.2至3.4分,主要是用剩饭的膳食。 用一张照片,两个模型的摄取偏差接近零,只是因为它们低估了服务能量,忽略了未食用的食物. 在模拟中,在五个模型的两种即时格式下增加照片后提高的准确性,同时各模型的即时效果各不相同。 超过148个喂食日,有3个型号将其平均误差的90%置信间隔保留在预设的10%的比分内,但没有一个型号达到预设的30%协议限制. 蛋白质被每个模型都低估了,大多数是在蛋白质-强化餐中;重复的呼叫在最多1.4分时改变了错误;高推理努力只帮助了最小的模型(4.2分)并改变了其他模型不到一分. 低平均偏差不能证明个人摄入量的准确估计;这种估计应支持而不是取代饮食学家的评估。

articles.title: Interpretable Face Contrast Modeling for Smartphone Portrait Rendering
articles.content: The quality of smartphone portrait photography has become increasingly important to both manufacturers and users. Recent devices use complex computational pipelines to improve facial rendering under varied lighting. These pipelines vary widely across manufacturers, so the same portrait can look noticeably different across smartphones. These differences affect multiple aspects of facial appearance, making perceptual preference difficult to characterize with a single measure. To address this, we propose an interpretable framework that decomposes face contrast into three components: overall facial tonal separation, eye-region contrast, and micro-contrast of fine skin details. We formulate dedicated metrics for each component and validate them via pairwise human judgments, demonstrating that our approach correlates more closely with human contrast perception than traditional contrast measures. To support this analysis, we introduce a realistic mannequin-based dataset designed for systematic facial contrast evaluation, comprising 508 full-resolution captures from 29 smartphones under diverse lighting, with region-specific masks and extensive pairwise perceptual annotations. As a downstream analysis, we show that combining the three component-wise metrics provides a meaningful basis for modeling balanced facial contrast preference in a controlled setting, and we present a preliminary evaluation on a smaller real-portrait dataset indicating that insights derived from the mannequin study can extend to real images. Our work provides a controlled first step toward defining and evaluating face contrast in portrait imaging.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于智能手机外观渲染的可解释相容模型
articles.content_zh: 智能手机肖像摄影的质量对制造商和用户都变得日益重要. 近期设备使用复杂的计算管道来改善不同照明下的脸部渲染. 这些管道在制造商之间差异很大,因此同样的肖像在智能手机之间可以看起来明显不同. 这些差异会影响面部外观的多方面,使得知觉偏好难以以单一度量法来定性. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个可解释的框架,将面部对比分解为三个部分:整体面部内脏分裂,眼-区域对比,以及细细的皮肤细节的微缩相接. 我们为每个组成部分制定专门的衡量标准,并通过对人判断加以验证,表明我们的方法与人类的对比感比传统的对比度衡量方法更为相关。 为了支持这一分析,我们引入了一套基于人脸的实事求是的数据集,用于系统进行面相对比评价,包括29个智能手机在多种照明下508个全分辨率捕获,并配有区域特异性口罩和广泛的双相感知说明. 作为下游的分析,我们显示,结合三个分量度,为在受控环境下模拟平衡面部对比偏好提供了有意义的基础,我们提出对更小的真相数据集的初步评价,表明从人造人研究中获得的洞察力可以延伸到真实图像. 我们的工作为在肖像成像中界定和评价相貌对比提供了有控制的第一步。

articles.title: PDNet: Exploring Pruning and Distillation for Real-Time Worker Activity Recognition in Industrial Assembly
articles.content: In this work, we address real-time fine-grained human activity recognition (HAR) in industrial assembly and introduce PDNet, a new framework that jointly exploits structured pruning and knowledge distillation for 3D convolutional networks. We start by training a 3D-CNN backbone in a supervised manner. Then, PDNet applies channel-wise structured pruning to obtain a more compact network. In the third step, our method is optimized using knowledge distillation from the large unpruned teacher to recover accuracy lost due to pruning. On the challenging MECCANO dataset with an X3D-M backbone, the pruned model without distillation reaches a Top-1 accuracy of 25.54 %, while PDNet raises this to 39.46 %, with only 6.90 MB model size and 3.78 GFLOPs. These results show that distillation within PDNet is highly effective in restoring pruned model performance and highlight its high potential for resource-constrained HAR in industrial assembly.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PDNet:探索在工业大会上对实时工人活动进行表彰的打磨和消沉
articles.content_zh: 在这项工作中,我们在工业组装中处理实时精细的人类活动识别(HAR),并引入了PDNet,这个新框架共同利用结构化的分泌和知识分馏为3D分化网络. 我们首先以监督的方式培训3D-CNN骨干。 然后,PDNet应用频道结构化的浏览来获得更紧凑的网络. 在第三步,我们的方法被优化了,利用了来自大而未被推倒的老师的知识分馏来恢复被推倒而失去的精度. 在具有X3D-M主干线的具有挑战性的MECCANO数据集上,未蒸馏的被碾磨过的模型达到Top-1精度25.54%,而PDNet则将其提升到39.46%,只有6.90 MB模型大小和3.78 GFLOP. 这些结果显示,PDNet内部的蒸馏在恢复被磨损的模型性能方面非常有效,并突出了其在工业组装方面对资源有限制的HAR的高度潜力.

articles.title: 3D Diffusion Models for Medical Imaging
articles.content: Generative deep learning methods such as Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks or Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable results in image synthesis. In particular, Diffusion Models have demonstrated superior image fidelity and sample diversity compared to other approaches on standard benchmarks, while also offering more flexible training dynamics as evidenced both in natural image domains and in medical applications. In medical imaging including Computed Tomography, Magnetic Resonance Imaging or Positron Emission Tomography, such models have various important use-cases including data augmentation, domain transfer, image reconstruction, inpainting, image augmentation and artifact correction. Further, generated images can be conditioned on patient characteristics, medical reports, segmentation masks or other images. Specific challenges arise due to the 3D volumetric nature of medical images, which translate to substantial demands in terms of memory, compute, and training data. This article provides a comparative overview of 3D Diffusion Models which have been developed for medical images, with a focus on current performance, limitations, and an outlook for future work.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 3D 医疗成像传播模型
articles.content_zh: 基因深层学习方法,如变相自编码器,变相自向网络或分流模型等,在图像合成上取得了显著成果. 特别是,与标准基准的其他方法相比,传播模型表现出了更高的图像忠诚度和样本多样性,同时也提供了更灵活的培训动态,这在自然图像领域和医疗应用中都有所证明。 在包括计算成像、磁共振成像或波西特隆出气成像在内的医学成像中,这种模型有各种重要的使用案例,包括数据增强、域传输、图像重建、油漆、图像增强和文物修正。 此外,生成的图像可以以病人特征、医疗报告、分片口罩或其他图像为条件。 医疗图像的3D体积性质产生了具体的挑战,这转化为记忆、计算和培训数据方面的大量需求。 文章对为医疗图像开发的三维扩散模型进行了比较概述,重点是当前性能、局限性和未来工作前景。

articles.title: YUTELA: A Scalable Edge Cloud AIoT System for Multi-Site Video Anomaly Detection with Scene Specific Adaptation
articles.content: Building upon our previous Ancilia framework, this work presents \emph{YUTELA}, an edge--server--cloud AIoT system for long-term, multi-site video anomaly detection. YUTELA replaces workstation-based on-site processing with NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge devices and redesigns the multi-camera pipeline through camera batching and redistribution, shared memory, reduced inter-stage data transfer, task integration, and TensorRT-accelerated inference. It maintains a separate anomaly model per camera, retrained on a centralized GPU server once enough recent pseudo-normal data are collected, with updated weights returned to the edge. With eight cameras, TensorRT increases throughput from 14.17 to 29.94 FPS under normal density, and the optimized edge node exceeds the throughput of the workstation-based Ancilia system in seven of nine workload settings, reaching up to 2.03 times its throughput at extreme density. This gain comes at the cost of higher latency under lighter loads with four or eight streams. YUTELA was then operated continuously for 170 hours at four public sites using 31 existing CCTV cameras. The deployment shows that runtime load is driven by scene activity and input frame rate rather than by camera count, and that retraining frequency varies by about three times across sites. The 101 automatically triggered training events occupied only about 6.6\% of a single GPU, indicating that one global node can support adaptation for tens of sites. Mean end-to-end alert latency ranged from 6.8 to 15.4~s depending on site traffic and anomaly type. These results show that YUTELA enables practical multi-camera edge processing with low-cost, camera-specific adaptation across heterogeneous sites.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: YUTELA:一个可伸缩的边缘云AIOT系统,用于多场视频异常检测,同时进行场景特定适应
articles.content_zh: 基于我们之前的Ancilia框架,本作呈现出\emph{YUTELA},一个用于长期多站视频异常探测的边缘-服务器-云层AIOT系统. YUTELA用NVIDIA Jetson取代基于工作站的现场处理 通过相机分批和再分配,共享内存,减少相机间数据传输,任务集成,以及TensorRT加速推论,托尔边缘装置并重新设计多相机管道. 它每台相机维持一个单独的异常模型,一旦收集足够近的伪常态数据,更新后重量返回到边缘,就会在集中式GPU服务器上进行再训练. 有了8个相机,TensorRT在正常密度下将吞吐量从14.17个增加到29.94个FPS,最优化的边缘节点超过基于工作站的Ancilia系统在7个工作量环境下的吞吐量,在极端密度下达到吞吐量的2.03倍. 这一增益的代价是,在有4个或8个溪流的较轻负载下,耐久性较高。 之后,YUTELA在四个公共站点连续运行了170小时,使用31台现有的闭路电视相机. 部署显示运行时间负载由场景活性和输入帧率所驱动,而不是由相机计数所驱动,再培训频率因不同站点而相差相差约3倍. 101自动触发的训练活动只占据了单一GPU的约6.6\%,这表明一个全球节点可以支持数十个站点的适应. 平均端到端警报延迟度从6.8到15.4~s不等,取决于站点流量和异常类型. 这些结果表明,YUTELA能够以低成本和相机特异性的不同地点进行实用的多相机边缘处理。

articles.title: Progressive multi-scale tumor-state memory for incomplete multimodal brain tumor segmentation
articles.content: Brain tumor segmentation uses complementary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences, but some sequences may be unavailable in practice. Their absence changes the information available for segmenting different tumor regions. Fusion methods can support different input subsets. However, fusion at several scales does not by itself specify how tumor evidence is retained and updated to guide fusion at later stages. We propose a progressive multi-scale tumor-state memory network (PMTM) for segmentation from any non-empty subset of T1ce, T1, FLAIR, and T2. PMTM maintains a compact state for the current subject across the encoder stages. At each stage, we use assignment maps to pool spatial features into ordered evidence vectors for each available modality. We average these vectors across the available modalities, and a learned gate combines this evidence with the previous state. The up- dated state guides residual fusion at that stage and is used in the state update at the next stage. A modality-token mixer also models interactions among the available modalities at each stage. We apply semantic supervision to the assignment maps at all four stages. We evaluate PMTM on BraTS2018, BraTS2020, and BraTS2023 GLI across all 15 non-empty modality subsets. Averaged over the three tumor regions and the 15 subsets, PMTM achieves Dice scores of 75.31%, 77.54%, and 80.47% on BraTS2018, BraTS2020, and BraTS2023 GLI, respectively. These scores are higher than those of RobustSeg, RFNet, and mmFormer in our experiments on each dataset. Component ablations and internal state analysis are performed on BraTS2020.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对不完整的多模式脑瘤分解进行渐进式多尺度肿瘤状态记忆
articles.content_zh: 脑瘤分化使用互补的磁共振成像(MRI)序列,但实际上有些序列可能无法使用. 它们的缺失改变了可用于分解不同肿瘤区域的信息。 融合法可以支持不同的输入子集. 然而,几个尺度的聚变本身并不说明肿瘤证据如何被保留和更新,以指导后期的聚变. 我们提议建立一个渐进式多尺度肿瘤状态记忆网络(PMTM),用于从T1ce,T1,FLAIR,和T2等非空子集分出. PMTM在整个编码器阶段为当前主体保持了紧凑状态. 在每一个阶段,我们使用任务地图,将空间特征汇集到每种可用方式的有序证据矢量中。 我们平均这些矢量跨越可用的模式,一个有学识的门将这个证据与以前的状态结合. 最新状态指导了该阶段的残留聚变,并在下一阶段的状态更新中使用. 一个模式键混合器还模拟每个阶段现有模式之间的相互作用。 我们对所有四个阶段的任务图实行语义学监督. BratS2018、BratS2020和BratS2023 GLI上所有15个非空模式子集的PMTM评价。 PMTM平均在3个肿瘤区域和15个子集中,在BratS2018,BratS2020和BratS2023GLI上分别取得了75.31%,77.54%和80.47%的Dice分数. 我们在每个数据集的实验中,这些分数都高于RobustSeg、RFNet和mmFormer。 BRATS2020进行了组件分解和内部状态分析。

articles.title: When Guidance Becomes a Guard: Early Interception of Unsafe Inputs in Text-to-Image Generation
articles.content: Text-to-image diffusion models can produce unsafe content, while output filtering intervenes only after synthesis. We investigate whether native generation signals enable early detection of unsafe and adversarial inputs. We find that classifier-free guidance exposes strong safety signals in conditional responses, accessible through compact statistics and linear readouts. Based on this finding, we propose Conditional Semantic Trajectory Interception (CSTI), which aggregates activation contrasts between conditional and unconditional responses at early checkpoints for calibrated risk detection. CSTI fits concept-specific detectors using canonical concept and safe examples, without attack samples, intermediate image decoding, or generator modification. Across five generators, four adversarial attack collections, and two general NSFW datasets, CSTI achieves the strongest overall performance among six baselines at a matched 5% FPR. Early interception reduces generation latency by over 60% on intercepted paths. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of native conditional responses for early safety interception.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当指导成为守护者时:对文本到图像生成中的不安全输入的早期拦截
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像传播模型可以产生不安全的内容,而输出过滤只有在合成后才能干预. 我们调查本地生成的信号是否能够及早发现不安全和对抗性的投入。 我们发现,无分类器指导在有条件的响应中暴露出强大的安全信号,通过紧凑的统计和线性读取可以访问. 基于这一调查结果,我们提出有条件的语义传导截取(CSTI),它汇总了在早期检查点对风险进行校准的有条件和无条件反应之间的激活对比. CSTI适合使用犬类概念和安全实例的概念特有探测器,没有攻击样本,中间图像解码,也没有发生器修改. 通过5个发电机、4个对抗式攻击收集器和2个NSFW一般数据集,CSTI在6个基线中取得了最强的总体性能,相对应的是5%的FPR。 早期截取在被截取的路径上将生成延迟降低60%以上. 这些结果显示,当地有条件的早期安全拦截对策是有效的。

articles.title: Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models
articles.content: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用递归语言模型的长式视频对文本摘要
articles.content_zh: 虽然VideoLLMs在理解短视频基准方面取得了显著进展,但它们往往难以总结长格式的基准。 这主要是由于长文提示引起的性能退化,保留时间连续性的固有困难,以及事件描述中缺乏精密丰富的概念. 为了解决这些问题,本文介绍了首个为视频处理而设计的递归视频语言总结模型(RVLSM),并针对长式视频到文本的总结. RVLSM递归地将视频分解成集成相通的片段并代表分块级推理到VideoLLM子模型和外部工具. 它采用(1)语义分解(STD),通过场景感知分解策略,按照语义边界动态地分出视频来保持时间的一致性和连续性;和(2)适应性多式工具调用(AMTC),通过有选择地引用动作识别、光学字符识别、自动语音识别和物体检测等辅助模块的路由机制,确保语义丰富的摘要。 在VideoXum和MixTyVSum基准上的实验显示,RVLSM在多个模型设置和性能度量度上持续改善于零镜头的VideoLLM基线,并具有先进精细的视频到文本汇总模型的竞争力. 重要的是,RVLSM摘要中被点名的实体与地面实况摘要中被测出的实体相比,与基线和最新方法被测出的实体更加一致,从而证实其生成的事件描述的显著性。

articles.title: Policy-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Spatial Reasoning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.content: Image-based spatial reasoning requires perception, decomposition, and inference, but the stage that limits accuracy can change during training. Answer-level rewards neither localize failures to individual stages nor provide discriminative group-relative feedback when all rollouts receive the same reward. Process supervision provides intermediate feedback, but fixed weights cannot adapt reward allocation to these changing bottlenecks. To address this gap, we propose CALIPER, an adaptive process-reward framework supported by SpatialTrace, a corpus of stage-decomposed spatial reasoning traces. CALIPER jointly estimates the associations between stage-wise reference coverage and answer correctness through within-group ridge regression, using these associations as utility proxies to gradually update reward weights. The resulting process reward supervises all rollout groups, including uniformly failing ones. Because utility estimates can become unreliable when answer-discriminative groups are scarce, a closed-loop harness monitors estimator reliability and validation performance to guide checkpoint rollback, rollout diversification, and early stopping. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks and three backbones show that CALIPER achieves the highest mean under both one-shot and harness training, with consistent gains over fixed allocation across RL optimizers. Further analyses confirm the benefits of adaptive reward allocation and harness control, with favorable scaling in model/data size.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有可核实报酬的空间理由的政策性信贷转让
articles.content_zh: 基于图像的空间推理需要感知,分解,和推想,但限制精度的阶段在训练中可以改变. 答题层面的奖励既未将失败到个别阶段的地方化,也未在所有推出阶段都得到同样的奖励时提供歧视性的团体相关反馈。 流程监督提供中间反馈,但固定的权重无法适应这些不断变化的瓶颈的奖励分配. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议利用空间跟踪这一适应性进程奖励框架,即一系列相位分解的空间推理痕迹。 CALIPER联合估计了阶段参考覆盖之间的关联,并通过组内山脊回归回答正确性,使用这些关联作为效用代用来逐渐更新奖励权重. 由此产生的奖励程序监督所有推出团体,包括完全失败的团体。 因为当回答-歧视群体稀缺时,公用估计可能变得不可靠,所以闭锁-放行控制带会监测估计器的可靠性和验证性能,以指导检查站的倒车,推出多样化,并及早停止. 跨越8个基准和3个主干线的广泛试验表明,CALIPER在一发制人和利用培训下实现了最高的中值,在RL优化者的固定分配上取得了一致的收益。 进一步的分析证实了适应性奖励分配和利用控制的好处,并有利于模型/数据规模的扩大。

articles.title: LaMER: Language-Conditioned Multi-Expert Routing for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
articles.content: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) localizes the image region described by a natural language expression, underpinning applications such as autonomous navigation, human-robot interaction, and medical image analysis. Under weak supervision, REC is challenged by the visual-linguistic semantic gap and the difficulty of inferring region-text correspondences from coarse image-level signals alone. Moreover, no single visual encoder captures all complementary properties---semantic alignment, fine-grained texture, and boundary awareness---while naively fusing multiple pretrained encoders yields heterogeneous, hard-to-reconcile representations. We propose LaMER, a weakly supervised REC framework that dynamically aggregates four frozen expert encoders through a language-conditioned Cross-Modal Routing Fusion module, adapting expert selection to each referring expression without instance-level bounding-box supervision. A Cell-Text Matching Head with Negative Anchor Augmentation, trained with a multi-objective loss combining contrastive, reconstruction, alignment, and load-balancing terms, further stabilizes optimization. LaMER achieves 77.67\%, 62.81\%, and 69.49\% Acc@IoU\(\geq 0.5\) on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg, surpassing DViN and WeakMCN by up to 16.49 and 14.49 points, with ablations validating each component.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LaMER:针对弱监督的参考表达理解语言的多专家程序
articles.content_zh: 参考表达理解(REC)将自然语言表达所描述的图像区域本地化,支持自主导航,人与机器人交互,医学图像分析等应用. 在薄弱的监管下,REC受到视觉-语言语义差距的挑战,以及仅从粗糙的图像级信号推断出区域-文本对应的难度. 此外,没有单一的视觉编码器能捕捉到所有互补的属性-语义对齐,精细的纹理和边界意识-同时天真地引信多发被预先训练的编码器,产生出多样的,难以调和的表示. 我们建议LaMER, 一个受弱监督的REC框架, 通过一个语言条件化的 Cross-Modal Routing Fusion 模块, 动态地聚合四个被冻结的专家编码器, 细胞-图案匹配头与负Anchor增强相匹配,经过多目标损失的训练,结合了对比性,重建,对接,和负载平衡等术语,进一步稳定了优化. LaMER在RefCOCO,RefCO+,和RefCOCOg上实现了77.67分,62.81分和69.49分,超过DViN和WowerMCN最高16.49分和14.49分,每个组件的分数都验证.

articles.title: One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution
articles.content: Document understanding is increasingly judged on where an answer comes from, scored against annotated gold locations as if each fact lived in one place. In long visual documents, a fact often lives in several places: a chart value is restated in the text, a key figure reappears in the summary. We ask how often such copies occur in standard benchmarks and what they do to evaluation. We annotate 420 questions from MMLongBench-Doc and MMDocRAG with the locations that independently establish each required fact, checked by two independent reviewers. Copies are common and often cross-modal: 19.5% of MMLongBench-Doc test questions have a strict copy outside the gold, and in 28% of MMDocRAG questions a non-gold candidate alone supplies a required fact. Single-gold scoring then fails in three predictable ways. A retriever that finds a copy is scored as a miss: page recall@1 of text and visual retrievers is underestimated by 13-24 points on questions with a cross-page copy. A model that cites a copy is scored as citing wrongly: crediting equivalent evidence reverses 11% of pairwise orderings among 65 competitive MMDocRAG systems. Masking the gold region leaves the fact available elsewhere: with a copy in the input, 41-56% of correct answers across four models survive it yet fail once every annotated instance is masked. Set-level masking with automatically found copies closes 78% of the gap to masking every annotated instance at matched granularity (three models); an unverified key-string rule lowers survival at least as far but masks three times the area. We release the annotations and redundancy-aware metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: One Fact,多处地方:长视文档中的冗余证据 突破单金评价检索、引用和归属
articles.content_zh: 对文件的理解越来越多地根据一个答案的出处来判断,根据注解的黄金地点得分,似乎每个事实都生活在一个地方。 在长相的文档中,一个事实往往存在于几个地方:一个图表值在文本中重现,一个关键数字在摘要中再现. 我们询问这些副本在标准基准中多久出现一次,以及它们对评价做了哪些工作。 我们将MMLong Bench-Doc和MMdocRAG的420个问题与独立确定每个所需事实的地点进行注释,由两名独立审查员检查。 拷贝是常见的,经常是交叉式的:19.5%的MMLong Bench-Doc测试题在黄金外有严格的拷贝;28%的MMDocRAG仅向非黄金候选人提问就提供需要的事实. 单金得分则以三种可预测的方式失败. 找到副本的检索器被评为失差: 文本和可视检索器的页面回放@1 在有跨页副本的问题上被低估了13至24分. 一个引用副本的模型被评为错误引用: 贷记等同证据在65个有竞争力的MMdocRAG系统中倒置了11%的对等订单. 掩盖黄金区留下了其他事实:在输入中附上副本后,4个模型中41-56%的正确答案幸存下来,但一旦每个注解实例被掩盖,就失败了。 自动发现副本的设置层遮罩关闭了78%的空白,以相匹配的颗粒性来遮盖每个注释实例(三个模型);一个未经验证的按键字符串规则至少会降低存活率,但遮盖面积为三倍. 我们发布说明 和冗余度量衡。

articles.title: From Legacy to Contemporary: Scalable Color Modernization for Long Video
articles.content: Bringing legacy video back to contemporary screens does not necessarily make it look contemporary. Earlier imaging pipelines often leave color casts, muted chroma, weak con- trast, and tonal imbalance, while correcting these character- istics still relies heavily on expert colorists and scales poorly to long, multi-shot videos. We formulate long video color modernization, a task that updates the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage while preserving scene content and coherence across frames and shots. We introduce a scalable, training-free framework that jointly modernizes grids of temporally adjacent keyframes using a pretrained text-guided image editing model, producing coherent con- temporary references without paired supervision. Compact shot-specific color transforms then propagate these adjust- ments throughout each shot, preserving spatial structure and temporal stability. We conduct a multidimensional evaluation on diverse legacy videos spanning five decades. We combine a human evaluation of perceived modernness with quantita- tive measures of content fidelity, temporal stability, percep- tual quality, and efficiency, and introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC) to assess grade co- herence across shots. On our evaluation set, our frame- work achieves the highest perceived modernness while re- maining competitive across complementary measures, open- ing a path toward the systematic study of long video color modernization. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwoomood/ Video_Color_Modernization.git
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从遗产到当代: 长视频可缩放色彩现代化
articles.content_zh: 将遗留的视频带回当代屏幕并不一定使其看起来是当代的. 更早的成像管往往会留下彩色铸造物,变弱的染色体,弱的凸起物和通体失衡,同时纠正这些性格-异端仍然严重地依赖于专家的取色器,而尺度差到长而多镜头的视频. 我们设计了长长的视频彩色现代化,这项任务更新了传统彩色镜头的花色和外观,同时保留了场景内容和跨帧和镜头的一致性. 我们采用一个可扩展的、无培训的框架,使用经过预先训练的文字指导图像编辑模型,共同使时间相邻的密钥框架网格现代化,在没有对等监督的情况下产生连贯的临时参考资料。 紧凑相片特定颜色的转换,然后将这些调整 -- -- 颗粒在整个相片中传播,保持空间结构和时间稳定性。 我们对长达50年的各种遗产录像进行多层面评价。 我们把对所感知的现代的人类评估与对内容的忠诚、时间稳定性、穿透性质量和效率的四分法结合起来,并引入SW-IGC(SW-IGC)的Source-Wighted Intershot Constitution(SW-IGC),以评估各镜头的等级共性。 在我们的一套评价中,我们的帧工作实现了最高的感知现代,同时重新主导各种互补措施的竞争,打开了一条系统研究长相相相色现代化的道路. 代码见https://github.com/jiwoomood/。 视频_颜色_现代化. git

articles.title: HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction
articles.content: Objective: Multimodal survival prediction jointly analyzes histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs), genomic profiles, and clinical variables to stratify patients by risk. However, existing approaches often inadequately account for granularity differences across modalities, particularly in spatial organization and feature dimensionality. To address these challenges, we propose HGASurv, which introduces a hierarchical WSI encoding module and a clinical-guided graph propagation module for granularity-aware multimodal integration. Methods: The hierarchical WSI encoding module maps WSI patch features onto a spatial grid using their original coordinates and applies parallel convolutions to construct representations at patch, local-neighborhood, and regional scales. Genomic signature embeddings then query these scale-specific WSI representations through cross-modal co-attention, producing signature-conditioned morphological features. The clinical-guided graph propagation module uses clinical variables to define patient-similarity edges and propagates fused image-genomic node embeddings with graph attention, integrating clinical information through topology rather than feature concatenation. Results: Across three TCGA cohorts, HGASurv achieved the strongest overall C-index performance, with ablation studies supporting the complementary contributions of the hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation modules. Conclusion and Significance: By introducing hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation, HGASurv unifies multi-scale pathology representation with topology-based clinical integration in a hierarchical granularity-aware framework. This design shows that matching representation and integration mechanisms to modality-specific granularity improves multimodal survival prediction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HGASurv: 分级的外观-智能集成,用于多式联运生存预测
articles.content_zh: 目标:多式联运生存预测联合分析组织病理学全滑图象(WSIs),基因组剖面和临床变量,以通过风险对患者进行分层. 然而,现有办法往往没有充分考虑到不同模式的颗粒性差异,特别是在空间组织和地貌维度方面。 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议HGASurv,其中引入一个分级的WSI编码模块和一个用于颗粒性-认知多模式结合的临床指导图表传播模块。 方法: 分级的WSI编码模块将WSI补丁特征用原始坐标映射到空间网格上,并应用平行的演化来构造补丁,局部-邻接,区域尺度的表示. 基因组特征嵌入后通过跨模式共意来查询这些比例特有WSI的表示,产生具有签名条件的形态特征. 临床导图传播模块使用临床变量来定义患者-同源性边缘并用图表注意力来传播被熔接的图像-基因组节点,通过地貌学而不是地貌结合来整合临床信息. 结果: 在三个TCGA组中,HGASurv取得了最强的整体C-index性能,同时进行扩展研究,支持分级WSI编码和临床指导图传播模块的补充贡献。 结论和意义:通过引入分级WSI编码和临床导图传播,HGASurv统一了多尺度病理表现,在分级颗粒性-知觉框架内以地貌临床结合. 这一设计表明,将代表性和一体化机制与特定模式的颗粒性相匹配可改善多式联运生存预测。

articles.title: TriScore: Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection with Energy, Boundary Probes, and Transform Consistency
articles.content: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detection usually relies on a single signal extracted from a frozen classifier, such as confidence, energy, features, or gradients. This dependence becomes fragile under classifier-level adversarial shift, where the shift can preserve the detector's chosen cue while changing the model's decision behavior. We investigate whether this failure mode can be mitigated by combining complementary detection criteria instead of selecting a single score. We introduce TriScore, a post-hoc OOD detector that combines three ID-calibrated signals from the same frozen backbone: an energy prior, a boundary-fragility score, and a transform-consistency score. These signals are standardized on ID validation data and fused by an input-dependent ID-residual gate, requiring no OOD labels, auxiliary model, training, or stored feature bank. Across four ImageNet-scale backbones, TriScore achieves the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines under a non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, while remaining competitive on standard OOD benchmarks. Ablations show that the gains come from combining complementary cues rather than optimizing a single detector signal. These results support multi-criterion post-hoc detection as a practical route toward more robust OOD detection under classifier-level shift. The source code is publicly available at github.com/gursoyege/TriScore.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 三分分分数: 利用能源探测、边界探测和变形一致性探测
articles.content_zh: 热出分流后检测通常依赖于从被冻结的分解器中提取出单个信号,如置信度,能量,特征等或梯度等. 这种依赖性在分类器级对抗性转变下会变得脆弱,这种转变可以在改变模型的决定行为的同时保留探测器所选择的提示. 我们调查这种故障模式是否可以通过合并补充检测标准而不是选择一个分数来缓解. 我们引入了TriScore,一种后Hoc OD探测器,它结合了来自同一被冻结的骨干上的三个ID校正信号:能量前置,边界弱点分,变相一致性分. 这些信号在ID验证数据上被标准化,并被一个依赖输入的ID-留守门接通,不需要OOD标签,辅助型号,训练,或存储的特征库. 在4个ImageNet规模的骨干中,TriScore在非适应性对抗-过渡协议下的15个Hoc后基线中实现了最佳平均AUROC,同时在标准OOD基准上保持竞争力. 膨胀表明,收益来自将互补的提示组合起来,而不是优化单一的探测器信号. 这些结果支持了多克后分解检测,作为在分解器级移位下更强的OD检测的实用途径. 源代码在github.com/gursoyege/TriScore上公开.

articles.title: MCDA: Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Dynamic Topology Augmentation for Functional MRI Analysis
articles.content: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MCDA:多维图对比性学习与动态地形学增强功能磁共振分析
articles.content_zh: 休眠-状态fMRI(rs-fMRI)是诊断脑病和发现病理机制的重要非侵入性工具. 然而,现有的图表对比性学习方法往往未充分利用各个培训时期的增强历史以及不同观点之间的关系。 在本文中,我们引入了由地理学指导的多视图图对比性学习框架,并配有动态地理学地理学增强(MCDA)用于fMRI分析. 与使用固定噪声或边缘投放的传统GCL不同,MCDA采用了动态增强更新(DAU)模块来迭代地完善被增强的地貌. 具体地说,我们纳入了自我意识和跨样本增强战略,以同时捕捉个人特定的功能特征和主体间异质性. 然后,我们设计了一个地形学指导的多视图图对比性学习计划,它不仅探讨原始网络与其扩大观点之间的相互关系,而且探讨不同扩大观点之间的相互关系,以最大限度地实现结构信息保存。 我们描述分数级优化方向,为对比目标确定下限. 该框架结合了脑障碍诊断的分类和对比性损失,并研究了作为潜在生物标志的歧视性功能连接模式. 对包含1,236个学科的两个公共rs-fMRI数据集进行的实验表明,MCDA的性能超过了最先进的方法. 该代码已在\url{https://github.com/goodcodinga goodboy/MCDA}公开发布。

articles.title: CARNet: End-to-End Coupled Association-Recognition Network for Fine-Grained Multi-Drone Collaborative Detection
articles.content: Multi-drone collaborative detection aims to enhance target recognition by leveraging complementary observations from overlapping aerial viewpoints. Existing approaches typically follow a two-stage pipeline that first establishes cross-view correspondences and then performs fusion-based recognition. However, this decomposition suffers from inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant pairwise modeling, and irreversible error propagation, where incorrect associations inevitably undermine subsequent recognition performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Coupled Association-Recognition Network (CARNet), a unified framework that jointly optimizes cross-view target association and recognition fusion through a shared target-pair representation. To improve association reliability in densely populated scenes with visually similar targets, CARNet explicitly incorporates spatial cues into pairwise relation modeling. Moreover, we introduce two complementary causal-inspired intervention strategies: the first enhances cross-view association by emphasizing appearance-confusing pairs, while the second bolsters the robustness of fusion-based recognition by learning stable multi-view representations under incomplete visual evidence. In addition, we present MDMT-CD, a fine-grained extension of the MDMT dataset that enriches the original vehicle annotations with detailed category labels, providing the first benchmark specifically designed for multi-drone collaborative vehicle detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARNet consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The MDMT-CD dataset and source code will be available at https://github.com/bigdreaming11/CARNet.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CARNet: 最终对夫妇协会的鉴定网络
articles.content_zh: 多德龙协同探测旨在通过利用从相重叠的空中角度获得的补充观测来增强目标识别. 现行做法通常遵循两个阶段的管道,首先建立交叉视图通信,然后进行以聚变为基础的确认。 然而,这种分解存在不一致的优化目标、冗余的双向模型以及不可逆的错误传播,其中不正确的关联不可避免地会损害随后的识别性能。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立联合协会-识别网络(CARNet),这是一个统一框架,通过共享的目标-pair代表,共同优化跨视图目标关联和识别组合。 为了提高具有类似视觉目标的人群密集场景的关联可靠性,CARNet明确将空间提示纳入对等关系模型。 此外,我们引入了两个互补的因果激励干预策略:第一种通过强调相貌相通对来增强交叉相通,而第二种则通过在不完全的视觉证据下学习稳定的多相相通表达,来增强基于聚变的识别力. 此外,我们提出MDMT-CD,这是MDMT数据集的精细扩展,它用详细的类别标签来丰富了原来的车辆说明,提供了专门为多德龙协同车辆检测而设计的第一个基准. 广泛的实验表明,CARNet的业绩一贯高于现有最新方法。 MDMT-CD数据集和源代码将在https://github.com/bigdreaming11/CARNet上提供。

articles.title: From Cause to Effect: Generating Intermediate Event Chains in Videos
articles.content: Video-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual recognition but struggle with causal reasoning. Current evaluations are flawed: multiple-choice QA allows shortcuts, and open-ended QA lacks robust automatic evaluation. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a novel task where models have to generate the sequence of intermediate events connecting a cause and an effect. This structured setup demands genuine reasoning and enables reliable automatic scoring. We accompany this task with two complementary metrics: SODA-Embedding, which measures the semantic matching of a generated chain against a reference, and Causal-QA, which probes the chain's causal coherence by asking whether it contains the specific causal facts needed to reconstruct the narrative. We provide two test sets: SF20K-CC, a manually annotated diagnostic on 20 short films, and CMD-CC, a movie clip benchmark derived from audio descriptions. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with narrative causality understanding, frequently hallucinating or omitting key events. To address this, we fine-tune VLMs with GRPO using a composite reward that combines a format reward, SODA-Embedding, and Causal-QA accuracy, demonstrating substantial improvements over strong baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从原因到效果:在视频中生成中间事件链
articles.content_zh: 视频语言模型(VLMs)优于视觉识别,但与因果推理相搏. 目前的评价有缺陷:多选择QA允许快捷,开放式QA缺乏强势的自动评价. 我们引入了Causal chain Crowth(CCG),这是一种新颖的任务,模型必须生成连接因果的中间事件的顺序. 这种结构化的设置需要真正的推理,并能够可靠地自动打分. 伴随这项任务的还有两个相辅相成的衡量标准:SODA-Embedding,它对照一个参考标准衡量生成链的语义匹配;Causal-QA,它通过询问该链是否包含重建叙述所需的具体因果关系来探究链的因果关系. 我们提供两套测试:SF20K-CC,对20部短片进行手动附加说明的诊断;CMD-CC,从音频描述中衍生出来的电影剪辑基准. 我们的分析表明,最新水平的VLM与叙事因果关系理解相抗争,经常产生幻觉或忽略关键事件. 为了解决这一问题,我们利用综合奖励,将格式奖励、SODA-Embedding和Causal-QA的准确性结合起来,对VLMs和GRPO进行微调,显示比强基线有重大改进。

articles.title: TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation
articles.content: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TIM:与纵向放射学报告生成的迭代相互参照模型的暂时脱钩
articles.content_zh: 自动放射学报告生成(RRG)旨在将医疗图像转化为诊断文本,减少放射学家的工作量并规范临床文献. 尽管如此,现有办法主要侧重于单一时间点分析,未能掌握纵向检查中的时间性疾病的演变情况。 虽然最近的纵向RRG(LRRG)方法吸收了历史数据,但它们往往把不同时点的图像合并在一个单一的表示空间内,导致语义模糊和时间推理不一致. 在这项工作中,我们提议采用 " 暂时性脱钩 " 模式(TIM),这是明确将空间病理与时间发展脱钩的两阶段框架,并通过相互反馈对报告进行反复完善。 阶段 我进行时间分解的表述学习,将时间演变模式与疾病特征区分开来,并为以往和目前的研究编写放射学报告。 第二阶段采用了一种相互报告完善机制,确定以前报告中的诊断不一致之处,并通过对错误敏感的反馈,反复更正以前和现在的报告。 关于纵向-MIMIC数据集的实验表明,TIM超过了现有的单相和纵向基线,实现了跨语言和临床指标的最新业绩。 代码见https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.

articles.title: Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
articles.content: Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dynamics- Aware Sparse 注意高效自动回放视频
articles.content_zh: 自动向后扩散变形器已经作为长相视频生成的强大范例而出现. 然而,它们往往受到令人望而却步的计算间接费用和大量记忆足迹的限制。 这种效率低下的原因是密集的计算机制将统一的处理资源分配给所有瞬间区域,未能利用视频内在的时间冗余,因为视频通常局限于稀有地区。 在本文中,我们提出DASA-Aware Sparse Notion(DASA),这个统一框架从密集的计算转向稀有的由运动驱动的生成来消除存储和计算冗余. 在视频编码原理的启发下,我们的方法将视频内容明确解析为动态和静态区域. 为了缓解内存瓶颈,我们有选择地压缩了历史 KV 缓存,只保留所生成块内的动态特性. 此外,为了减少计算间接费用,我们采用了基于本地动态的区域一级计算分配战略。 此外,还采用了动力导蒸馏法,通过轻量级蒸馏培训过程提高性能。 V Bench上的实验表明,我们的方法加速了2.16x的自旋式视频生成,同时保持了高视力的忠诚.

articles.title: XGLASS: X-Ray, Gaze and Language Assisted Slice Sequencing for CT Volumes
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve remarkable performance on 2D medical images, such as X-rays or pathology images, while 3D VLMs that directly process CT/MRI volumes lag behind due to limited 3D training data and the predominance of 2D foundation architectures. To leverage powerful 2D VLMs for analyzing medical volumes, which contain hundreds of slices, it is therefore necessary to focus only on those few slices, which are diagnostically relevant. To enable such a prioritization, we propose XGLASS, a method that transfers medical expertise from 2D X-rays to 3D CT for task-aware slice prioritization. XGLASS uses disease-conditioned importance maps derived from language-aligned radiologist gaze on X-rays and spatially aligns them with coronal CT projections, bringing gaze priors and CT content into a shared 2D representation. The fused gaze-prior/CT projection is then used to predict a disease-specific ordering of axial slices, prioritizing diagnostically relevant slices. XGLASS significantly improves budgeted retrieval over 2D and 3D-native baselines, achieving a top-10 hit rate up to 75.9% for the best-performing disease. In practice, this means that after inspecting only the top 10 slices (4.17% of a 240-slice scan), XGLASS identifies a diagnostically relevant slice in more than 75% of cases. For downstream slice-wise finding classification, an XGLASS-selected 30-slice candidate set reduces model calls by 87.5% while improving F1 by 11.3 percentage points over all-slice inference, 4.2 points over the strongest 2D selector, and remains competitive with 3D-native selectors while requiring up to 130.8 times less time and 10.9 times less GPU memory per finding, supporting its use as a lightweight preselector for volumetric CT analysis. The code and pretrained checkpoint are available on https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: XGLASS: X-Ray, Gaze 和 CT 卷语言辅助切片序列
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在X射线或病理影像等2D医学图像上取得了出众的性能,而直接处理CT/MRI卷的3D VLM由于3D训练数据有限和2D基础架构占主导地位而滞后. 为了利用强大的2D VLM来分析含有上百个切片的医学卷,因此,必须只关注那些与诊断相关的少数切片. 为了能够确定这种优先次序,我们建议采用XGLASS,将医疗专门知识从2D X光转移到3D CT,以便确定任务的优先次序。 XGLASS使用基于语言相通的放射学家对X射线的视线所绘制的以疾病为条件的重要地图,并在空间上将其与日冕CT的预测相匹配,将视线前传和CT内容带入一个共享的2D代表. 然后使用引信的凝视先入为出/CT投影来预测轴切片因疾病而异的顺序,优先排列诊断相关切片. XGLASS大大改进了2D和3D本土基线的预算检索,使表现最好的疾病达到最高为75.9%的上-10个命中率. 在实践中,这意味着XGLASS只检查了前10个切片(240-切片扫描的4.17%)后,在超过75%的病例中识别出一个诊断相关的切片. 在下游切入法中,XGLAS选取的30个切入法选取法将模式调用率减少87.5%,同时将F1比全切入法提高11.3%,比最强的2D选取法提高4.2分,与3D选取法保持竞争力,同时每选取法需要最多130.8倍的时间和10.9倍的GPU内存,支持其作为轻量级预选器来进行体积CT分析. 密码和事先经过训练的检查站可在https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS上查阅。

articles.title: RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion
articles.content: Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RECAP: 高效视频传播的对等散热关注和分级缓存
articles.content_zh: 分流变压器产生高质量的视频,但计算成本仍然很高. 分散注意力和时间缓冲分别减少了去诺步骤内部和之间的计算,提供了自然成分. 然而,很少注意的预测成为时间再利用的来源,使其在取样轨迹上出现错误。 我们观察到,提高这些来源的准确性可以恢复忠心而不改变再利用时间表,而溅射错误在附近步骤之间仍然方向一致,这表明更正信息可以共享,而不是重新计算。 这些观察激励了RECAP,这是一种免费培训的方法,夫妇通过对等校正,通过在线错误反馈进行适应性协调,以分级缓冲来分散注意力。 紧缺的密集改进纠正了当前稀有估计数中遗漏的相互作用,而新的稀有统计跟踪输入变化并规范老化的更正。 由此产生的预测随后更新了全步预测再利用的来源,使预测历史在密集的刷新之间得以推进. 我们用多种视频传播模式来评价 稀缺方法、缓存方法及其直接成分。 在HunyuanVideo 720p 5-second series上,RECAP实现了3.05x快取并超越了所有测试的忠诚和推论速度的直接成分.

articles.title: SAR2Net: Learning Spatially Anchored Representations for Retrieval-Guided Cross-Stain Alignment
articles.content: Achieving spatial alignment between whole-slide images(WSIs) across stains is essential for integrating morphology and molecular information, yet it remains challenging due to extreme resolution, tissue fragmentation, and large nonlinear deformations. Conventional registration pipelines depend on global pre-alignment and spatial consistency, which often collapse under such distortions. We present SAR2Net, a framework that learns spatially anchored representations and reformulates cross-stain alignment as a region-level feature retrieval problem. Instead of estimating explicit transformations, SAR2Net learns pointwise representations encoding the relative spatial relationships to tissue landmarks. Given landmarks and arbitrary coordinates, it predicts spatially anchored features that serve as deformation-invariant descriptors of tissue topology. A twostage retrieval framework then establishes correspondences between slides, even when global alignment is infeasible. Experiments on biopsy-oriented HE-IHC datasets show that SAR2Net achieves robust region-level alignment under severe tissue distortions, outperforming previous methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAR2Net:在空间上学习用于检索-指导的交叉对接的插图
articles.content_zh: 实现覆盖污点的全滑行图像(WSI)之间的空间对接,对于整合形态学和分子信息至关重要,但由于极端分辨率、组织分解和大型非线性变形,它仍然具有挑战性。 常规登记管道取决于全球预先调整和空间一致性,而这种调整往往会因这种扭曲而崩溃。 我们介绍SAR2Net,这是一个学习空间定位表述并重新确定跨相色调一致性的框架,是区域一级的特征检索问题。 SAR2Net没有估计明显的变异,而是学习指向表示,将相对空间关系与组织地标编码. 鉴于地标和任意坐标,它预测了作为组织地貌的变形-变异描述符的空间定位地貌。 然后,一个两阶段检索框架建立幻灯片之间的对应,即使全球对齐不可行。 对面向活检的HE-IHC数据集的实验表明,SAR2Net在严重的组织扭曲下实现了强烈的区域级对接,比以往的方法表现优异. 代码见https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.

articles.title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
articles.content: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RoAR-VAE:通过稳健的预测提高后期可变性
articles.content_zh: 有效的视觉示意器必须保持图像忠贞性,同时产生下游传播模型能够有效学习的潜质. 先前的工作通过语义调整或联合发号施令-扩散培训,提高了潜在的可扩散性。 重新审视REPA-E是一种具有代表性的做法,我们发现,在消除其扩散目标和专注的基因区块的同时,保留从被腐蚀的潜在物中得出的语义预测,在相应的环境下会产生类似的下游生成性能。 这一观察激励了稳健预测的一般原则:与生成有关的信息应继续从被腐蚀的潜在物中取回。 我们以两个相辅相成的目标即时提出这一原则。 RobustAlign预测从被腐蚀的潜入物中预受训练的语义特征来保存高层次的结构,而RobustRecon重建了干净的图像来保留精细的空间和外观信息. 他们共同组成了强力对接与重建VAE(ROAR-VAE). 我们的分析表明,强力预测通过使有用的信息在高变异潜在方向上更容易获得,从而改进了易散性,而扩散模型往往会更早了解。 从经验上讲,RoAR-VAE的平均生成基准性能比同一培训预算下最强的基准活化剂提高2.19分,同时比FLUX.1-VAE提高小文本重建精度16.93分. 这些结果表明,ROAR-VAE在重建忠贞与下游遗传学之间实现了有利的平衡。

articles.title: ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture
articles.content: Detailed hand and foot articulation is important for animation and motion analysis, yet remains challenging to recover from monocular video. Recent expressive video methods infer hand articulation from shared whole-body representations. Our conference work suggests that this underexploits local evidence: the Foot Motion Refinement (FootMR) module refines ankle rotations from foot keypoints, improving reconstruction even when the initial estimator receives the same keypoints. We extend this principle to hands with the Hand Motion Refinement (HandMR) module. Because 2D finger keypoints are often missing or unreliable, HandMR combines image features of a pretrained hand reconstruction model with initial arm and hand rotations to refine elbows, wrists, and fingers. We integrate FootMR and HandMR into ExMR (Extremity Motion Refinement), a system for reconstructing 3D body, hand, and foot motion from monocular video. An initial temporal estimator predicts whole-body motion, after which both refiners revisit local evidence to predict residual joint rotations. Experiments on ARCTIC, MOYO, RICH, and MOOF show that ExMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in hand and foot reconstruction, reducing hand per-vertex error and ankle joint angle error on MOYO by 19% and 18%, respectively, relative to the strongest competitor. Code will be made available for research purposes. Project page: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ExMR: 外相运动 精致地取出单体人类运动
articles.content_zh: 详细的手和脚表达对于动画和运动分析很重要,但从单相机视频中恢复仍然具有挑战性. 近期的表达式视频方法推断出来自共享全身表达的手语表达. 我们的会议工作表明,这种对本地证据的挖掘不足:脚运动精准化(FootMR)模块精炼出脚键点的脚踝旋转,即使初始估计器得到相同的键点,也改善了重建. 我们把这一原则推广到手动改进模块。 由于2D指键点往往缺失或不可靠,HandMR将预训手部重建模型的图像特征与起步臂和手自转来细化肘,手腕和指. 我们把FootMR和HandMR整合到ExMR(Extremity Motion Finement)中,这是一个从单相机视频中重建3D体,手和脚运动的系统. 一个初始的时间估计器预测了全身运动,之后两个精炼者都会重新审视当地的证据来预测残余的联合旋转. 有关ACTIC,MOYO,RICH,MOOF的实验显示,与最强的竞争对手相比,ExMR在手部和脚部重建方面都超越了最先进的方法,将MOYO的手部相向倒数误差和脚踝相向角误差分别减少19%和18%. 守则将提供给研究。 项目网页:https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/

articles.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
articles.content: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 有焦点的 Omni- Modal 图形界面 探员
articles.content_zh: 图形用户界面(GUI)代理越来越多地在横跨截图、音频、视频、互动历史以及设备状态的流出全方位模式观测中发挥作用。 然而,在每一个步骤上统一揭露这一完整的背景都忽略了相关性是短暂和稀少的:决定一个行动的信号在下一个步骤上会变得模糊不清. 由于执行的行动反馈到上下文中,这些错误会复合到序列分解,使剂进入不可逆转的轨道漂移. 我们提出基本要求,即 " 有重点的观念 " :一种能够逐步适应、行动充足和无侵犯性的代表性。 我们在FocusGUI中认识到这一点,FocusGUI是一个轻量级的适配器,它根据具体步骤的决定参考,动态地优先考虑多式渠道。 它不统一处理所有输入,而是将最相关的证据压缩成紧凑的潜伏并潜入被冻结的解码器的嵌入,引导模型的注意力,而不会改变其原生参数空间. FocusGUI列车单从动作监督,既不需要模式关联标签,也不需要主干线微调. 通过四种全方位模式主干线,它将总体类型匹配提升到+33.2,精确匹配提升到3.0倍于被冻结的主干线,将类型匹配提升到+30.1,高于现有最强增强方法.

articles.title: GeoEdit: Adversarial De-Evidencing for Silent Geoprivacy Protection via Image Editing
articles.content: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoEdit: 通过图像编辑对静态地平地保护进行横向除声
articles.content_zh: 最近的努力表明,多式联运大理由模型在地理推理方面具有很强的能力。 通过联合分析细微的视觉提示,这些模型可以推断出相片的位置,从而甚至让非专家的对手能够做作. 现存的防御方法难以将相片的可分享性与有效保护相平衡,往往无法充分打乱嵌入场景语义中的隐含地证链. 为此,我们提出GeoEdit,这是一个通过图像编辑进行无声地地理保护的对抗性的去证明框架。 具体地说,我们对图像中的高风险证据锚进行最小的编辑,从而打乱了基础空间推理链,同时保留了整体场景语义. 我们通过将结构化的知识与所发现的对抗性地理线索结合起来来确定这些锚地。 为了进一步引导大型编辑行动空间,我们采取了一项可学习的政策,迭代地完善编辑决定,将成功的轨迹提炼成可转移的自然语言见解,以便连贯而有效地编辑。 GeoEdit在LifePhoto Bench上的评价显示,GeoEdit对6个主流MLRM有强大的保护,在图像忠诚度上比视觉扰动基线高出了0.59多分.

articles.title: Wan-Alpha++: Animating a Single RGBA Asset into Controllable Transparent Video Effects
articles.content: RGBA video generation is essential for creating compositable visual assets in filmmaking, game development, and digital content production. However, generating high-quality RGB appearance alongside temporally coherent transparency remains a significant challenge. Existing text-to-RGBA video methods often entangle RGB and alpha distributions and offer limited control over the precise appearance of a target asset. In addition, incorporating image conditioning typically suffers from the emergence-disappearance effects, which fail existing first-frame or first-and-last-frame conditions due to their fully transparent boundary frames. To address these issues, we present Wan-Alpha++, a unified framework that brings controllable RGBA video generation to both text- and image-to-video diffusion backbones through a shared RGBA latent space, extending our conference version Wan-Alpha from the text-conditioned setting to image-conditioned generation with an interior reference frame. Our method first learns shiftable RGB-alpha distributions while preserving the pretrained RGB prior. Specifically, we introduce a transparency-aware bidirectional diffusion objective to produce distinguishable RGBA latent representations, and a transparency-guided mean sampler that shifts the noise distribution to improve transparency generation and enable spatial controllability. Building upon this RGBA generation prior, we introduce temporal phase reparameterization for image-conditioned effect generation. By cyclically transforming a zero-positive-zero alpha pattern into a positive-zero-positive pattern, it relocates visible content to both temporal boundaries, facilitating effective appearance conditioning with limited RGBA data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Wan-Alpha++:将单一的RGBA资产动画入可控透明视频效果
articles.content_zh: RGBA视频生成对于在电影制作,游戏开发,和数字内容制作中创造可堆叠的视觉资产至关重要. 然而,在暂时保持一贯透明度的同时,形成高质量的保护责任,仍然是一个重大挑战。 现有的文本到RGBA视频方法经常缠绕RGB和α发行,对目标资产的准确外观提供有限的控制. 此外,纳入图像条件通常受到出现 -- -- 消失效应的影响,这些效应由于边界框架完全透明而未能满足现有的第一帧或第一和最后一帧条件。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出Wan-Alpha++,这是一个统一的框架,通过共享的RGBA潜在空间,将可控RGBA视频生成带给文本和图像到视频的传播主干线,把我们的会议版本Wan-Alpha从文本条件设定扩展到图像条件设定生成带内部参考框架. 我们的方法首先学习可转移的RGB-α分布,同时保留预先训练的RGB前. 具体地说,我们引入了一个具有透明度的双向传播目标,以产生可区分的RGBA潜在表示,并引入一个以透明度为指南的平均取样器,以改变噪音分布,从而改进透明度的产生并实现空间可控性。 在先前的RGBA生成的基础上,我们引入了时间相重测,用于图像条件效应生成. 通过周期性地将零正-零正α图案转换为正-零正α图案,将可见内容迁移到两个时间界限上,以有限的RGBA数据来方便有效的外观调节.

articles.title: HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching
articles.content: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HP- PnP- 花: 混合时间排程和投影, 通过流量匹配恢复插件和播放图像
articles.content_zh: 图像修复是一个根本性的反向问题,试图从退化的观测中恢复出高质量的图像. 插管和放管(PnP)方法提供了一个灵活的框架,将预先训练的放管人纳入迭代重建中,而流相匹配则提供了一个基于连续时间ODE动态的高效基因模型化方法. 最近,Martin等人(ICLR, 2025年)开发出一种PnP-Flow方法,将PnP框架与流量匹配相结合,通过一种由预先训练的流量匹配模型所构建的有时间依赖的denoiser. 通过纳入不同的时序和额外的像素-空间投影操作员,本文提出了一种全新的高效的PnP-花算法(HP-PnP-花),在温和的假设下享有严格的收缩保证,而不会对上述作品所要求的高度设置限制性条件. CelebA和AFHQ-Cat上的数值实验表明,新提出的HP-PnP-花算法在去诺活化,去布鲁尔活化,超解分解,随机涂入等几个修复任务上显著地超过PnP-花. 值得注意的是,我们的算法实现了可比或更好的重建质量,迭代次数大大减少,将再迭次数从500美元减少到100美元,用于AFHQ-Cat的分解和超解。

articles.title: Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models
articles.content: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习目标 通过冻结等级世界模式的次级目标
articles.content_zh: 分级世界模型通过从粗细模型到下级控制器的预测状态,在长的地平线上进行计划. 选择这些状态可能很昂贵:高层规划者通过候选宏观动作轨迹反复区分. 我们用一个轻量级的入门条件网络来取代这次搜索 通过被冻结的高水平预测器训练 网络提供调制向量,而预测器则产生下个潜在的路由点. 训练在下线轨迹上使用后视目标及状态预测损失,没有搜索-解决目标或宏观行动标签. 推论保留了自发性高层次推出,但不需要高层次候选人优化. 我们在与H-JEPA分配的共用直线HWM检查站上评价这一办法,每个主干线使用3个主干种子和3个头部初始化. 有共同的评价协议,Cube上的平均成功率为70.4%,Push-T上为48.7%,FourRoom上为100.0%,Visual AntMaze上为71.1%. 该方法比对应的HWM在三种环境中的搜索基线有所改进,在Push-T上也有相同的平均值. NVIDIA L40S上的专用测量给出了1.28-4.39x端到端的速率来进行分批评价. 赤字将国家适应性条件确定为一贯的促进因素,而预测介导的次级目标和不受限制的条件则具有取决于环境的利益。

articles.title: TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation
articles.content: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TriTD: 实时自动回放视频生成的 三相轨迹-分解分解
articles.content_zh: 自动回放(AR)视频传播已成为高效视频生成的主要范例,但其实际部署仍被生成质量与推论效率之间的取舍所束缚. 我们将此瓶颈归咎于AR推出中的三个出错源:基模型出错,列车推导分布不匹配,上游出错传播. 在这个分解的基础上,我们从每步和累计出错中得出闭式上限,为联合优化生成质量和推论效率提供了原则基础. 在这项分析的指导下,我们提议采用TriTD,即具有三个互补模块的Tri-Partite Treptric-Districtive co-优化蒸馏框架。 首先,对于ODE初始化,我们采用了下个节点的轨迹分解(NTD)目标,它缩短了监管范围,并接纳了更低的回归-反转层. 其次,我们引入了Chunk-Graded Noising(CGN),这是一种单调无减速的每个chunk noising时刻表,它有助于缩小预期的列车推算噪声不匹配,并去除冗余的KV-cache更新,产生大量不花质量成本的速度. 第三,我们提出Orthogonal-Parallel DMD(OP-DMD),这是一种分配相配损失,它保留了最初的DMD监督,同时在正向子空间引入了额外的回归约束来抑制离轴漂移,同时提高了训练稳定性和最终生成质量. 广泛的实验表明,TriTD在视觉质量上始终超过现有的基线,同时在单一H100GPU上达到26.8FPS的实时吞吐量,为交互式流线视频生成提供了平衡的质量效率解决方案.

articles.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OpenVL Harness: 真实世界视觉代理工具与多模式内存
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理上取得了迅速的进展,然而许多任务需要的证据单靠内部推理是难以获得的:我们对22个基准的控制研究显示,仅仅增加基础模型的推论预算只能产生微小的收益. 这种任务需要有根据的认知、外部知识和通过各种工具获得的数字测量,其产出必须能够对模型作出解释,并保留各种推理步骤。 我们介绍了OpenVLHarness,这是一个围绕能力层和持久的多模式记忆组织的多模式推理工具。 能力层将任务级工具界面与证据渲染相结合,提供一致的获取多端后端,并将其输出转化为可被模型读取的观测. 持续的多模式内存保留了相应的图像,结构化数据和网络引用,作为每个查询的可地址文物. 一个编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序,使计算能够结合多个工具的结果. 这些机制共同支持获得、检查和整理多式联运证据的迭接过程。 对22个有8个开放和专有骨干的基准进行评估后,OpenVLHarness的平均分数比匹配的无工具基线提高9.7-12.6分,包括+11.2分与Qune3-VL-8B分,+9.7分与Kimi K3分,+9.9分与GPT-6 Astra分. 随着GPT-6 Luna在中度推理上的努力,OpenVLHarness以最大努力7.7-8.5分的成绩超过了基准模型"Codex"和"Visual Sketchpad",而其模型-token成本最高为37%.

articles.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
articles.content: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 这真的有用吗? 综合功能性CAD机制
articles.content_zh: 虽然LLM代理可以产生视觉上可信的 CAD 组件,但这些设计往往不能实现预期的物理功能. 我们研究功能性的 CAD 设计,一种由代理人解释未明确要求的设置,即构造和迭代修改机制,以满足物理模拟中的功能要求. 验证这些要求是非三角性的:不同的候选机制可能通过完全不同的组件,控制和操作序列来实现相同的功能. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出FunCAD-Harness,这个框架将抽象的要求转化为针对候选人的物理测试,并使用模拟反馈来指导设计修改. 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们引入了FunCABennch,这一基准涵盖46个具有相互依存和多步骤业务的机制家庭。 跨越边界的LLM剂实验表明,FunCAD-Harness暴露出视觉检查看不见的微妙机械故障,大大改善了功能成功率,超过了标准模拟强化基线. 归根结底,我们的工作标志着向有能力将人类意图转化为工作机制的CAD代理人迈出了一步。

articles.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
articles.content: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WeAct: 作为代理动作的动态重量切换
articles.content_zh: 长视线剂必须从相接的轨迹中学习各种能力。 更新共同的参数以学习新的能力可能会降低以前获得的参数,从而造成灾难性的遗忘。 随着轨迹的发展,不同阶段可能需要不同的能力,然而传统的联合培训和静态适配器合并在整个执行过程中保持固定参数配置. 我们引入了WeAct(Weight-level Internal Action),它通过一个被冷冻的骨干对独立能力特定的LORA适配器进行培训,并在代理器的动作空间中添加适配器的选择. 这些内部行动使用该模型的本土工具调用界面,在共享的上下文中进行需求能力构成. 在8个深度研究基准中,WeAct的Quen3-32B与完全微调对应方相比提高了平均精确度6.2%,尽管使用计算较少,与最强的静态LORA-merging方法相比提高了27.5%。 WeAct还支持模块化的持续适应,方法是增加一个新的代码计算适配器来扩展代理的能力并更新现有的写适配器来提高报告质量. 两项更新都使主干和其他适配器保持不变,支持在物剂中进行模块化的持续适应.

articles.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
articles.content: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LatComm: 大语言模型之间Latent通信的可重复使用的上下文压缩
articles.content_zh: 结合了几种大语言模型(LLMS)的系统,常常会用一个上下文处理许多问题. 当上下文作为文本在模型之间传递时,接收模型会再次为每个问题处理其所有符号. 避免这一费用需要一种紧凑、跨问题可重复使用、可由不同LLM读取的上下文表述。 现有的压缩和潜在通信方法只提供其中一些特性。 我们引入了LatComm,即Latett通信接口,它通过将编码与读取区分来提供所有三个:上下文被编码一次,没有问题,接收者选择每个问题要读什么. 一个被冻结的上下文编码器LLM将上下文压缩成一个固定大小的包并发送给另一个被冻结的接收器LLM,它通过交叉注意读取了包,门从它的快取来计算. 在12个多选择问答数据集上,LatComm比单向量基线提高平均精度,最高可达10.2分. 在"Quality"上,它将接收器的输入减少57x并更快地回答第3x条的问题.

articles.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
articles.content: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 混合结构中的竞争性学习
articles.content_zh: 许多现代语言模型都采用了混合结构,既包含线性-时间重现,又包含软最大注意力. 现代重现层提供了高度表达性的混合机制,同时通过将上下文信息压缩成固定大小状态来确保高吞吐量,但在上下文信息检索中却表现得软马克斯注意力不足. 在本文中,我们揭示出一种相竞的学习现象,不同种类的混音器竞相学习同一种功能,当任何一层学习到一个功能时,它会压制其他层的相应学习信号. 地层归属分析显示,在典型的数据分布下,现代再生学习回取功能的速度快于软最大注意力,导致注意力在多数情况下无法学习回取. 在培训中停止重现时更新重量有助于注意力学习检索。 基于这些结果,我们提出了关于自然语言的混合结构培训前阶段培训程序。 最多可达1B参数的模型的实证结果显示,我们的方法在语言模型丢失,常识推理,以及不同上下文长度的广泛检索相关任务等方面都得到大幅改进.

articles.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
articles.content: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 野外代理世界模型:计算机使用代理环境综合
articles.content_zh: 代理学习正在从学习人类数据转向通过与世界的互动来学习。 然而,在现实世界计算机系统中直接推广这种学习具有挑战性,可能带来巨大的安全风险。 因此,我们提议在野外建立世界代理模式(WildAWM),这是一个可扩展的管道,用于合成可控制的环境和培训一般计算机使用代理的任务。 虽然现有方法一般专门用于单一代理交互界面,但我们构建可执行环境,共同支持图形用户界面,模式上下文协议服务,以及命令行界面,使代理能够灵活地将视觉交互,工具使用和代码执行结合起来. WildAWM完全由开源模型提供动力,表明高质量的计算机使用环境可以在没有专有前沿模型的情况下生成. 除了环境之外,我们还应对任务综合中反复出现的三个挑战:确保可溶性、保持足够的困难并产生可靠的核实者,方法是采用基于执行的质量门,将不同代理人的推出、交叉判断的一致性检查和判断力的反事实探测结合起来。 由此形成的管线合成了341个长相环境任务对子,可以要求100多个代理步骤来解决并保持挑战,即使是前沿模型,GPT-6-Astra只解决了其中60%. 我们专门在这些合成世界训练两个大小不同的Quen模型. 这两个模型在覆盖网络、爪子和计算机使用物剂的8项分配外基准上都取得了巨大收益,表明在WINDAWM的合成世界中学习可以将计算机使用任务广泛归纳为看不见的任务。 该守则可在https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM上公开查阅。

articles.title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
articles.content: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: KKEEW-Bench:在环境压缩中评价证据保全
articles.content_zh: 上下文压缩提高了长文本的效率,但可能通过信息瓶颈引入忠实问题。 现有的评价依赖于QA度量衡,但读者仍然可以从不忠实的压缩中正确回答,所以这些度量衡低估了这种损失. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了KEEP-Bench这一诊断基准,该基准直接评估3个挑战环境的4,102个案例的可靠性,这些案例需要保存证据,以便提出可信的参考解决方案、明确的限定词和少数群体的观点。 实验表明,即使有量身定制的提示,最强的模型仍然不可靠:尽管上下文窗口超过100K个令牌,投入平均只有3.1K个令牌,但是最好的开口量模型(31B)只保留了66.8%的所有需要的证据,最好的专有模型只保存了61.6%. 不同证据结构的性能也大相径庭,因此有限结构的结论可能带有偏见. 我们还引入了一个衡量标准,即证据保存返回(EPR),将证据召回与推断的FLOP联系起来,并发现其最高值为中度(4B-8B),召回率仍然很低。 额外的产出预算主要有利于已经很强的模型,并扩大了能力差距,然而,更有力地保存这些模型需要付出高昂的计算成本。 这些调查结果突出表明,未来工作必须调查在小型计算预算下具有强有力的信息保存的压缩机,而不是依赖大量产出预算或模型规模。
