articles.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
articles.content: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RefCraft:通过网络开发建立视觉-参考-参考-代理生成基准
articles.content_zh: 除了基本的工具使用和编码技能外,有效地将视觉参考纳入代理生成对于将AI代理应用于现实世界的生产力任务同样至关重要. 我们通过网页开发来研究这一关键能力,这是一个实用和易于评价的设定,在这一设定中,现有基准在很大程度上仍然是理想化的:它们通常侧重于重建视觉目标,或仅从文字指示中生成网页,忽略了从视觉实例发展起来的更常见工作流程。 具体地说,我们采用了RefCraft,这是一个由300个现实的多模式网页开发任务构成的基准,这些任务将自然语言说明和1至5个参考网页的截图结合起来。 代理人必须有选择地解释和利用这些参考文献,同时制作、视觉检查和反复改进其产出。 我们利用可独立核查的关键点和补充方案及自愿活动法官,评估由此产生的不限成员名额文物。 在9个前沿(M)LLMs中,最强的系统在100个中总得分只有52.12分,揭示出视觉参考条件的代理生成对于实用网页开发环境中的当前模型来说仍然是个巨大的挑战.

articles.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
articles.content: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MemT-1.0:走向记忆-内在演变
articles.content_zh: 内存-内在演化需要使内存成为基础模型的内在能力,使其能够不断积累和利用信息. 为此,我们引入了MemT-1.0,这是一种内存基础模型的新架构,将内存内部化,作为模型计算的一部分. MemT-1.0在Metis上施工 三角洲 Net-2在每个转弯内设有稳定的符号级内存更新机制. 我们进一步引入了"Storage混合"(Mixture-of-Storage),以扩大本土记忆容量. 在精心准备骨干骨干后,我们开发了一个两阶段培训管道,包括持续的培训前培训和培训后培训,并辅之以34B个培训数据标志以及高效培训和推断基础设施。 我们发布了由MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash组成的模范家庭,并对记忆力和一般能力进行全面的评价. 结果表明,它们的平均表现超过了参数内存基线,并且仍然具有检索强化方法的竞争力,同时在很大程度上保持了一般能力。 在历史长度为128K令牌的情况下,MemT-1.0-Nano实现了约1.86\times$的终到终推速,并相对于全上下文KV缓存的持久存储减少66\times$. MemT-1.0通过将回收的程序经验内部化,改进了在代理任务上的任务成功,为内存-内在演化提供了一个实际步骤。

articles.title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
articles.content: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpecMRL: 重新设计 Matryoshka 代表性学习
articles.content_zh: Matryoshka代表学习(MRL)旨在通过共同优化嵌入前缀来支持灵活的代表大小. 这种设计虽然有效,但缺乏明确的制约,无法确保主导部分提供合适的紧凑编码. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出"SpecMRL"(SpecMRL),它重组了特征空间,以便能更有效地读取前缀. 具体地说,我们扩展了MRL,以一个参数衍生的光谱基础,它具有特征重要性。 SpecMRL否则会遵循标准的MRL,在所学光谱空间进行前缀读出. 关于MTEB的实验显示,SpecMRL的性能完全超过MRL评价被降低的维度,在更积极的压缩下获得更大的收益. 这些结果表明,所学光谱基础更好地确定信息化方向的优先次序,从而能够更有效地进行表达压缩。 值得注意的是,SpecMRL扩展了MRL的性能前沿,超过了全维的MRL,而嵌入维度只有一半.

articles.title: AfriBED: a Speech Recognition Bias Evaluation Dataset for Low Resource African Languages
articles.content: Despite advancements in automatic speech recognition systems (ASR), current systems exhibit speaker-attribute bias, i.e., their speech recognition performance is biased against certain speakers based on their demographic attributes such as gender, accents, and speaker type. However, accurately assessing speaker attribute bias in a given ASR system requires the availability of a bias evaluation dataset with comparable speech across subgroups of a speaker attribute. In this paper, we introduce African speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED), a novel speech recognition bias evaluation dataset for two low resource African languages, Bemba and Nyanja, to detect and estimate gender and speaker-type bias for ASR systems. The dataset comprises 9 hours of speech with 3928 utterances recorded by 80 speakers for Bemba, while the Nyanja set includes 6260 utterances with approximately 18 hours of speech recorded by 127 speakers. The results of our baseline experiments demonstrate that the datasets are useful for examining gender and speaker-type attribute bias in the target languages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AFRIBED:低资源非洲语言语音识别比斯评价数据集
articles.content_zh: 尽管在自动语音识别系统(ASR)方面有所进步,但现行系统显示的语音属性偏差,即其语音识别表现基于性别、口音和语音类型等人口特征而偏向于某些语音。 然而,要准确评估某一ASR系统中的发言者属性偏差,就必须提供一套带有发言者属性各分组可比语音的偏向评价数据集。 在本文中,我们介绍了非洲语音比亚斯评价数据集(AfriBED),这是一个针对Bemba和Nyanja两种非洲低资源语言的新型语音识别偏差评价数据集,用于发现和估计ASR系统的性别和语音类型偏差。 数据集包括9小时的演讲和80名发言者为本巴录制的3928个发言,而Nyanja数据集包括6 260个发言,127名发言者录制了约18小时的发言。 我们的基线试验结果表明,数据集有助于审查目标语言中的性别和语种属性偏差。

articles.title: ASTOR: Benchmarking and Improving Autoformulation for Soft-Constraint Optimization with a Formal Grammar
articles.content: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ASTOR: 采用正式语法优化软约束的基准化和改进自动化
articles.content_zh: 现实世界的决策问题结合了两种性质不同的制约:必须满足的要求,称为硬约束,以及可以被侵犯的偏好,称为软约束. 由于这些问题常常被自然语言的决策者所提出,因此大型语言模型为协助解决它们提供了一个自然工具. 这导致了自发化,它侧重于使用LLMS将决定问题的自然语言描述翻译为可执行的数学优化模型. 然而,这一研究往往忽略了软性限制,如消费者、管理人员和规划者提出的那些限制,尽管许多实际问题需要明确加以示范。 我们引入了ASTOR,一个推论-时间框架,将自然语言决定问题映射到由语法指导的抽象语法树(AST)上,然后确定将由此产生的表达性汇编成可执行优化代码. 我们还引入了SoftOR,这是自然语言问题的统一基准,侧重于软约束的表达. 在Softor上,ASTOR在可比较的单向求取和多代理LLM方法中实现了最佳的集合精度,同时在仅包含硬性约束的标准自发基准上保持竞争力. 编码和数据见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md。

articles.title: Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability
articles.content: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 安全中培训:将LLM安全作为基本能力内化
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)的安全调整主要在培训后进行,而最近的工作也已开始将安全数据纳入培训前的工作。 然而,如果以后的培训不再包括安全数据,安全就会退化,安全方面的进步往往以一般能力为代价。 这种紧张关系表明,不应将安全和一般推理视为单独的训练目标。 相反,我们认为安全是一种LLM能力,可以通过与一般任务共享的推理结构来学习。 两者都要求模型了解意图或任务目标,应用相关知识和关于潜在后果的理由。 我们引入了安全中期培训,这是从培训前到培训后的一个阶段,通过这一共同结构共同发展安全和一般推理。 鉴于安全和实用提示,该基本模型产生结构化的文件和推理痕迹,然后用于中期培训。 相较于Qune3-1.7B,4B和8B基型,安全中训将平均攻击成功率(ASR)降低72%至81%,同时也提高了一般能力. 通过随后的培训,这些好处依然存在。 在通用的SFT之后,中训练型基本保持了安全性,实现了低于基线的ASR而不牺牲一般能力. 它们也保留了普通专用GRPO的安全,没有安全奖赏,而随后的RL在从中培训模式初始化时,达到了更好的安全用途前沿. 这些结果表明,在共同的中培训阶段学习安全和一般推理可以减少安全效用的取舍,并使安全对随后的培训更加有力。

articles.title: Teacher Supervision, Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models
articles.content: Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher's bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher's coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce's choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher's probabilities ends at the teacher's decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 教师监督、固定代表制和校准:候选人-评分决定模式的确切风险计算
articles.content_zh: 候选人评分决定模型将概率分布反馈给所介绍的一组答案。 一个这样的系统Jev和一个开放的对口单位JevAny的公开文献描述了三种确定这些概率估计的训练成分:大型模型的软目标、被冻结的先行骨干和温度校正。 我们分析高斯代孕物中的每一种成分 在那里可以精确计算出有限的样本风险 接受过教师目标培训的学生继承了教师的偏见,更多的学生数据没有删除,与教师的约定也没有透露. 固定表述方式只将风险降低到一个明确的样本尺寸阈值以下。 在一个 probit 模型中,精确的再校正图是温度缩放图,它只有在老师的系数有正确方向时,才会去除所有多余的风险,否则留下校正诊断无法检测到的残余. 根据Luce的选择,候选人的分数在对某一事件进行改进时是一致的,如果而且只有按对数和外观加以汇总。 在231,521起来自消费者金融保护局的信用卡投诉中,在决定投诉是否以货币救济告终时,接受物流教师概率培训的学生以教师的决定成本结束,而接受结果培训的学生则低于8%,30B型读作"零发"的成绩仍然比重新校正后的老师差,该型号则以17.5分贝偏离一致性条件. 预受考验的表示会减少需要的被标出的数据并校正概率的尺度,但两者都不纠正偏执的老师,因此概率必须对照已实现的结果来检查.

articles.title: RESIN: Multi-Chain Reasoning with Entity-Structured Indexing
articles.content: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RESIN:多钱 与实体编制索引有关的原因
articles.content_zh: 多链推理是一项具有挑战性的任务,不仅因为多链证据被分散,而且因为推理的不同部分可能需要不同的互动支持链. 平面取回可以将文本松散相通的模型淹没,而早期选择单一推理路径则可以丢弃只有在考虑其他事实后才变得有用的证据. 我们引入RESIN(与实体结构索引重合),它使用结构定位证据,同时保留原始来源作为推理的基础. RESIN将一个问题分解为焦点的一跳需要,为每跳取出一组以源为基础的小单元,并仅将这个相关证据放入紧凑推理缓冲. 缓冲保留了替代支持直到最终组成,在不强迫走一条简陋的道路的情况下作出中间决定。 在完整的HolisQA基准上,RESIN实现了82.92个上下文回顾和76.70个回答对所有问题的关联性,所报告的CR和AR覆盖了五个领域,在四个领域的F1高于已公布的基准. 分解表明,键入式证据多样性和随机分解都至关重要,支持明确的结论: 精确的证据组织和延迟的承诺使多链推理有效和可审计。 我们的代码见https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN。

articles.title: Game of Phones: Harnessing Game Theory and LLMs in 'Bot Wars' to Counteract Phone Scams
articles.content: Phone scams impose substantial and growing costs on individuals and financial systems worldwide, yet existing countermeasures impose no resource cost on perpetrators. Strategic scam-baiting, in which automated agents engage scammers to deplete their operational capacity, offers a proactive alternative but requires dynamic strategy adaptation that static systems cannot provide. We introduce a game-theoretic framework enabling LLMs to learn effective counter-strategies through in-context experience without fine-tuning. The framework models scammer-baiter interactions as a two-player game with empirically grounded strategies and utility functions, using Nash equilibrium as a formal benchmark for evaluating learned behaviour. Across 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, adaptive strategy selection achieves 28.9-79.7% closer alignment to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines. The code and an annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores are released at https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/ .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 手机游戏:在"Bot Wars"中用游戏理论和LLMs来对抗手机相机
articles.content_zh: 电话骗局给全世界的个人和金融体系带来巨大和不断增长的成本,而现有的对策却不对犯罪者造成资源成本。 战略诈骗,即自动代理商雇用欺诈者耗尽其业务能力,提供了一个主动积极的替代办法,但需要动态战略调整,而静态系统是无法提供的。 我们引入了一个游戏理论框架,使LLMs能够通过内在的文字经验学习有效的反战略,而不进行微调. 框架模型是骗局者-赌博者的互动,作为双玩家游戏,具有基于经验的战略和效用功能,将纳什均衡作为评价所学行为的正式基准. 在300个模拟对话和三个LLM架构中,适应性战略选择比非适应性基线更接近纳什平衡,达到28.9%-79.7%。 在https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/上发布了300个对话框的代码和附加说明的数据集,并附有转弯战略标签和功用分数。 。 。 。 。

articles.title: Monsoon: Scalable Spontaneous Speech Collection for Low-Resource ASR in 50 Languages
articles.content: For most languages, automatic speech recognition (ASR) is limited less by model architecture than by a lack of accurately transcribed spontaneous speech. We present Monsoon, a framework for collecting such data at scale. It elicits unscripted conversations between paired contributors, screens recordings with automated classifiers, corrects transcripts over five levels of human review, and selects segments for lexical and acoustic coverage. It has collected speech in 50 languages; we analyse seven 3,500-hour corpora. At equal volume, its quality stages reduce semantic word error rate (WER) by 10-39% relative to a conventional protocol. Compared with an architecture-matched baseline trained on public corpora, Whisper fine-tuned on Monsoon performs comparably on the baseline's own test sets and reduces semantic WER by 20-44 points on conversational benchmarks. The gains transfer to a second architecture and grow with data volume. We release the framework, its quality-control models, and the fine-tuned models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 季风:50种语言的低资源ASR可缩放自发演讲集
articles.content_zh: 对于大多数语言来说,自动语音识别(ASR)受到模型架构的限制较少,而缺乏准确的转录自发语音. 我们提出 " 蒙松 " ,这是大规模收集此类数据的框架。 它引来配对贡献者之间的无标本对话,用自动分级器来显示录音,在人文审查的5个层次上校正笔录,并选择分块进行词汇和声学覆盖. 它收集了50种语言的演讲;我们分析了7个3500小时的蝎子. 在等量时,其质量级比常规协议将语义词出错率(WER)降低10-39%. 相较于在公共公司训练的建筑相配基线,Whisper在"蒙松"上的微调在基线本身的测试集上可以比较性地表现,在对话基准上将语义WER减少20-44分. 收益转移到了第二个架构,随着数据量的增长而增长. 我们发布框架, 其质量控制模型, 和微调模型。

articles.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
articles.content: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HarnessPro:与Pareto优化性能-成本取舍的递归性取舍自我改进
articles.content_zh: 在建立有能力的AI代理商方面,利用性发展发挥着至关重要的作用. 最近的办法通过递归性自我改进(RSI)改进了利用,但其业绩收益往往伴随着较高的执行成本。 我们引入了HarnessPro,一种无标签的方法,用于不断演化的牵引来提高任务性能并同时降低执行成本. 在此情况下,通过LLM生成的测试对候选带进行评估,而无法获得地面真实解决方案或正式测试。 专门人员对执行轨迹进行诊断,根据不同的性能成本优先事项计划更新,并作为候选工具加以实施。 HarnessPro没有返回单一的航道,而是使用正常的加权平方距离选择,为不同的部署预算提供注重成本(升)、平衡(中)和注重绩效(重)的航道。 被选中的牵引器会进入下一个迭代,其中执行反馈指导进一步更新. 我们的实验涵盖Bench 2号终端、SWE-Bench Pro和Program Bench,使用GPT-5.5和Codex,GLM-5.2和Claude Code。 在这些基准中,使用GPT-5.5和Codex,HarnessPro的重型模式平均通过率收益为2.0个百分点,每个任务的平均成本比RHO降低26.1%。 在使用克洛德代码的GLM-5.2时,这种优势也存在. 代码见https://github.com/pzs19/HarnesPro。

articles.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
articles.content: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TokenGate: 适应快速和内存的 LLMs —— 有效预置, 并添加学习的 Token Pruning
articles.content_zh: 专家的读者处理大量投入(例如代码寄存器和长文件),方法是略微只仔细阅读重要的内容。 另一方面,语言模型通过每个模型层处理所有输入符号,因此长文本输入的处理成本很高. 我们引入了TokenGate,这是一个小型的即用组件,它扩展了现有的训练有素的模型,使端到端的可学习符号能够浏览出长的文本输入,用于快速和内存高效的预填. 为了实现端到端的学习,尽管没有区别的上-K运算符来进行象征性的浏览,我们引入了有符号的注意,这个机制由Mixture-of-Experts所启发,利用象征性的重要性分来重新加权注意记录. 在各种任务中,TokenGate实现了1.4-11.3\times的较快时间与第一地标(TTFT)和1.5-3.4\times的较低峰值内存,对于变压器的预填没有精确降解. 相较于前作中表现最优的代币刷新方法,TokenGate放弃了6.4\times$更快的预填和2\times$更低的峰值内存. 键 门自为地延伸出标准变压器(如:Qun3)和混合调取模型(如:Qun3.5),简单的轻量级适应可与标准参数效率的微调相媲美. 我们在https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate提供我们的代码。

articles.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
articles.content: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: recAMPLIFY: 递归蛋白语言模型的大型预训
articles.content_zh: 蛋白质语言模型(pLM)是蛋白质注释和突变效应预测的强大工具,但进展很大程度上依赖于模型大小和数据的缩放,使得模型价格昂贵并容易被记起. 测试时间缩放提供了一条互补路径,但为自递回式LLMs所开发的方法并不直接传输:被遮蔽的编码器缺乏一代循环,氨基酸不会用推理语言口语化. 相反,我们调整了递归性预演,以适应被遮住的pLM,在其中,一个有重力的变形器芯能将残留相通的隐藏状态精炼出可调节的周期数. 我们用ReAMPLIFY来即兴制作这个配方, 这个配有155M独特参数的pLM, 与AMPLIFY-350M一样, 尽管参数少了56%,但它改进了CASP接触恢复和4个监督任务中的3个,主要是将折叠精度提高了22.5%. 由于累加AMPLIFY的最佳深度因任务和化验而异,我们随后引入了Gated Mixture Recurence(GMR),这个框架从复发期间访问的被概率加权混合的隐藏状态中解码出每个蛋白质. GMR在分级,低等或每分解分解时使用一个有学识的剩余门来控制每个周期建议的更新中有多少被接受进入状态. 这统一了停止并成为一个单一的适应性计算目标,同时恢复PonderNet式的停止作为没有门的特殊情况。 在累加AMPLIFY上分层,GMR进一步将预期地层深度降低至37%,尽管准确度的取舍因任务而异. 机械分析表明,残留的地标控制了超过训练有素深度的再生稳定性,并阻止了深度跟踪生物特性。

articles.title: EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition
articles.content: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EpiLens:用于获取流行病学知识的轻量级RAG
articles.content_zh: 为了为将来的爆发做准备,研究人员需要知道已经做了哪些研究以及他们使用哪些数据. 用手绘制出一幅大型文献是缓慢的,而仅大型语言模型就可能错报或拼接出源. 我们提出一个EpiLens,一个轻量级的开源回取增强生成软件包,该软件包将固定回取模板和输出计划应用在一个元件中的每张纸上,并将输出与源段落相链接. 我们从多病原参数研究的源头造出2,297份论文,并对EpiLens的纸张分类工作流程与214份手工标注的论文进行评估。 没有针对具体任务的训练数据,分类人员在四个任务中匹配或超过经过测试的有监督的零射入基线。 该研究的早期取出单为327个估计数引用了已公布的来源. 我们把每项估计与所引述的文件或审查中包括的案卷研究联系起来。 然后,我们用分类器的标签来比较与不同参数和病原体相关的论文. EpiLens将更多的与复制数字相关的论文标注在以模型为基础的死亡率风险上(54%对22%,而手动标签为62%对24%)。 这一差距与经常使用传输模型来估计再生数量是一致的,在比较的5个病原体中,每个病原体都持续存在. 除了参数之间的对比,模型化的与孵化期估计相连接的论文比例因病原体而异:SARS-CoV-2为55%,而mpox为6%.

articles.title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
articles.content: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在重复下复制:从前缀匹配到位置哈兴
articles.content_zh: Frontier LLMS几乎可以完美无缺地复制随机文本,然而它们常常会被重复字符的长块所超越或被截断. 在重复字符串中,匹配的本地内容不再可靠地识别出应该继续复制或应该停止复制的地方. 尽管如此,我们显示一个带有$O(\log\log N)$-bit精度和$O(\log N/\log\log N)宽度的双层变压器可以复制每个字符串到所选择的设计地平线$N$,并在任意重复的情况下正确终止. 我们使用RoPE风格的注意力值和输出旋转(VO-旋转),以小质期来编码与定界锚的距离来调制这些质地. 根据"中国遗存定理",这些周期编码共同区分出所有需要的距离,允许一个检索规则选择下个源令牌或端标. 相反,我们证明,在相继的有限精度软马克斯堆积下复制是宽度独立的不可能结果。 它适用于唯一的位置输入是最终会变常的添加性注意力偏差的变压器,包括无PE和递归性地执行ALi. 双 一旦一个同键跑超过所产生的饱和阈值,再重复会使对数保持不变. 如果这个阈值用$N$子线性地增长,这些模型既不能完成一个长长的全同式复制,也不能正确停止,这个模式类似于边框 LLMs的终止错误. 在合成复制实验中,即使训练范围内,基线变压器模型也会在长长的重复弦上失败. 相形之下,经过训练的VO型号,一般在训练长度以外,精度接近完美,长度可达约5005美元,即所选的素材期产品.

articles.title: HoloCosm: Beyond Single-Metric Benchmark Compression Across Multiple Metrics
articles.content: Benchmark compression reduces evaluation cost by selecting a small set of samples. Existing methods typically guide selection using a single metric, although benchmarks often assess models along multiple dimensions. We find that model rankings are often weakly correlated across metrics, indicating that different metrics capture distinct aspects of model performance. Samples selected for one metric do not reliably preserve scores and rankings on others when used for compressed evaluation. At 80\% compression, each of the five single-metric baselines yields higher reconstruction error than equal-size random sampling in over 70\% of cross-metric comparisons. To address this challenge, we present HoloCosm, which jointly minimizes normalized score-reconstruction error across source models and metrics while constraining ranking distortion. We evaluate HoloCosm across multiple compression rates on 15 language, multimodal, VLA, and agent benchmark configurations with 85 component metrics. With 80\% compression, HoloCosm outperforms Random, the strongest baseline overall: average NMAE drops by 35.3\% to 0.236, worst-component NMAE drops by 39.5\% to 0.330, and average Spearman correlation rises from 0.884 to 0.915. In addition, HoloCosm remains competitive with existing baselines in single-metric evaluation. We will release our code and experimental results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HoloCosm:超过单一计量基准的多计量压缩
articles.content_zh: 基准压缩通过选择一小组样本来降低评价成本. 现行方法通常使用单一的衡量标准来指导选择,尽管基准往往按照多个层面评估模型。 我们发现,模型排名在各种衡量尺度之间往往互不关联,这表明不同的衡量尺度捕捉模型业绩的不同方面。 为一个衡量标准选择的样本在用于压缩评价时,不能可靠地保持分数和对其他分数的排名。 在80+Q压缩时,在70+Q的交叉测量比较中,5个单量基线中的每个都产生比等大小随机抽样更高的重建出错. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出HoloCosm,它共同将源模型和度量衡之间正常的分数重建错误降到最低,同时限制排名扭曲。 我们评价HoloCosm在15种语言、多模式、VLA和具有85个组件度量的代理基准配置上的多重压缩率。 80\%压缩后,"HoloCosm"超越了性能"随机",是总体最强的基准:NMAE平均下降35.3\%到0.236;最差组件NMAE下降39.5\%到0.330;平均斯皮尔曼相关从0.884到0.915. 此外,HoloCosm在单计量评价中仍然与现有基线有竞争力。 我们将发布我们的代码和实验结果。

articles.title: Hierarchical Token Merging with Recursive Autoencoders for Unsupervised Grammar Induction
articles.content: Hierarchical abstraction is a fundamental principle across many data modalities, enabling complex sequences to be represented compositionally at multiple levels. Learning such hierarchies directly from data, without explicit structural supervision, remains a central challenge in representation learning. We investigate whether meaningful hierarchical structure can emerge from compression alone. While autoencoders learn compressed representations through reconstruction, this objective does not necessarily favour meaningful compositional structure. We study this challenge through unsupervised grammar induction, where the underlying hierarchy can be evaluated explicitly. We introduce a hierarchical token-merging autoencoder that recursively combines adjacent tokens into increasingly abstract representations, compressing entire sequences through a variational information bottleneck. The model jointly learns representations and hierarchical structure by marginalising over possible binary trees using dynamic programming. To address training instability, we combine independently trained models through unsupervised consensus and distillation. Experiments on a synthetic, ambiguous grammar demonstrate the emergence of meaningful hierarchical structure without structural supervision. The resulting model achieves 93% grammatical parse-validity and 93% exact reconstruction on held-out sequences, compared with 42% parse-validity for the strongest trivial baseline. These findings establish a proof of concept for hierarchical token merging as a mechanism for unsupervised structure discovery and abstraction learning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与无监督的语法介绍的递归自动编码器合并
articles.content_zh: 分级抽象是跨越许多数据模式的基本原则,使得复杂的序列能够在多层次上以组成方式得到体现. 直接从数据中学习这种等级制度,而没有明确的结构监督,仍然是代表性学习的一个中心挑战。 我们调查的是,仅从压缩中是否能够产生有意义的等级结构。 虽然自定义编码器通过重建来学习压缩表达,但这个目标并不一定有利于有意义的组成结构. 我们通过不受监督的语法诱导来研究这一挑战,在这种诱导中可以明确评价基本的等级。 我们引入了一种等级式的符号聚合自编码器,将相邻的符号递相地结合到越来越抽象的表示中,通过变异信息瓶颈来压缩整个序列. 该模型通过利用动态编程在可能的二进制树上边缘化来共同学习表现和分级结构. 为了解决培训不稳定的问题,我们通过不受监督的共识和提炼,将经过独立培训的模式结合起来。 关于合成,模棱两可的语法的实验表明,有意义的等级结构在没有结构监督的情况下出现. 由此产生的模型在被搁置序列上实现了93%的语法解析无效和93%的精确重建,而在最微小基线上则实现了42%的解析无效。 这些结论确立了一种概念的证明,即等级符号合并作为无监督的结构发现和抽象学习的机制.

articles.title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding
articles.content: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过变相解码的并行语言模型
articles.content_zh: 自动后退语言模型每向前传一次发出一个符号. 这造成了高推论延迟,特别是因为模型在质量上得到了提升。 在本文中,我们引入了平行语言模型(PLMs),通过潜在辅助变量的路由依赖,在一个前行中产生相互一致的符号. PLM使用变异约束进行训练,这种约束会降低到自旋性损失外加平行的解码损失. 经验是,与自递和离散扩散基线相比,PLM在Pareto前沿的速度快和更好。 被预先训练的PLM在80M到3B参数的模型尺度上实现近于自动回放的预训损失,并跟随模型大小的动力定律来加速. 我们的1.3B模型在数学、编码和教学基准上匹配或超过一个同样经过训练的自动递归模型, 我们共同表明,平行一代人可以从一个单一的培训目标中接受自发质量的培训。 我们将在https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm上提供我们的代码。

articles.title: Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing
articles.content: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Rubric内部奖励差异:通过Lentnt维度回收和平衡减轻Rubric Hacking
articles.content_zh: 鲁布里克黑客化限制了在基于名词的强化学习中的性能和培训稳健性. 通过将分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分 从分化的角度来看,我们观察到两个现象:(1) 维度不平衡,导致政策倾向于大量覆盖的维度;(2) 维度缺失,导致报酬与真实质量之间系统性的差距. 为了减轻这些问题,我们提议采用公平率维度聚合法(FDA),在每一维度内各代人进行竞争,以缓解名义上的不平衡;提议采用残余语义维度完成法(RSDC),地雷评估维度在整体偏好信号中隐含地编码,以便完全覆盖。 聊天、科学和医疗领域的实验表明,FRDA通过更稳定的改进减轻了粗略的黑客入侵,而RSDC既优于单倍回报培训,也优于天真多倍回报汇总,产生普遍更高的响应质量。

articles.title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
articles.content: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 哪一种模式的角色? 成本效益 B. 关于LLM代理工作流量的Pareto建议
articles.content_zh: LLM代理工作流程越来越多地为专门角色采用不同的模式. 用户可能倾向于在任务质量和部署费用之间作出不同的权衡,有时也考虑暂时性。 寻找好工作需要与评价多个候选人分开寻找费用。 我们引入了成本计算基廷斯(CC-Gittins),这是对Pareto建议进行单一目标成本认识基廷斯搜索的多目标扩展. 它利用了评价与部署费用之间的结合:部署费用较高的任务也为评价费用高。 搜索在寻求质量更高和部署费用更低之间替代,重新利用每次评价为两次搜索提供信息。 每批之后,CC-Gittins建议在对质量和部署费用进行不确定性调整的估计数下进行非主导性的任务。 我们评价CC-Gittins从工作流程中得出的8个质量成本矩阵,其中2至5个角色,最多1 681个候选人。 我们还将这种方法作为第三个目标来评估。 在八项基准中,CC-Gittins以详尽评估成本的10%左右回收了真实帕雷托边疆的一大部分,并以很少的假阳性回收了大部分边疆。

articles.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
articles.content: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpaceScout:VLM代理可以积极探索并映射出3D相片吗?.
articles.content_zh: 空间情报要求特工人员积极获取视觉证据,将观测纳入三维世界的一致代表. 然而,空间问题回答提供了有限的证据,说明模型是否能够通过自主探索构建准确的计量地图。 我们引入了SpaceScout,这是在活动对象级3D映射上评价视觉语言模型代理的基准. 空间 Scout包含80个不同的室内场景,包含有3,140个目标物体. 鉴于一个物体清单、RGB观测、相机校正和相机姿势,特工控制一个相机,以探索每个场景并在一个共享坐标框架内估计物体中心。 这项任务需要协调观点选择、交叉视图关联、几何估计和在限定的互动预算下对地图的修订。 评价通过对缺失预测进行惩罚的物体级重叠分数,共同衡量本地化准确度和目标覆盖度. 具有前沿VLM的实验揭示出实质性的局限性:最强的被评价模型克洛德·奥普斯·5.5,平均重叠得分为41.71%,47.23%的目标超过交叉结合(IoU)阈值为0.5,只有3.25%超过0.9. 这些结果表明,在恢复粗糙的物体布局和绘制完整、精确的平面图之间存在着很大差距。 SpaceScout为通过活性感知建立可靠的三维空间表示的开发剂提供了定量测试台. 代码见https://github.com/JesseZZZZZZ/SpatialScout。

articles.title: The Development of Sycophancy in Language Models: Tracing Vulnerabilities from Pretraining to Post-Training
articles.content: Language models can change a committed answer to accommodate a user's opinion or pushback without new evidence. However, when this behaviour develops during training and what a released model inherits from earlier stages remain unclear. We follow 741 checkpoints of 30 open model lineages, from early pretraining to released models. We plant initial verdicts on moral scenarios and measure how far a model follows a user's stated opinion or abandons its verdict under pressure. In most lineages the behaviour is present before post-training, and its average strength changes in either direction, at different stages across lineages. A clearer pattern emerges at the level of individual questions. Beyond responses without pressure, pretraining behaviour predicts little of which questions a released model yields on. That pattern forms during post-training: on routes with supervised fine-tuning, the fine-tuning checkpoint predicts part of it and the preference-optimization checkpoint most of it. A sibling trained from the same base along another route predicts far less: for Tülu-3 8B, its own preference-stage checkpoint removes 85% of the remaining prediction error, a sibling 19%. Internal states add predictive information without changing this ranking. Similar average scores conceal different vulnerabilities, and training history matters for auditing a released model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模式的协同发展:追踪从培训前到培训后的脆弱性
articles.content_zh: 语言模型可以改变一个承诺的答案来适应用户的意见,或者在没有新证据的情况下推回. 然而,当这种行为在培训期间发展起来时,以及被释放的模式从早期继承什么,仍然不清楚。 我们遵循741个检查站,其中有30个开放式的模范线路,从早期的预训到释放的模型。 我们设置关于道德假设的初步判断,并衡量一个模型在多大程度上遵循了用户表达的意见或在压力下放弃其判断. 在大多数分系中,行为在训练后出现,其平均强度在两个方向都发生变化,不同分系的不同阶段。 个别问题一级出现了更明确的模式。 除了没有压力的反应外,预训行为预测对释放的模型产生的质疑很少。 这种模式在培训后形成:在经过监督的微调的路线上,微调检查站预测了其中的一部分,以及大多数的优惠优化检查站。 一个来自同一基地的兄弟姐妹在另一条路线上接受训练的预测要少得多:对于Tülu-3 8B来说,它自己的偏好阶段检查点消除了所剩85%的预测错误,一个兄弟的19%. 内部状态在不改变此排名的情况下添加了预测信息. 类似的平均分数掩盖了不同的弱点,为审计一个公布的模式,培训历史问题。

articles.title: From Outcomes to Components: A Counterfactual Evaluation Framework for LLM-Proposed Repairs
articles.content: An LLM-generated repair action specifies which records to change and by how much. A failed action may still contain a useful target set or numerical update, depending on how the two are paired. We evaluate this problem in traffic networks and databases, where aggregate observations obscure the records that need correction. We examine the pairings by executing each combination from the same initial state, using a reference action that restores the affected records. In 76 of 114 traffic actions, the gain from correcting both parts exceeds the sum of the gains from correcting each part alone. Six of these actions become worse after either correction alone, but improve when both parts are corrected. In database repair, replacing only the proposed update with the reference update worsens 17 of 108 model actions, all of which select unaffected records. We also test whether parts of two proposals can be reused. On held-out observations, selecting among the proposals and their recombined target-update pairs recovers 61.6% of the reference action's loss reduction, compared with 58.0% from selecting between the proposals alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从结果到组成部分:LLM拟议修理的反事实评价框架
articles.content_zh: 由 LLM 生成的修复动作指定了哪些记录需要更改并用多少来表示. 失败的动作可能仍然包含一个有用的目标集或数字更新,这取决于两者的配对方式. 我们在交通网络和数据库中评估这一问题,在这些网络和数据库中,综合观察掩盖了需要更正的记录。 我们通过从同一个初始状态执行每个组合来检查配对,使用一个参考动作来恢复受影响的记录. 在114个交通行动中的76个中,纠正两部分的收益都超过了仅更正每一部分的收益之和. 其中6个行动在单独更正后变得更加糟糕,但当两个部分都更正后情况有所改善。 在数据库修复方面,仅以参考更新取代拟议的更新,使108个示范行动中的17个行动恶化,所有示范行动都选择了未受影响的记录。 我们还检验是否可以重新利用两项建议的部分内容。 根据搁置意见,在建议书中选择和重新组合的目标更新对子可收回参考行动减少损失的61.6%,而仅在建议书之间选择的则为58.0%。

articles.title: When the harness decides success: state that cannot be re-observed
articles.content: Agent harnesses decide what a language model sees across turns: they drop old turns, summarize them, or replay the model's own earlier reasoning. We ask when these choices change whether an agent succeeds, not only what it costs, and report three findings. First, in a pre-registered synthetic probe, truncating the context window costs a low-cost reasoning model nothing in success when a needed fact can be looked up again (it looks the fact up instead), but drops its success to chance when the fact cannot be re-observed: the two penalties differ by 92.5 percentage points (90% CI [89.5, 95.5]). A pre-registered replication on one model from a second provider showed the same contrast. Once the fact was lost, that model chose no answer rather than guessing. Second, on ARC-AGI-3, where the benchmark's Standard harness trails its Provider Adapter harness by a wide margin, we decompose that gap one component at a time, for one model on four games. Summarizing old turns instead of dropping them, while keeping the Standard harness's invitation to take notes, recovers 86% of a 63-point gap without replaying the model's reasoning. The same harness without the invitation recovers 43%, and adding the provider's native replay of the model's reasoning recovers the remaining 57%. These are point estimates from one counted run per configuration and game, and the replay share depends on a single run. Third, in the benchmark's published runs and in ours, the Adapter's advantage in the probability of clearing a level it has reached is larger at deep levels than at early ones. This largely restates where runs stopped and does not separate a growing advantage from a constant one.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当吊带决定成功时:不能重新观察的状态
articles.content_zh: Agent tapes决定一个语言模型所看到的是交叉转折:它们放下了旧转折,总结了它们,或者重放模型自己早期的推理. 我们问这些选择何时改变一个代理人是否成功,而不仅仅是其代价,并报告三项调查结果。 首先,在预先注册的合成探测器中,断开上下文窗口会花费一个低成本推理模型,当一个需要的事实可以再次被查取时(它将事实向上看)没有任何成功,但当事实无法被重新观察时,它的成功率会降到机会:两起罚则相差92.5个百分点(90% CI [89.5,955]). 第二家供应商在一个模型上预先登记的复制也显示出同样的对比。 一旦失去事实,那个模型选择了没有答案而不是猜测. 其次,在ARC-AGI-3上,在基准的"标准"(Standard's language)利用它提供方的"适应器"(Providers Adapter)的利用率大相径庭的地方,我们一次将这个缺口一个组件分解,用于四个游戏的一个模型. 总结出旧的转折而不是丢掉,虽然保留了"标准"的取出笔记的邀请,但收回了63分相差的86%,而没有重放模型的推理. 没有邀请的同一种取材机回收了43%,并添加了提供商对模型推理的本土回放恢复了剩余的57%. 这些是每个配置和游戏一个计数运行的分数估计,重播份额取决于一个运行. 第三,在基准公布的运行量和我们的运行量中,适应者在清除其达到的某一水平的概率方面的优势在深度水平上大于早期水平。 这在很大程度上重复了停止运行之处,并没有将不断增长的优势与恒定优势分开。

articles.title: Conducting Reliable Keyword Estimation with Unreliable ASR in Police Audio Data
articles.content: Extracting insights from large audio data sets using human transcription is expensive and time-consuming. Off-the-shelf Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems offer an easy-to-use scalable alternative, but systematic transcription errors, especially in domain-specific settings, can bias downstream analyses and lead to unreliable conclusions. We investigate whether imperfect ASR transcripts can still be used to obtain statistically valid keyword frequency estimates by combining model outputs with a small set of human-labeled examples, following Prediction Powered Inference and Design-based Supervised Learning frameworks. We evaluate this approach on police radio communications from Baltimore and Chicago, a domain in which keyword distributions could provide valuable insights into police activity, but off-the-shelf ASR systems exhibit systematic errors on operationally important terminology. Using bootstrap-based confidence interval coverage as our evaluation metric, we find that our approach substantially increases the number of domain-specific keywords that can be analyzed with statistically valid confidence intervals, from 43.0% using ASR alone and 27.2% using only a small set of human-labeled transcriptions to 56.2% in the Baltimore dataset, with similar improvements observed in Chicago data. Our results demonstrate that post-hoc error correction can improve statistical validity of downstream analyses even for poor-quality transcriptions, offering an avenue for better leveraging off-the-shelf ASR models for large-scale speech analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在警方音频数据中使用不可靠的ASR进行可靠的关键词估计
articles.content_zh: 利用人类的抄录从大型音频数据集中提取真知灼见既昂贵又费时. 现成的自动语音识别(ASR)系统提供了一个易于使用的可伸缩的可选方法,但系统化的转录错误,特别是在特定域的设置中,会偏向下游分析,并导致不可靠的结论. 我们调查是否仍然可以利用不完善的ASR记录稿,按照预测强力推论和基于设计的监督学习框架,将模型输出与少量人类标注的例子合并,以获得统计上有效的关键词频率估计。 我们对巴尔的摩和芝加哥的警察无线电通信采用这种方法进行评价,在这个领域中,关键词的分发可以提供对警察活动的宝贵见解,但现成的ASR系统在业务上重要的术语上却出现了系统性的错误。 我们用基于靴子的置信间隔覆盖作为我们的评估尺度,发现我们的方法大大增加了可用统计上有效的置信间隔分析的域名关键词的数量,从43.0%只使用ASR,27.2%只使用一小组人名标记的抄录到巴尔的摩数据集的56.2%,芝加哥数据也有类似的改进. 我们的结果显示,事后误差校正可以提高下游分析的统计有效性,即使是对质量差的抄录,为更好地利用现成的ASR模型进行大规模语音分析提供了一个途径。

articles.title: BERT Is Already a Denoiser: Cheaply Unlocking Iterative Generation in Masked Language Models
articles.content: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT are typically used for representation learning despite their denoising pretraining. We test whether this capability supports conditional generation without diffusion training. Our decoder repeatedly predicts masked tokens and commits high-confidence predictions using a cosine schedule. It requires no diffusion timestep or reverse-diffusion objective. Frozen BERT already exhibits substantial denoising capability, reconstructing 61.0%, 37.5%, and 24.4% of masked tokens at 15%, 45%, and 60% corruption, respectively, although generation deteriorates sharply as visible context disappears. This capability alone does not yield task-directed generation: frozen BERT reaches only 11.0% on ARC-Easy and 4.2% on MMLU. Ordinary MLM adaptation, however, rapidly converts the same architecture into a usable generator. Full adaptation reaches 28.2% and 24.6%, respectively, while parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces unmatched outputs. On open-ended conditional generation, full MLM adaptation reaches BLEU/ROUGE-L of 0.163/0.583 on QQP and 0.107/0.327 on Quasar-T, placing it in the same broad performance range as published BERT models trained through diffusion without explicit diffusion training. Finally, applying the same generative interface to stronger masked representations substantially improves performance: RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy and 33.8% on MMLU. These results separate three components of masked iterative generation: pretraining supplies the representation and denoising operator, task adaptation determines what the model generates, and an iterative commitment rule supplies the decoding process. Explicit diffusion training is therefore not necessary to obtain effective iterative conditional generation from pretrained MLMs in the settings studied here.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BERT 已经是一个 Denoiser : 廉价的解锁移位模式
articles.content_zh: 假面语言模型(MLMs),如BERT,通常用于代表学习,尽管其取消预训。 我们测试这种能力是否支持不经过传播培训的有条件生成。 我们的解码器反复预测被遮住的活物,并使用同位素时间表进行高自信的预测. 它不需要扩散时间步或逆向扩散目标。 冰冻的BERT已经显示出很大的解密能力,重建了61.0%、37.5%和24.4%的蒙面标志,分别是15%、45%和60%的腐败,尽管随着可见环境的消失,世代急剧恶化。 这种能力本身并不产生任务导向生成:冷冻BERT在ARC-Easy上只达到11.0%,在MMLU上达到4.2%. 然而,普通的MLM适应能将同一种架构迅速转换为可使用的生成器. 全面适应分别达到28.2%和24.6%,而参数效率高的适应大幅减少了未匹配的产出。 在无限制的有条件生成时,完全的MLM适应在QQP上达到0.1663/0.583的BLEU/ROUGE-L,在Quasar-T上达到0.107/0.327的BLEU/ROUGE-L,将其置于与公布的BERT模型相同的广泛性能范围,通过传播培训而未经过明确的传播培训. 最后,将同样的基因界面应用于更强的被遮掩的表达方式,大大提高了性能:RoBERTa-大在ARC-Easy上达到44.2%,在MMLU上达到33.8%. 这些结果将蒙面迭代生成的三个组成部分分开:预训提供表示和去名接线员,任务调整决定模型生成什么,迭代承诺规则提供解码过程. 因此,在此处研究的环境下,不需要通过事先经过培训的MLM进行明确的传播培训,以获得有效的迭代条件生成。

articles.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Cost-Aware Metric for Evaluating Iterative LLM Jailbreaks
articles.content: Attack success rate (ASR) evaluates jailbreaks against large language models without accounting for repeated calls to the victim model. Yet each additional call gives the deployed system another opportunity to detect the attack and intervene. We introduce $\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}}$, which penalizes additional victim-model calls while retaining binary success judgments. Our evaluation considers GCG~\cite{zou2023universal}, PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking} with a step budget, and a single-step PAP~\cite{zeng2024johnny} baseline on JailBreakBench across three model families. GCG's scores decrease by 7.0--8.7 percentage points after discounting, while PAP's remain unchanged. While for PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}, we see a wider discounting range between 3.4-12 percentage points, showing that the "step" quantity differs per iterative strategy. Reporting both metrics makes the discount due to repeated victim-model interaction explicit. Code is available \hyperlink{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/beyond_asr}{here}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 《超越攻击成功率:评价惯性LLM的成本效益计量》 监狱破裂
articles.content_zh: 攻击成功率(ASR)对大型语言模型的越狱行为进行了评价,但没有考虑到多次向受害人模型发出呼吁。 然而每次额外的呼叫都给部署的系统提供了又一次机会来侦测攻击并进行干预. 我们引入 $\ mathrm{ ASR\ mathrm{ STEP}$, 惩罚更多受害者模式的呼叫, 我们的评价认为 GCG-cite{zou2023Universal},PAIR-cite{chao2025jailbreak}带有一个步骤预算,以及一个单步骤的PAP-~\cite{zeng2024johny}在三个模范家庭的JailBreak Bench上的基线。 GCG的分数在打折后下降了7.0-8.7个百分点,而PAP的分数则保持不变. 而对于PAIR-cite{chao2025jailbreating}来说,我们看到一个在3.4-12个百分点之间的更宽的折现范围,表明"步"数量在每一次迭接策略上有所不同. 两种衡量标准都表明,由于受害者与模型的反复互动,折扣是明确的。 代码可用\超链接{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/ beyond_asr}{here}.

articles.title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting
articles.content: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReAnchor: 将被拒绝的核查国用于扩散起草
articles.content_zh: 块扩散起草器通过在一次前传中生成多个草稿令牌来加速投机解码. 然而,每次通过只从一个目标产生的锚上产生一个固定长块,从而限制了草案可以延伸多远. 与此同时,目标核查计算出隐藏状态,甚至在第一次拒绝之后的位置,但这些状态通常被丢弃,而不是被再利用。 我们提出ReAnchor,一种无训练方法,利用被废弃的核查状态,在转出的位置上将一个事先训练过的起草者重新锁定,生成平行的区块草稿。 这些区块改进了原区块内的预测并扩展了覆盖范围,超越了它的终点. 在T=0的采样温度下,ReAnchor在Gemma 4-12B上实现了最大平均增益,将接受时间延长了19.4%,分出8个基准的解码速度提高了17.9%. 平均平均在4个目标模型和8个基准上,通过预先训练的DFlash起草器,将接受长度提高了15.2%,解码速度提高了13.4%。

articles.title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多教师政策扭曲的渔-地测量视图
articles.content_zh: 将专业基础模型整合为统一的通论者是后培训的中心目标. 两种方法是常用的:模式合并(模式合并速度快,但被视为一种heuristic)和多教师政策蒸馏(多教师政策蒸馏),它们匹配分布,但需要大量推出计算,并有跨任务梯度冲突. 我们显示,两者是在不同命令中看到的一个目标。 在一个共同的同源专家盆地内,多教师政策提炼的目标,第二顺序是,正是费舍尔-合并的目标。 因此它的最小化是费舍尔合并(Fisher),是一种由专家的闭合式组合给出的经典的模型-并发法,所以合并是最佳的到第二顺序,作为蒸馏的闭合式阶段. 根据这一认定,我们提议采用两阶段合并程序 -- -- 余留事项治理处和小组。 具体来说,一个完整的参数费舍尔合并在基础模型上是难以解决的,因此Phase~1将合并限制在任务执行子空间. 扩展合并的切入空间分析,我们显示,混合任务向量的相同系数也混合了隐含的回报,这使得一个未加标签的提示上的剩余程序能够解决它们. 程序将每个域中最差的残基最小化,并报告其能常值为域后遗谱. Phase~2 让这个频谱规范可以添加的: RGBM钝化了低常态残基域,仅为光谱缺口上方域而列车孤立分支,并用校正收缩来回写所接受的更新. 在两个开源合并套件上,Phase~1合并单独匹配或超越了训练有素的多教师蒸馏,RGBM则以零附加联合训练步骤来进一步改进,而每个未加配的回写,包括继续从合并中联合蒸馏,则会低于它.

articles.title: RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing
articles.content: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 路由器世界:与 Latency-Aware LLM 进行对谈的AI 路线
articles.content_zh: 在"大语言模型"(LLMs)上所构建的有争议AI系统需要有路由机制,在规模上平衡答答质量和响应延迟. 然而,现有的LLM路由基准假定所有候选模式结果都完全可观察,未充分强调作为一等尺度的耐久性,并且将不同协议的评估与现实世界的环境错配。 我们引入了路由器世界,这是对话GenAI中LLM路由的综合基准. 路由器世界统一371k单回转响应和76k多回转代理轨迹,采用与标准化的LLM-as-judge协议的自然用户交互,并通过以硬件为基底的后置说明将效率与瞬态定价脱钩. 关键的是,路由器World通过两个设置将部分可观察性下的路由正规化:Cold-Start将学习限制在稀少的静态日志上;而Voyager则对连续数据流进行模型化,其中路由决定会塑造未来的培训分布. 评估13个路由基线,我们发现,大多数路由器都过分强调准确性,而忽略了部分可观察性的延迟. 守则和基准数据可供公开查阅。

articles.title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Preference Reward Models with Evolving Penalties
articles.content: Reinforcement learning for language models has moved from preference reward models to verifiable rewards, which sustain much longer optimization. Preference models are prone to reward hacking: the policy raises their score without improving response quality, or even while degrading it. Yet for open-ended tasks, where quality can neither be verified nor fully written down as rubrics, they remain valuable. We introduce Dynalize, which mitigates reward hacking online, during policy training. Periodically and asynchronously, a language model analyzes training rollouts and writes penalties for undesirable behaviors that the reward model appears to reward; a judge applies them to every rollout. In clinical counseling and creative writing, training on the reward model alone raises its score continuously but ultimately leads to a decline in external benchmarks. Dynalize sustains longer training and results in improved downstream performance. For example, we find that our method suppresses patterns incentivized by preference models that, without penalties, spread to most responses, and even to the model's reasoning, which the reward model does not explicitly score. Furthermore, we show that its gains hold in multi-turn training, and even after we retrain the reward model on the discovered behaviors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 减轻对有变化处罚的优惠奖励模式的收视率
articles.content_zh: 对语言模式的强化学习已经从优惠奖励模式转向可核查的奖励,这维持了更长的优化. 偏好模式容易被奖励黑客:政策提高他们的分数而不提高反应质量,甚至贬低反应质量. 然而,对于无法核实质量或无法将质量完全记为标题的开放式任务,这些任务仍然很有价值。 我们引入了Dynalize, 它减轻奖励在线黑客, 在政策培训。 一个语言模型定期和同步地分析培训的推出,并写出奖赏模型似乎奖励的不良行为的惩罚;法官在每次推出时都应用这些方法。 在临床咨询和创造性写作方面,仅关于奖励模式的培训不断提高其分数,但最终导致外部基准下降。 Dynalize使培训持续时间更长,提高了下游的业绩。 例如,我们发现,我们的方法压制了各种模式,这些模式被优惠模式所激励,这些模式在没有惩罚的情况下传播到大多数响应,甚至到模型的推理上,而奖励模式没有明确得分. 此外,我们表明,它的收益体现在多轮培训,甚至在我们重新培训关于所发现行为的奖励模式之后。

articles.title: Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes
articles.content: Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion. Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 力量控制如何改变干预措施 比较整个 Sparse 自动编码码
articles.content_zh: 改变稀有自编码器(SAE)代码既可以改变干预方向,也可以改变规模,因此比较干预效果需要强力控制,具体说明持有的等同内容. 规范匹配和输出校正提供了不同的控制,但是在强度匹配之后,干预措施是否在代码之间产生不同的效果仍然不清楚. 我们比较这些控制下对Gemma和Llama固定特征组的干预效果,并观察到: (1)全平面缩放. 用每个输入一个系数,完全输出Kullback-Leibler(KL)校正使得基于编码器的参考干预产生的平均效果差距比非负最小平方(NNLS)的正比值更小. 在新的Llama输入中,总标准匹配损失了11个参考转让,而全输出校正则保留了每个转让决定。 (2) 位置缩放。 在一个小的匹配的性别协议子集上,位置标准匹配比完全输出校正所观察到的平均差距要小。 (3) 答案排除。 与未分级的NNLS相比,解答被排除的校正缩小了所计量的主题-动词协议比较的差距,但因性别调整而增加了差距. 完全输出的KL校正也缩小了标准匹配的构造候选者的较大缺口,尽管在几个场合的匹配覆盖不完整. 由于校正使用了所评价的投入的产出,因此可以诊断残余的分歧。

articles.title: AfriGuard: Safety and Robust Refusal For African Languages
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) designed to interact with users are typically trained to respond appropriately to harmful or toxic content. However, ensuring appropriate responses becomes more challenging in diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, where safety risks may be expressed or interpreted differently. Building safe AI systems therefore requires detecting safety risks, understanding their nature, and responding appropriately, while accounting for linguistic and cultural variations that add complexity to each stage. In this work, we introduce AfriGuard, a culturally grounded multilingual dataset for studying harmful intent, safety-category understanding, and refusal behavior across 10 African languages and English. Our findings reveal that guardrail models underperform both open- and closed-source LLMs on safety-intent and safety-category classification, while models show limited understanding of appropriate safety behavior, scoring below 60% F1. We further find that models often fail to respond appropriately to unsafe prompts not because they explicitly refuse, but because they produce linguistically inadequate responses that result in incidental non-assistance rather than proper refusals. Finally, using AfriGuard, we develop efficient guardrail models that achieve performance competitive with models up to 30x larger, introduce refusal detectors that improve average performance by 43.9% over existing detectors, and demonstrate that supervised fine-tuning can substantially improve overall safety performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 非洲荷兰语:非洲语言的安全和坚决拒绝
articles.content_zh: 旨在与用户互动的大型语言模型(LLMS)一般都接受过针对有害或有毒内容的适当反应的培训. 然而,在不同的语言和文化背景下,确保适当的应对措施更具挑战性,在这种背景下,安全风险可能会得到不同的表达或解释。 因此,建立安全的人工智能系统需要发现安全风险,了解其性质并作出适当反应,同时考虑语言和文化差异,这些差异增加了每个阶段的复杂性。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了非洲荷兰语,这是一个基于文化的多语种数据集,用于研究10种非洲语言和英语的有害意图、安全类别理解和拒绝行为。 我们的调查结果显示,护卫模型在安全意图和安全类别分类方面都表现不佳,而模型显示对适当安全行为的了解有限,评分低于60%的F1。 我们进一步发现,模型往往未能对不安全的提示作出适当的反应,不是因为它们明确拒绝,而是因为它们在语言上反应不足,导致附带不援助,而不是适当的拒绝。 最后,我们使用AfriGuard开发了高效的护卫模型,这些模型能与30x更大的模型实现性能竞争,引入了拒绝探测器,比现有的探测器提高了43.9%的平均性能,并证明有监督的微调可以大大地提高整体安全性能.

articles.title: Training Negatives Still Matter After Calibrating Answerability Readouts
articles.content: Answerability readouts predict whether a passage supplies an answer, but whether calibration can compensate for removing negative passages during training remains unclear. We present a controlled study of how training-negative construction affects calibrated prediction, ranking, and downstream answer retention. We compare native training, which retains negative passages, with empty training, which removes them, holding questions, labels, positive examples, and model weights fixed. Both are calibrated on the same labeled native examples. On SQuAD 2.0 and RepLiQA, native-trained logistic readouts at selected depths achieve lower Brier loss for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-it, with or without output scores. Native fusion also outperforms calibrated output alone. Post-hoc AUROC analysis shows better ranking under native training, beyond what threshold adjustment alone can explain. On the official SQuAD 2.0 development set, native readout policies improve F1 over empty policies but retain more answers to unanswerable questions. The advantage varies by estimator and depth, while RepLiQA's text shortcuts limit claims about contextual understanding. Unfinished generations prevent complete answer-level evaluation, although worst-case bounds preserve the native-empty F1 gains. Our findings show that training negatives affect ranking and downstream decisions even after common calibration, without establishing a universal advantage for native training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 校准可答性后培训负面因素仍然重要
articles.content_zh: 可回答读取预言通道是否提供答案,但校准能否补偿去除训练期间的负面通道,仍不清楚. 我们提出了一个关于培训-负式建筑如何影响校准预测、排名和下游答案保留的控制性研究。 我们比较了本土训练,保留了负面的段落,与去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去 两者都在同一被标注的本土例子上校正. 在SQuAD 2.0和RepLiQA上,在所选深度的本土训练后勤读取能为Quen2.5-7B-Instruct和Gemma-2-9B-it实现较低的Brier损失,无论是否输出分数. 原生聚变也仅能超过校正输出. hoc后AUROC分析显示,在本土培训下,排名更好,超出了仅靠阈值调整就可以解释的范围. 在官方的SQuAD 2.0开发集上,本土读取政策比空政策改进了F1,但保留了更多无法回答问题的答案. 其优势因估计和深度而异,而RepLiQA的文本快捷方式限制了对背景理解的主张. 未完成的几代人阻止了完整的解答级评价,尽管最坏的情况界限保留了本土空地F1收益. 我们的调查结果表明,培训负面因素影响排名和下游决策,即使在共同校准后,也没有为本土培训确立普遍优势。

articles.title: TeleASR-Amharic: A Benchmark for Robust Amharic ASR in Realistic Telecommunication Conditions
articles.content: The real-world usability of ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages, where existing speech resources are often collected in clean studio environments. In this work, we introduce TeleASR-Amharic, a benchmark for evaluating Amharic ASR under various acoustic and telecommunication conditions. We analyze the major degradations observed in real telecommunications recordings and develop a benchmark that covers multiple channel conditions, environmental disturbances, and telecom-domain variations. Our results show that telecommunication degradation can substantially reduce recognition performance, making even high-performing ASR models impractical under severe conditions. For example, the WER of the best-performing model increases from 0.23 to 0.79 under severe telecommunication degradation, corresponding to a relative increase of 243% in recognition errors. We further investigate the effects of different noise and channel distortions and show that scaling training data and applying carefully designed telecommunication-aware augmentation substantially improve robustness. In particular, our best training configuration achieves a 23.6% relative WER reduction under extreme noise conditions. Together with the release of our telecommunications-domain data, these findings provide a reproducible benchmark for measuring progress in Amharic ASR while highlighting open challenges in developing robust speech technologies for real-world deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TeleASR-阿姆哈拉克: 《现实电信条件下的强大阿姆哈拉ASR基准》
articles.content_zh: ASR模型的现实世界可用性仍然具有挑战性,特别是对资源匮乏的语言而言,在清洁的工作室环境中往往收集到现有的语音资源. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了TeleASR-Amharic,这是在各种声学和电信条件下评价Amharic ASR的基准. 我们分析在真实电信录音中观察到的主要退化情况,并制定一个涵盖多种信道条件、环境扰动和电信领域变化的基准。 我们的结果显示,电信的退化可大大地降低识别性能,使即使是高性能的ASR模型在严峻条件下也变得不切实际. 例如,在严重的电信退化下,表现最好的模型的WER从0.23增加到了0.79,相当于识别错误的相对增加243%. 我们进一步调查不同噪音和信道扭曲的影响,并表明,扩大培训数据的规模和运用精心设计的电信意识增强能大大地提高稳健性。 特别是,我们最好的训练配置在极端噪音条件下实现了相对WER减少23.6%. 这些结论与我们公布的电信领域数据一道,为衡量阿姆哈拉语ASR的进展提供了一个可复制的基准,同时突出了在为实际世界部署开发强有力的语音技术方面的公开挑战。

articles.title: Label Authority in Speech Emotion Recognition: Intended and Perceived Ground Truth in Emozionalmente
articles.content: Ground truth in Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is often presented as a single categorical fact, yet an acted emotion and the emotion heard by listeners describe different aspects of the same recording. We examine this distinction in Emozionalmente, an acted Italian corpus that provides both an elicited production label and five listener judgements for every clip. Using frozen XLS-R, HuBERT, and WavLM representations with matched probes, we compare three label authorities: the expressed condition, the listeners' hard plurality, and their complete vote distribution. The results tell a consistent story. Recovering the expressed condition is easier than predicting a tie-broken listener plurality, but that gap compares two different questions rather than revealing a general loss of SER ability. As listener agreement weakens, the plurality becomes an increasingly brittle hard target. Training on the full vote distribution does not substantially change which class wins the model's hard decision, but it produces probability assignments that more closely follow the alternatives selected by listeners, especially for ambiguous clips. No authority therefore replaces the others. Expressed labels describe how speech was produced, pluralities provide an operational single-class decision, and vote distributions preserve perceptual uncertainty. For human-facing Internet of Sounds applications, evaluations should state which authority is being predicted, retain its aggregation rule and agreement information, and use distributional scores when disagreement is part of the target.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言情感识别中的标签管理局:Emozionalmente的意向和感知地面真相
articles.content_zh: 在"言语情感识别"(SER)中的基础真理常常被呈现为单一的绝对事实,然而一种动作情感和听众所听到的情感却描述了同声录制的不同方面. 我们在《Emozionalmente》中审查了这一区别,这是一份意大利的法案,它为每一段节目提供了引人入胜的制作标签和五个听众的判断。 我们利用被冻结的XLS-R,HuBERT,和WavLM的表示以及相匹配的探测器,比较了三个标签权威:被表达的条件,听众的硬多元性,以及他们完整的投票分布. 结果是一个一致的故事。 恢复表达的状态比预测平分的收听者多元性要容易,但这一差距比较了两个不同的问题,而不是显示普遍丧失了SER能力. 随着听众协议的削弱,多元性成为了越来越微弱的硬目标. 关于全票分配的培训并没有实质性地改变哪个阶层赢得了模型的艰难决定,但它产生了更密切地遵循听众选择的可选选择的概率分配,特别是对于模棱两可的片段. 因此,没有任何权威取代其他权威。 表达的标签描述了语音是如何生成的,复数提供了可操作的单级决定,而选票分配则保留了知觉的不确定性. 对于人造的Sounds应用互联网,评价应说明正在预测哪个权威,保留其汇总规则和协议信息,并在分歧是目标的一部分时使用分配分数。

articles.title: WenSight-Decision-1 for Direct Decisions under E-commerce Rules
articles.content: E-commerce decisions require applying natural-language rules to the available case evidence. We introduce WenSight-Decision-1, a shared model that scores supplied options directly from rules and case information for six operational tasks, with examples spanning six languages. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B with reference options as supervision, using the same option scores for training and inference. On 1,440 synthetic operational cases reserved for final evaluation, accuracy rises from 61.60% for Qwen3.5-9B to 92.92% for WenSight-Decision-1 under identical inputs and scoring. Joint fine-tuning improves all six tasks, bringing heterogeneous operational judgments under a common decision interface.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于电子商务规则下直接决定的温视-决定1
articles.content_zh: 电子商务决定要求对现有案例证据适用自然语言规则。 我们引入了WenSight-Decision-1,一种共享模式,通过规则和案例信息直接为6个业务任务提供选项评分,例子涵盖6种语言. 我们微调了Quen3.5-9B,将参考选项作为监督,在培训和推断时使用相同的选项分数。 在为最后评价保留的1 440个合成作业病例中,精确度从Quen3.5-9B的61.60%上升到了WenSight-Decision-1的92.92%。 联合微调改进了所有六项任务,在共同决策界面下作出了多种多样的业务判断。

articles.title: The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits
articles.content: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理内存的几何: 预测检索- 边界内存失败, 并描述其限制
articles.content_zh: 我们研究对话转折,内存文本,和查询之间的几何关系,是否能够预测生成前的答案正确性. 我们评价4个内存实施情况,同时进行密集或混合检索,以及1个观察-摘要比较。 我们把这些文本嵌入一个共享空间。 物流分类器使用25个功能,描述查询相近性,内存-对话通信,和对话结构. 在LongMemEval-small上,集合的AUROC为0.640对2,367个问题系统对,低于0.655个问题困难基线。 性能因问题类型而异:几何在单会辅助题上达到0.841,而仅系统身份就达到0.826. 在控制困难和身份后,几何学没有增加统计上确定的集合改进(delta = +.002,95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). 固定存储上下文选择实验发现相近排序记忆的精度高于随机子集,符合普通检索相关性. 在"LoCoMo"上,相近倒转的相似性对单跳问题和相近其他几类的相近估计有微小的预测值. 训练使用正确性标签;预测使用预答特性,没有额外的LLM生成调用. 其结果是记忆表达与正确性之间的关联,而不是建立可靠的部署诊断。 特别是,嵌入相近不能验证事实覆盖或区分内存构造、检索和生成错误。

articles.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
articles.content: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it.
