It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HarnessRL:为开放式RL提供适时培训的协同政策
articles.content_zh: 以Rubric为基础的强化学习(RL)为开放的一代培训政策,以自然语言标准作为奖励,但这些奖励随着培训的进展可能会变得无效. 我们找出两种失败模式。 在非歧视性奖励下,由于勘探不足或任务难度与政策能力不匹配,分数跌至一致的低值或高值. 在虚假的奖励下,较高的分数并不对应更好的回应. 两者都反映了一种培训配置,其任务取样、探索和评价随着政策的发展而保持不变。 我们引入了HarnessRL,一种与政策共同演变的训练时间工具,它通过三个接口进行任务取样、推出指导和标点标准。 节奏 RL维持一个训练时间记忆,从中,一个被利用的进化器可以检索任务内的历史和交叉任务的证据. 使用这种证据,进化器将每个奖励失败归结到其更新可以解决的界面上. 然后,它运行一个提议者和及时评论者循环,其中评论者只有在衡量其对目前被冻结政策的影响之后才接受候选人更新,将被拒绝的候选人送回修订。 我们还负责Rubric-Mix-10k,这是一个五大领域培训和评价套件,用于跨越医疗、科学、写作、角色扮演和教学任务,开放的RL。 在Rubric-Mix-10k上,哈内斯 RL在4B和9B模型尺度上比最强的基线高出2.8至3.1分,几乎将培训步骤减半,达到最佳检查站。 代码和数据见https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Quen-Character/tree/main/HarnesRL。

articles.title: SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge
articles.content: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SNO-PI:标签-Scarce SNOMED CT实体 与经过培训的编码器和被破译名知识链接
articles.content_zh: 我们提出SNO-PI,这是截至2026年10月18日SNOMED国际SNOMED的SNOMED CT实体链接基准上表现最出色的呈文. SNO-PI实现宏字符IoU为0.5387,表现优于组织者的参考系统(0.4582;基于2024挑战胜者方法),相对比为18%. 将临床与SNOMED CT联系起来是一个零射出和几射出的问题,因为一个非常大的标签空间:272个附加说明的MIMIC-IV放出摘要只涉及大约219 000个合格概念中的6 595个,其中三分之一只发生一次。 这激发了一种基于从经过预先培训的模型和人性化知识转移而来的设计. SNO-PI将高召跨建议,SapBERT候选取用和列表组合重排与3个BERT-家族编码器,在任务微调前在未加标签的MIMIC-IV音符上再用蒙面语言建模进行进一步预训并再进行SNOMED CT同义词和分级. 我们认为,掌握的知识对培训中从未见过的概念最有帮助,但这些概念仍然是出错的主要原因。

articles.title: Governing the Rule Space. Ruliology, Computational Irreducibility and Anticipatory Governance of Quantum Technologies
articles.content: The regulation of emerging technologies is often conceived as a strategy of catching up, because legislators arrive too late. Yet gathering signals, constructing scenarios and adapting rules to an anticipated future are fundamental tasks for those entrusted with governance, including the governance of rules themselves. The literature on so-called future law has already shown that anticipation means building institutional capabilities rather than predicting outcomes precisely (anticipatory governance). Taking this premise as its starting point, this article proposes to understand regulation as an exploration of the transformations that may occur. The Ruliological Framework for Anticipatory Regulation distinguishes rules, transformations and trajectories, assessing alternatives and possible developments. Within this approach, computational irreducibility is adopted conditionally, not as a demonstrated property of legal systems. The Quantum Europe Strategy provides a case study and further grounds for reflection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 《规则空间》。 量子技术的流利、计算和预期治理
articles.content_zh: 对新兴技术的监管常常被认为是一种赶超策略,因为立法者来得太晚. 然而,收集信号、构建设想情景并调整规则使之适应预期的未来,是那些负责治理的人的基本任务,包括规则本身的治理。 关于所谓未来法律的文献已经表明,预期意味着建立机构能力,而不是精确预测结果(预期治理)。 本条以这一前提为出发点,提议将监管理解为对可能发生的转变的探索. 《预测性管理框架》区分了规则、转变和轨迹,评估了替代办法和可能的发展。 在这种方法中,计算不可减少性是有条件的,而不是作为证明的法律制度财产。 《量子欧洲战略》提供了案例研究和进一步思考的理由。

articles.title: Self-Consistency of Entity Sets and Citations in a Deep Research System under Repeated Prompting
articles.content: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重复提示的深层研究系统中实体设置和引用的自相容性
articles.content_zh: 深层研究剂(DRA)通常用于开放式的合成任务,其中闭合世界质量评估基准不适合描述性能的相关方面. 我们研究一个商业深层研究系统的自我一致性, 重复同样的提示, 代表每个报告与它提到的一组命名的实体, 分类为定制计划, 通过重复运行一个与网络安全有关的单一无限制的快件,我们用成对重叠进行量化,以说明在重复的相同快件下检索和合成的产出结构的稳定性。 在10跑中,对等实体Jaccard的中位数为0.12,对等引号Jaccard低于0.02,发现曲线不明显饱和. 实体组合之间(dis)协议的大小和结构因实体类别而异,这表明在DRA中自我一致性被更好的理解为基础实体空间的函数而不是系统的稳定属性.

articles.title: Co-Evolving Policy and Reward for Code Generation: A Mechanistic Study of Single-Adapter Drift
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is particularly well suited to code generation because generated programs can be objectively evaluated through execution. Execution also provides behavioral information that can be reused as additional supervision. The Synergistic Policy and Reward Co-Evolving Framework (SPARK), originally proposed for reasoning tasks, exploits this idea by recycling training rollouts and their evaluation results to train a model not only to generate solutions but also to evaluate and improve them. We investigate whether this policy-reward co-evolution approach transfers effectively to code generation and whether execution-grounded reflection provides an additional source of self-improvement. We compare SPARK-style rollout recycling with execution-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct. Our results do not support either hypothesis under the configuration tested. Although co-evolution improves training performance, these gains do not generalize to held-out problems. Compared at the same stage of training, rollout recycling produces roughly 34x greater KL divergence from the reference policy than execution-only GRPO. Over training, trained tokens per GRPO sequence fall from 185 to 86 as training pass rate increases, while held-out performance declines or fails to sustain early gains. We characterize these patterns as single-adapter policy drift: the shared trainable parameters increasingly depart from pretrained code-generation behavior without corresponding gains in generalization. The results show that higher training reward alone is not evidence of generalizable code self-improvement and highlight the importance of held-out evaluation and drift diagnostics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 共同制定政策和奖励守则生成:对单梯漂流的机械研究
articles.content_zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)特别适合代码生成,因为生成的程序可以通过执行进行客观的评价. 执行还提供行为信息,可以被再用作为额外的监督. 最初为推理任务而提出的协同政策和奖励共同演变框架(SPARK)通过回收培训的推出及其评价结果来利用这一想法来培训一个模式,不仅生成解决方案,而且对其进行评价和改进。 我们调查这种政策奖励的共同演变方法是否有效地转移到代码生成上,以及基于执行的反思是否为自我改进提供了又一来源。 我们比较SPARK式的推出回收与只执行组相对政策优化(GPRO)使用Quen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct. 根据测试的配置,我们的结果不支持这两种假设。 虽然共同演变可以提高培训绩效,但这些成果并没有被概括为被搁置的问题。 与同一培训阶段相比,推出回收与参考政策之间的KL差异大约为34倍,而仅执行GPRO。 培训结束后,随着培训合格率的提高,每批GRPO中接受培训的标志从185个降至86个,而被扣留的成绩则会下降或无法维持早期的成果。 我们把这些模式定性为单一适应政策漂移:共享的可训练参数越来越偏离预先训练的代码生成行为,而没有相应的通化收益. 结果显示,仅靠更高的培训奖励并不能证明可通用的代码自我改进,并强调了坚持评价和漂移诊断的重要性。

articles.title: Where Does Rhetorical Distortion Live? A Multi-Platform, Multi-Language Measurement of Influencer Content
articles.content: Much of the manipulation in online influencer content is not false but disproportionate: an accurate fact is framed as historic, urgent, or catastrophic. Fact-checking and clickbait detection are not designed to capture such framing, and little is known about where it originates: with the creator, the topic, the platform, or the audience that replies. We operationalize rhetorical distortion through five literature-grounded dimensions (Significance Inflation, Anxiety Manufacturing, Novelty Claims, Loaded Language, and Temporal Distortion) and measure it with a three-tier pipeline in which bilingual lexical rules propose candidates, negative filters cancel known false-positive contexts, and an LLM verifies or relabels the candidates. Applying the pipeline to 13,060 posts from 330 accounts on six platforms (RSS/newsletters, YouTube, Bluesky, Reddit, Weibo, and X/Twitter), we find that platform is far more strongly associated with account-level distortion than content category (Kruskal-Wallis $\varepsilon^2=0.33$; two-way ANOVA $η_p^2=0.49$ for platform vs. $0.09$ for category). X/Twitter scores highest (DI 7.74 vs. 0.78 for RSS). Classifying tweets and their replies separately shows where this comes from: the reply layer readers see under a post (its top-5 replies) carries 3.5x the distortion of the tweet it answers (7.65 vs. 2.17, $p<10^{-6}$, 36 of 43 accounts), driven by Loaded Language. At equal text length the gap shrinks to 1.5x but remains significant, and creator tweets alone are statistically indistinguishable from YouTube and Bluesky. Two independent human annotators confirm the reply gap, and the platform ordering and the reply gap replicate with GPT-4o as a second classifier. On threaded platforms, measured distortion thus lives largely in the audience layer, which motivates measurement that separates creator and reply text.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Rhetorical Distortion Live? 瑞多克·德·德·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克·克 影响内容的多平台、多语言测量
articles.content_zh: 网络影响者内容的操纵并不是虚假的,而是不相称的:准确的事实被描述为历史性、紧迫或灾难性的。 事实检查和点击bait检测并不是用来捕捉这样的设定,对于其起源地也鲜为人知:与创造者,主题,平台,或回答的受众. 我们通过五个基于文献的维度(显著通货膨胀、焦虑制造、小说索赔、装填语言和临时扭曲)来实施言辞扭曲,并用一个三级管道加以衡量,在这个管道中,双语词汇规则提出候选人,负面过滤器取消已知的虚假背景,以及LLM验证或重新给候选人贴上标签。 将管道应用于6个平台(RSS/newsletters、YouTube、Bluesky、Reddit、微博和X/Twitter)的330个账户中的13 060个员额,我们认为该平台与账户层次的扭曲关系远比内容类别更密切(Kruskal-Wallis $\varepsilon ^2=0.33美元;平台双向ANOVA $\\p^2=0.49美元对类别为0.09美元)。 X/Twitter得分最高(RSS的DI 7.74对0.78). 校对:Soup 与YouTube和Bluesky相比, 微博本身在统计学上是无法区分的。 两个独立的人名注释器证实了回复漏洞,平台订购和回复漏洞以GPT-4o为第二分类器复制. 在有线的平台上,测量到的扭曲因此主要生活在观众层中,这激发了将创作者和回复文本分开的测量.

articles.title: Expert L2 English Speech Evaluation on a Gaming PC: Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody with XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus
articles.content: oollim is a locally executable system for evaluating L2 English pronunciation accuracy, fluency, and prosody on a consumer computer. The system combines pretrained XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus representations with reference-text features and ridge regressions trained on SpeechOcean762, the Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus (English), J-AESOP, and their combinations. On 305 independently held-out recordings assessed by three expert raters, several ridge configurations substantially outperform archived Azure API scores obtained in January 2026 in both Spearman correlation and quadratic weighted kappa across all three constructs. These results support expert speech evaluation on consumer hardware using pretrained representations and construct-specific regressions, without neural-model fine-tuning or calibration on the private evaluation data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 专家L2英语演讲评价 游戏个人电脑:精确度、流利度和Prosody与XLS-R、XEUS和PhoneticXeus
articles.content_zh: oollim是一个当地可执行的系统,用于评价L2英语发音的准确性,流利性,以及消费计算机上的发音. 该系统结合了预训XLS-R,XEUS,和PhoneticXeus表示法与参考文本特征和脊回向法,SpeechOcean762,韩语学习者L2 Speech Corpus(英语),J-AESOP,及其组合. 在3名专家评分员评估的305次独立保存的录音中,几个山脊配置的成绩大大超过2026年1月在斯皮尔曼关联和四相加权卡帕三种构造中获得的Azure API分数。 这些结果支持使用预先训练的表示和构造特定回归,对消费者硬件进行专家语音评价,而不对私人评价数据进行神经模型微调或校正。

articles.title: LaMER: Language-Conditioned Multi-Expert Routing for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
articles.content: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) localizes the image region described by a natural language expression, underpinning applications such as autonomous navigation, human-robot interaction, and medical image analysis. Under weak supervision, REC is challenged by the visual-linguistic semantic gap and the difficulty of inferring region-text correspondences from coarse image-level signals alone. Moreover, no single visual encoder captures all complementary properties---semantic alignment, fine-grained texture, and boundary awareness---while naively fusing multiple pretrained encoders yields heterogeneous, hard-to-reconcile representations. We propose LaMER, a weakly supervised REC framework that dynamically aggregates four frozen expert encoders through a language-conditioned Cross-Modal Routing Fusion module, adapting expert selection to each referring expression without instance-level bounding-box supervision. A Cell-Text Matching Head with Negative Anchor Augmentation, trained with a multi-objective loss combining contrastive, reconstruction, alignment, and load-balancing terms, further stabilizes optimization. LaMER achieves 77.67\%, 62.81\%, and 69.49\% Acc@IoU\(\geq 0.5\) on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg, surpassing DViN and WeakMCN by up to 16.49 and 14.49 points, with ablations validating each component.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LaMER:针对弱监督的参考表达理解语言的多专家程序
articles.content_zh: 参考表达理解(REC)将自然语言表达所描述的图像区域本地化,支持自主导航,人与机器人交互,医学图像分析等应用. 在薄弱的监管下,REC受到视觉-语言语义差距的挑战,以及仅从粗糙的图像级信号推断出区域-文本对应的难度. 此外,没有单一的视觉编码器能捕捉到所有互补的属性-语义对齐,精细的纹理和边界意识-同时天真地引信多发被预先训练的编码器,产生出多样的,难以调和的表示. 我们建议LaMER, 一个受弱监督的REC框架, 通过一个语言条件化的 Cross-Modal Routing Fusion 模块, 动态地聚合四个被冻结的专家编码器, 细胞-图案匹配头与负Anchor增强相匹配,经过多目标损失的训练,结合了对比性,重建,对接,和负载平衡等术语,进一步稳定了优化. LaMER在RefCOCO,RefCO+,和RefCOCOg上实现了77.67分,62.81分和69.49分,超过DViN和WowerMCN最高16.49分和14.49分,每个组件的分数都验证.

articles.title: How Benchmark Graph Construction Shapes Multi-Hop KG Navigation: A Controlled Audit of PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large
articles.content: Multi-hop knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) benchmarks are often treated as fixed language-and-reasoning tasks, but for navigation-based methods, difficulty also depends on the graph in which those tasks are instantiated. This makes graph construction a consequential but often entangled part of the navigation task. To isolate this effect, we audit PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL) as graph-navigation benchmarks under a controlled intervention: we hold questions, topic entities, released answers, released path annotations, and family-level splits fixed while replacing each released task-filtered graph with the larger source KG distributed with the benchmark. Source restoration expands the effective navigation search space and graph-consistent answer and path multiplicity while sharply reducing unguided reachability to released answers. We evaluate whether these structural changes persist across navigation policies using structural references, frozen small-language-model navigation policies, and trained MINERVA policies. Across both frozen and trained policies, restoration substantially reduces released-answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity, while graph-consistent evaluation recovers only part of the loss. These results show that benchmark graph construction is part of the navigation task specification rather than merely an implementation detail and can materially shape measured behavior even when the released QA task is held fixed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基准图形构造形状多高KG 导航:对路径问题和路径问题进行控制的审计
articles.content_zh: 多跳知识-图解答(KGQA)基准往往被视为固定的语言和推理任务,但对于以导航为基础的方法,难度也取决于这些任务被即时化的图表. 这使得图表构造成为导航任务中必然而常被缠绕的部分. 为了隔离这种效果,我们审计路径问题(PQ)和路径问题-Large(PQL)作为受控干预下的图导航基准:我们持有问题,主题实体,发布答案,发布路径说明,以及家庭层面分拆固定,同时将每个已发布的任务过滤图替换为与基准分配的较大源KG. 源恢复扩展了有效的导航搜索空间和与图形一致的答案和路径多端,同时将解出答案的无导可达性急剧降低. 我们评价这些结构性变化是否在各种导航政策中持续,使用结构参考、冻结的小型语言模型导航政策以及训练有素的MInerVA政策。 无论是冻结政策还是训练有素的政策,恢复都大大减少了释放的准确度和轨迹可靠性,而与图表一致的评价只弥补了部分损失。 这些结果显示,基准图表构建是导航任务规格的一部分,而不仅仅是一个执行细节,即使释放的QA任务被固定,也可以在物质上塑造被测量的行为.

articles.title: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
articles.content: On-policy distillation can transfer the reasoning capabilities of a strong teacher to a smaller student. However, distillation from a stronger teacher model faces two mismatches: its solutions may be difficult for a smaller student to imitate, and its token-level probabilities may be incompatible with, or even unavailable to, the student. Existing methods handle these settings through different forms of supervision. To this end, we propose Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces. The model to be distilled from, termed the external teacher, first provides a reasoning trace as privileged context, which can be generated in an offline fashion. The student generates rollouts without this context, while a copy of the student conditioned on it, serving as the self-teacher, scores the same rollouts in the student's own token space. BSD uses the resulting token-level guidance to adjust updates on unsuccessful rollouts, with a verifier providing the outcome signal. As the external teacher is queried only to produce text, the same training procedure applies to all teacher scenarios: shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers. Across these scenarios, BSD improves over the base model and outperforms baselines tailored to each scenario, offering a novel and unified pathway for distillation. Code is available: https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于政策学习的桥梁式自我分裂
articles.content_zh: 政策分解可以将强师生的推理能力转移给较小的学生. 然而,从更强的师范模式中分馏会面临两种不匹配的情况:其解决方案可能难以让较小的学生模仿,而其象征级的概率可能与学生不相容,甚至无法与学生相容. 现有方法通过不同形式的监督来处理这些设置. 为此,我们提议Bridged Self-Distillation(BSD),这是从任何提供推理痕迹的老师身上分馏出一个统一的框架. 从外部老师那里提炼出来的模型,首先提供了作为特权背景的推理痕迹,可以脱机生成. 学生在没有这种上下文的情况下产生"推出",而附条件于此的"学生"的复制品,作为自导自演,在学生自己的象征性空间中得分相同"推出". BSD使用由此得到的令牌级指导来调整未成功推出时的更新,由核查员提供结果信号. 由于询问外部教师只是为了制作文本,因此同样的培训程序适用于所有教师的情况:共享触控器、交叉触控器和封闭的API教师。 在整个这些设想中,BSD比基准模型有所改善,并且超越了适合每个设想情景的基线,为蒸馏提供了一个全新的统一途径。 代码见:https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
articles.content: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实验性有限责任公司参数有效精细图解的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 参数效率微调(PEFT)方法对于在受资源限制的情况下调整大型模型至关重要。 然而,由于专家混合结构在大规模参数尺度上提供了有效的推论,因此在社区中日益普遍,由于缺乏将PEFT应用于教育部模型的系统方法,造成一个重大差距。 为了缩小这一差距,我们进行了大规模的系统研究,在三个关于下游任务的教育部骨干和一般知识任务的骨干上,调查一套基本设计方法,包括应调整哪些模块、应采用何种颗粒性来调整教育部模块、应采用何种PEFT方法以及应在何种程度上使用负载平衡目标。 我们的实验产生了若干关键见解。 首先,仅根据可比参数预算,使教育部专家具有竞争力的一般能力保留,就能取得最高的下游业绩。 其次,本地专家加权更新比绕过专家或整个教育部模块的适配器更能提供下游-保留取舍。 第三,LORA和DORA共同界定了经评价的PEFT方法中最强的操作区域,以达到高下游精度. 第四,没有非零负载平衡系数Pareto占据了零基线. 我们最终评估了Wen3上2美元-LORA的重量级重新设计。 将其模块级绕行池移入本土专家权重,使所有四个上游端点都提高了2.4至17.9分,可训练参数减少17%,下游平均成本为3.2分.

articles.title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
articles.content: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VibeTraining-Bench:数据-培训者-Harness联合设计用于迭代系统改进
articles.content_zh: 递归自修(RSI)需要代理人诊断系统瓶颈,协调整个培训和推论的改进. 我们把特工人员联合优化培训数据的能力、教练员和推论机作为交叉组件共同设计。 我们引入了VibeTraining-Bench,这是在跨越终端操作、软件工程、多回合工具使用和数学推理的任务中评估这种能力的基准。 在每项任务中,研究人员从固定资源预算下的相同的初始代理系统开始。 在验证反馈的指导下,它们迭代地完善数据、培训员和推断工具,然后选择并提交一个最终剂系统,用于对测试集进行评价。 为了防止奖励黑客入侵,我们实施了三项保障措施:测试数据隔离,单独的研究和分级容器,以及研究代理的网络限制. 我们的评价结果表明,前沿研究代理人大大改进了目标代理人系统。 例如,在SWE-bench Verifed上,GPT-6-Astra将目标代理系统的性能从32.9%提升到53.7%,与人造指令模型的55.4%相当. 然而,仍有余地提高它们共同设计和迭代地改进数据、训练员和利用的能力,以取得累积的业绩收益。 我们希望VibeTraining-Bench将成为推进RSI的统一平台,加深我们对代理系统跨组件优化的理解. 代码和数据见https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTraining Bench。

articles.title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs
articles.content: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved three of four model configurations across the external benchmarks, with mean gains of up to 9.6 percentage points, and improved all four configurations on the held-out test set by 10.2-30.3 points. Abstract retrieval performed best when reference evidence was abstract-aligned, whereas full-text representations were generally more effective when richer evidence was needed. Hierarchical representation matched or outperformed flat full-text retrieval in most end-to-end comparisons while requiring 67% fewer indexed units and 44-56% less storage. These findings show that corpus scale should be treated as an explicit evaluation variable in biomedical RAG, and that the most appropriate design depends on evidence format, model behavior, and operational constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大型生物医学研究小组:公司规模、文件代表性和效率取舍
articles.content_zh: 我们对生物医学检索-增强生成(RAG)系统的效力和效率如何影响生物医学检索-增强生成(RAG)系统的规模、文件表述和重新排序进行了有控制的大规模评估。 检索收藏逐渐扩大,同时保留了相关的原始文件,从而能够对各种体积进行一致的比较。 我们比较了抽象的,平整的全文, 和分级的全文 整个第一阶段的检索, 重新排序, 以及端到端的多选择问题回答。 已根据五个外部生物医学基准和一套预留测试对开发数据选定的配置进行了评价,同时测量了检索延迟和指数存储,以量化业务费用。 随着收藏量的增加,所观察到的少量或受管制的收藏品的性能模式并非始终如一地存在,重新排列是否有用取决于保单和检索设置。 RAG在外部基准上改进了四个模型配置中的三个,平均收益最高可达9.6个百分点,并在所设定的10.2-30.3分的搁置测试上改进了全部四个配置. 当参考证据是抽象的时,摘要检索表现最好,而如果需要更丰富的证据,则全文说明一般更有效。 在大多数端到端比较中,分级表示匹配或超过平面全文检索,同时需要减少67%的索引单位和44-56%的存储. 这些调查结果表明,生物医学RAG应将生物量表视为明确的评价变量,最适当的设计取决于证据格式、模式行为和操作限制。

articles.title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors
articles.content: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 流行变化下类型的决定模式:决策培训、校准和隐性前科
articles.content_zh: 被打出的决定模型(TDMs)比起呼叫者定义的选项返回概率,Jev被其供应商描述为校正. 但是在部署级频率变化时,在固定测试集上测量的校正在应用阈值的地方不需要坚持. 现有的评价留下了两个空白:供应商决策培训的收益没有与主干部门的收益分开,而TDM只在测试组的班级分配中进行测试。 我们询问决策培训是否改进了一个模型,而不是它自己的骨干;TDM的校准和阈值是否能够承受流行(标签)的转变,以及经过微调的分类器。 我们比较了三个TDM(Jev,Tev1-4B,Nimble-9B),它们的基准模型和两个经过培训的关于模拟变换下五个公共数据集相同决定的分类器,在计算任何测试之前,35个对等测试被固定. 首先,决策培训并非一致有益:只有LORA适配器才能与Quen3.5-9B相区别的Nimble-9B在意向任务上得到更好的校正,而Macro-F1则在财务情绪上得到更糟糕的分数. 第二,在中度转变下,Jev的预期校正误差(ECE)和阈值风险的大幅增长,远远大于对DeBERTa的微调,仅以金融情绪为主,增长1.7和2.5个百分点;平均超过2000个转值假想(探索),差距在每个数据集最多只有一分. 第三,EM先用模型的平均发展预测进行校正,因为其以前的需要是没有标签的,并将Jev的ECE在最高的两个数据集上调低了2.7分和1.8分,尽管标注的再校正更低了多得多. 我们测试的三个TDM既非其骨干整体好,也非其独特的易变;就校正而言,它们的主要弱点是它们已经存在的不转而校正错误。 我们发布所有输入、代码和产出。

articles.title: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
articles.content: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 调度器是一个隐藏检索器: 如何在搜索代理中同步获取证据
articles.content_zh: 语言模型代理人越来越多地通过平行推理和同步信息收集来解决复杂的任务. 对两个模范家庭和三个基准进行有控制的再演显示,尽管初步证据相同,交付时间会改变在所有结果到达之前作出的搜索决定。 采购方面的分歧比同级重复变化高出24个百分点。 在所有初步证据到来之后,这种依赖性继续存在,并通过第二次调查,将代理人所看到的暂时性差异转变为他们所获得的持久差异。 配有相配构件的购置-监管程序表明,在固定的提前到达计数时的不一致性会限制已经收到证据的使用. 我们引入了Confluent Information(CEA),它反而在每一个子问题的证据完成后释放出本地推理,并且将共享搜索与完成令分开分配. 对于一个固定的计划和稳定的有条件反应法,我们证明了共同的对决定、收购和答案的偏颇。 由于有三个基准的仅限问题计划,CEA将采购方面的分歧提高到了重复变化的1.0个百分点以内,并实现了与完全投入控制相当的准确性,比早期承诺提高了12.6个百分点。 将CEA的固定分配额改为争议中的先备分配额,增加了21.6%的购置分歧,而当地查询-目标分歧则几乎重复。 时间比较表明,CEA比同一程序更早达成决定,并比等待所有初始证据的同一程序更快的响应.

articles.title: Answering While You Type: Optimizing Time-to-Answer with Streaming Generation
articles.content: Work on efficient large-language-model inference has concentrated almost entirely on reducing the cost of decoding once a request is complete. The quantity a user experiences, however, is the interval between submitting a request and receiving a usable response, and that interval can be shortened without making decoding itself faster. While a request is being composed it is already partially specified, yet conventional deployments begin no computation until submission. We propose and study streaming generation, a decoding regime in which the model begins producing a response from an incomplete request and revises it as the remaining input arrives, so that only a small residue of the answer remains to be computed once the request is submitted. We evaluate the regime on autoregressive and diffusion language models, characterise the conditions under which it reduces user-visible latency, and analyse the mechanism responsible.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在您输入时回答: 优化时间到答录器的流化生成
articles.content_zh: 关于高效的大语言模型推论的工作几乎完全集中在一旦请求完成后降低解码费用上. 然而,用户经历的数量是提交请求和收到可用答复之间的间隔,而这一间隔可以缩短,而不会使自己解码更快。 虽然一项请求正在编写中,但已经部分具体说明,但常规部署直到提交后才开始计算。 我们提议并研究流化生成,这是一种编解码制度,即模型开始从不完整的请求中产生答复,并在剩余输入到达时加以修订,这样,在提交请求后,只有一小部分答案尚待计算。 我们评价关于自动递减和传播语言模式的制度,确定减少用户可见延迟的条件,并分析负责的机制。

articles.title: AudioScorer: Learning Question-Aware Token Relevance for Large Audio Language Models
articles.content: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) reason over speech, environmental sounds, music, and other acoustic information. However, their audio encoders produce dense token sequences that make long-form audio costly to process. Existing audio pruning methods reduce this cost using heuristics such as attention, representation similarity, or temporal sampling, but do not explicitly learn which tokens are most useful for a given question. We propose AudioScorer, a lightweight model that scores audio tokens according to the user question. It is trained by distilling the ranking of audio tokens under the frozen LALM's answer-gradient saliency, together with downstream answer supervision. Compared with other pruning methods, AudioScorer achieves the best or tied-best result at 10% token retention on 7 of 10 semantic and acoustic tasks, including speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio-scene classification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 音频计分器: 学习大音频语言模型的 QQ- Aware Token 相关性
articles.content_zh: 大型音频语言模型(LALMs)理性比语音,环境声音,音乐等声学信息. 然而,他们的音频编码器产生密集的符号序列,使长式音频处理成本高昂. 现有的音频冲洗方法利用注意,表现相似性,或时间采样等热力学方法来降低这一成本,但没有明确知道哪些符号对特定问题最有用. 我们提出AudioScouncer,一个轻量级的模型,根据用户的问题来评分音频符号. 它通过在被冷冻的LALM的解答分级优势下对音频符的排名进行分馏来培训,同时进行下游解答监督. 相较于其他打分方法,AudioScore器在10个语义和声学任务中的7个任务上以10%的符号保留来达到最佳或捆绑的最佳结果,包括语音识别,情感识别,和音频-场景分类.

articles.title: Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law
articles.content: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 马奇娜·保利安娜: 荷兰破产法中处理 " 行动 " 的神经-连带方法
articles.content_zh: 适用一项法律规定往往要求有条理地进行有章可循的推理和对判例法中拟订的开放式术语的敏感性。 《荷兰破产法》第42条(Faillissementswet,Fw)的cactio pouliana允许破产从业人员避免损害债权人的交易。 我们提出了第42Fw条的神经同义模型。 它的象征核心用Catala写成,其通俗风格保持了法规和形式一致,并通过对等编程而得到发展,开放文字的术语在神经元和象征解析器对等的地方作为布尔输入来表示. 神经常规结构 案件自然语言的事实 布尔和日期输入。 神经分程序通过对荷兰民事判决的基于案例的推理来解决开放式词语,通过对正在解决的要求进行过滤的管道检索,并在案件的程序链上扩展。 这些判决的分解和标签非常精确,并参照100项判决的金本位标准。 在10起手持说明的情况下,神经系统模型合理处理大多数标准,但与知识要求相矛盾。 检索深度没有显示明确的量化效果,尽管检索到的判决为以前的案例法提供了明确的依据。

articles.title: Shaping the Document, Not the Model: Optimized Suffixes for Context Following
articles.content: When a user supplies a document and wants the answer drawn from it, a language model is expected to follow it even when it contradicts its parametric knowledge. Prior work has focused on making the model rely on context by steering activations, contrasting logits during decoding, or instructing it in plain language. We ask whether the document alone, with no instruction written into it and no access to the model at inference time, is enough. We optimize a document suffix by discrete token search, starting from the answer to a single question and extending the objective to a set of passages, to multi-hop questions that follow from the planted fact, and to later turns of a conversation. On counterfactual passages that contradict parametric knowledge of the model, the suffix flips nearly all items the model resists across three instruction-tuned model families, in most settings outperforms the decoding baseline and the strongest instruction we could write, and matches activation steering. Controls show that the suffix largely acts through the passage rather than injecting the answer, and a single suffix per model transfers to unseen passages. Each extended objective carries the effect to its target, so the objective, not only the document, sets how far the effect reaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 塑造文档, 而非模型: 最佳后缀
articles.content_zh: 当一个用户提供一个文档并想要从中提取的答案时,一个语言模型即使与它的参数化知识相矛盾,也有望遵循它. 之前的工作重点是通过引导活化,在解码时对比日志,或用平话指示来使模型依赖上下文. 我们问,仅凭该文件本身,没有写入任何指示,也没有在推断时间获得模型是否足够。 我们通过离散的符号搜索来优化一个文档后缀,从回答到一个单一的问题,然后将目标扩展到一组段落,从所植入的事实开始的多跳问题,再到后来的对话转折. 在与模型的参数化知识相矛盾的反事实段落上,后缀翻转了几乎所有的模型所抵抗的项目,跨越了三个指令调制的模型家族,在大多数情况下,都超过了解码基线和我们所能写的最强指令,并匹配活化向导. 控制显示后缀主要通过通道进行操作,而不是将答案注入,每个模型都有一个后缀向看不见的通道转移. 每个扩大的目标都带来其目标的效果,因此目标,而不仅仅是文件,规定了效果达到的程度。

articles.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
articles.content: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 心跳想:在实时语音代理中倾听时的投机性理性和工具执行
articles.content_zh: 使用工具的语音代理经常让用户在语音结束后等待,即使可操作信息在请求中提前到达. 光谱式方法在演讲期间开始工作,但块束式或中断式更新生成可以在一个工具调用完成之前截断. 这对夫妇计算发言更新的时间,限制了提前完成的有益工作. 我们引入了"心想"(Heartbeat Thinking),它通过新的"思想家"引用来处理更新的输入,同时允许正在进行的引用和发送的工具完成. 定期引用阅读最新的部分记录和关于已完成推理和工具结果的共同记录。 这些结果有助于解决缺失的论据并启动依赖性呼叫,从而能够在整个语音更新过程中进行准备以取得进展. 在整个SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG, Heartbeat改进了SHANKS式窗口基线的总投机工具覆盖或再利用,对最终任务质量有基准依赖效应。 在FDBench v3上,它将工具覆盖率提高了16个百分点,将平均最终反应延迟率降低了36.4%. 结果显示,心跳思维范式在语音中保留了正在进行的计算,可以将收听时间转化为可再使用的准备,以更快和更能进行语音代理响应.

articles.title: Rethinking BPE: Merge Selection as Model Selection
articles.content: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) are a core component of modern language models; yet, tokenizer capacity remains typically determined by a fixed merge budget, chosen heuristically. Since larger vocabularies increase memory usage and computational cost, selecting compact and effective token inventories is essential for efficient language modeling. We study the optimization of a BPE merge budget as a statistical model selection problem and investigate information-theoretic criteria for \emph{computing optimal merge sets} directly from corpus statistics. To further improve the merge selection in limited data conditions, we augment the BPE training corpora with synthetic texts generated from the original data, providing estimates for the unigram and bigram distributions. Experiments across multiple corpora and downstream tasks show that using a principled vocabulary selection technique reduces model size, with little degradation in performance. We further observe that synthetic data can yield better tokenizers, especially in low-resource settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新思考 KPE: 合并选择为模式选择
articles.content_zh: Byte-Pair Encoding(BPE)等子词符号化方法是现代语言模型的核心组成部分;然而,符号化能力仍然一般由固定合并预算来决定,以heuristic方式选择. 由于较大的词汇增加内存使用和计算成本,选择紧凑而有效的符号清单对于高效的语文模型制作至关重要。 我们研究优化BPE合并预算作为统计模型选择问题,并直接从实体统计中调查\emph{计算最佳合并集}的信息理论标准。 为了进一步改善有限数据条件下的合并选择,我们用从原始数据中生成的合成文本来增强BPE训练公司,为单体和大块分布提供估计. 跨越多科多拉和下游任务的实验表明,使用有原则的词汇选择技术会缩小模型大小,性能几乎没有退化. 我们进一步注意到,合成数据可以产生更好的显示器,特别是在资源少的情况下。

articles.title: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
articles.content: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VEILED-SH:通过间接语言评价数据集(自相机)表达脆弱性
articles.content_zh: 人工智能系统可能错失间接的、文化上的困扰,或提供与应用程序上下文不匹配的支持。 现有的基准并不共同解决文化差异、应用背景和从业人员的分歧。 我们引入了VEILED-SH,作为评估对自杀、自残和痛苦等间接表现的单回合反应的基准和构建方法。 它的10 003个提示包括顾问聊天、论坛帖子、平台搜索和分辨, 一种经过专家验证的多标签分类法区分了意图,沟通功能,以及反应行为. 6个自动剖面图,分别校准为3个对等支助从业人员和3个临床医生,保留了单独的代理对等评分参考政策. 对5个系统进行涵盖范围较广的抽样评估,发现不同概况生成的参考政策之间的代理协调存在差异,即使是对同一系统的回应也是如此。

articles.title: Reading Time Modeling with Pixel-Based Language Models
articles.content: Tokenization-free, pixel-based language models (PLMs) have recently been proposed as an alternative to conventional token-based language models (TLMs), typically motivated by practical considerations, e.g., the flexibility to support new languages or vocabularies. Nevertheless, PLMs also have the potential to serve as infrastructure for computational (psycho)linguistics, where tokenization has been a source of bias in estimating information-theoretic values, such as surprisal, and has pushed the bottom-up visual orthographic features outside the scope. In this study, we first integrate PLMs into the modeling of naturalistic human reading and, in particular, examine their use to estimate next-word predictability, which can also integrate orthographic and parafoveal information. Our results demonstrate that next-word prediction difficulty, computed in pixel space, has strong predictive power for gaze duration and word skipping behavior across various languages. In particular, their advantage is complementary to existing token-level surprisal and entropy estimates. Cross-lingual analyses with script variations also clarify their distinctive visual processing biases, facilitating research into how bottom-up visual information is incrementally integrated into expectation-based reading.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以像素为基础的语言模型读取时间建模
articles.content_zh: 最近有人提议,不使用类似像素的语言模型(PLMs),作为传统符号语言模型(TLMs)的替代物,典型的动机是实际考虑,例如支持新语言或词汇的灵活性。 尽管如此,PLM也有可能成为计算(psycho)语言学的基础设施,在计算信息理论值时,标注学一直是偏颇的来源,如超平等,并将自下而上的视觉正文特征推出范围外. 在这项研究中,我们首先将PLM纳入自然主义人类阅读的模型化,并特别审查它们用于估算下个字的可预测性,这也能够将正文和抛物资料相融合. 我们的结果显示,用像素空间计算的下个字的预测困难,在视线持续期间具有很强的预测力,并且字词跳过各种语言的行为. 特别是,它们的优势是对现有的象征性水平的超额和等效估计的补充. 具有脚本变化的跨语言分析也澄清了它们独特的视觉处理偏差,有助于研究如何将自下而上的视觉信息逐渐地纳入基于期望的阅读.

articles.title: Conditional information Retrieval for Longitudinal Survey Harmonisation
articles.content: Identifying conceptually equivalent questions across different surveys is a challenging information retrieval task where surface-level textual similarity is insufficient. Two questions may be lexically similar yet assess entirely different sociological sub-concepts, or lexically different yet conceptually equivalent. We introduce a conditional information retrieval framework that addresses this by decomposing the task into two steps: concept extraction, which identifies the underlying sociological concept of a survey question using a fine-tuned generative model, and concept-aware retrieval, which augments question representations with the extracted concept as an explicit conditioning signal for finer-grained alignment. To reflect the realistic data scarcity conditions of specialised social science annotation, we use CLOSER as a case study. Our framework consistently outperforms baselines by 2-3 points in both MAP and Recall. We further analyse fine-tuning strategies including SFT, DPO, and dynamic DPO, finding that SFT delivers the most stable gains while dynamic DPO interacts differently with instruction-tuned versus distilled reasoning backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that a model fine-tuned on a general social science thesaurus (ELSST) transfers robustly to task-specific survey data, offering a practical solution under data scarcity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 有条件的资料 纵向调查的检索
articles.content_zh: 在各种调查中确定概念上相当的问题是一项具有挑战性的信息检索任务,因为表面的文字相似性不足。 两个问题在逻辑上可能相似,但对完全不同的社会学分概念进行评估,或者在逻辑上不同但概念上相当。 我们引入了一个有条件的信息检索框架,通过将任务分解成两个步骤来解决这个问题:概念提取(它用精细的基因模型确定调查问题的基本社会学概念)和概念意识检索(它用所提取的概念来强化问题表述,作为更精细的调整的明确条件信号)。 为了反映专业社会科学注释中现实的数据稀缺状况,我们使用CLOSER作为案例研究. 我们的框架在《行动计划》和《召回》中的业绩始终比基线高出2至3分。 我们进一步分析微调策略,包括SFT,DPO和动态DPO,发现SFT能提供最稳定的收益,而动态DPO与指令调取与分馏推理主干不同. 最后,我们表明,对一般社会科学术语库(ELSST)进行微调的模型将强有力地转移至针对特定任务的调查数据,在数据稀缺的情况下提供了一个实际的解决办法。

articles.title: VISAGENT: An Agent-Based End-to-End Voice Interaction System
articles.content: Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness. More broadly, this work advocates a shift from isolated voice assistants toward agent-centric conversational infrastructures, providing a general blueprint for building extensible voice-agent systems in public services and beyond.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VISAGENT:一个基于代理的端到端语音互动系统
articles.content_zh: 基于语音的公共服务已经由人工交换机演变为智能平台,以满足现代用户需要. 然而,目前的系统仍然受到僵硬的菜单驱动互动、分散的纵向服务以及有限的扩展性的限制。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了VISAGENT,一个基于代理的端到端语音互动系统,用于大型公共服务,该系统集端到端语音互动,分级代理路由,可伸缩语音代理市场,以及用户内存支持于一体. 该系统以自然语音取代菜单驱动的工作流程,并动态地向用户发送请求,通过双层路由范式,实现副秒意图到代理选择超过上百个代理. 用户内存向偏好-意识代理选择提供信息,并向所选代理提供相关偏好和上下文,支持个性化任务执行,并减少用户重复先前提供的信息的需求. 语音代理注册机制将任务代理转换为对话实体,使动态登机和生态系统层面的扩展成为可能。 我们通过在中国114条跨多个服务领域的热线进行现实部署,验证了VISAGENT。 实验结果表明,低纬度的全相通性相互作用、稳健的路由可伸缩性以及竞争性的语音自然性。 更广泛地说,这项工作主张从孤立的语音助理转向以代理为中心的谈话基础设施,为在公共服务部门内外建立可扩展的语音代理系统提供了总体蓝图。

articles.title: DeepSEA: A Multilingual Evaluation Benchmark for Southeast Asia
articles.content: While language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their performance remains disproportionately skewed towards high-resource languages. This disparity is particularly acute for the 700 million inhabitants of Southeast Asia, where vast linguistic diversity remains under-represented in existing benchmarks, often suffering from limited language coverage or narrow task scopes. To address this, we introduce DeepSEA, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from established datasets through professional human translation into 12 Southeast Asian languages, spanning both high-resource (e.g., Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese) and low-resource (e.g., Burmese, Khmer, Lao) tiers across five distinct tasks: mathematical reasoning, scientific reasoning, question answering, abstractive summarization, and machine translation. Extensive evaluation of frontier proprietary and open-weights models reveals that while frontier models like Gemini-3.7-Flash maintain robustness across resource tiers, smaller models face severe performance degradation on low-resource languages. Crucially, models perform better in reasoning and summarization when pivoted through English rather than target languages, exposing a critical dependency on English representations, especially for low-resource languages. Beyond these observations, we provide a cross-lingual error analysis and a cross-script tokenizer fertility analysis. We hope these findings shed light on the development of next-generation inclusive multilingual models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DeepSEA:东南亚多种语文评价基准
articles.content_zh: 虽然语言模式表现出了显著的能力,但其表现仍然不成比例地偏重于高资源语言。 对东南亚7亿居民来说,这种差距尤其严重,因为在现有基准中,语言多样性仍然不足,往往语言覆盖面有限或任务范围狭窄。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了DeepSEA这一综合基准,该基准是通过专业的人类翻译为12种东南亚语言而建立的,涵盖高资源(如印度尼西亚语、泰语、越南语)和低资源(如缅甸语、高棉语、老挝语),涉及五个不同的任务:数学推理、科学推理、回答问题、抽象总结和机器翻译。 对前沿专有和开放量级模型的广泛评价表明,虽然双子座-3.7-Flash等前沿模型在资源层次上保持稳健性,但较小的模型在低资源语言上面临严重性能退化. 关键的是,模型在通过英语而不是目标语言进行支点时,在推理和归纳方面表现较好,暴露出对英语表述的依赖性,尤其是对于低资源语言而言. 除了这些观察之外,我们还提供一种跨语言误差分析和一种跨语标注式生育率分析。 我们希望这些结论能够阐明下一代包容性多语种模式的发展。
